AI.method: 研究两种不同的偏好数据质量差异：生成器级差异（由生成选择和拒绝推理轨迹的模型能力差异引起）和样本级差异（由单个偏好对中判断的质量差异引起）。通过改变生成器的规模和模型家族来研究生成器级差异，使用LLM作为评判者从多个推理质量维度评估生成轨迹的质量来研究样本级差异。
AI.result: 研究发现：1）增加生成器级差异能稳步提升在领域外推理任务上的性能；2）按样本级差异筛选数据可以实现更高效的数据训练。生成器级差异越大，模型在未见推理任务上的表现越好。
AI.conclusion: 提出了通过偏好优化提升推理性能的双重策略：在构建偏好对时最大化生成器级差异，并利用样本级差异选择最具信息量的训练样本。这为构建更有效的偏好数据提供了指导原则。

title: SIC3D: Style Image Conditioned Text-to-3D Gaussian Splatting Generation
summary: Recent progress in text-to-3D object generation enables the synthesis of detailed geometry from text input by leveraging 2D diffusion models and differentiable 3D representations. However, the approaches often suffer from limited controllability and texture ambiguity due to the limitation of the text modality. To address this, we present SIC3D, a controllable image-conditioned text-to-3D generation pipeline with 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS). There are two stages in SIC3D. The first stage generates the 3D object content from text with a text-to-3DGS generation model. The second stage transfers style from a reference image to the 3DGS. Within this stylization stage, we introduce a novel Variational Stylized Score Distillation (VSSD) loss to effectively capture both global and local texture patterns while mitigating conflicts between geometry and appearance. A scaling regularization is further applied to prevent the emergence of artifacts and preserve the pattern from the style image. Extensive experiments demonstrate that SIC3D enhances geometric fidelity and style adherence, outperforming prior approaches in both qualitative and quantitative evaluations.

AI.tldr: SIC3D是一个可控的图像条件文本到3D生成系统，使用3D高斯泼溅技术，通过两阶段流程实现从文本生成3D内容，然后从参考图像进行风格迁移。
AI.motivation: 现有文本到3D生成方法存在可控性有限和纹理模糊的问题，主要受限于文本模态的表达能力。需要一种能够结合图像参考来增强纹理控制和风格一致性的方法。
AI.method: 采用两阶段流程：第一阶段使用文本到3DGS生成模型从文本生成3D对象内容；第二阶段通过变分风格化分数蒸馏（VSSD）损失从参考图像向3DGS传输风格，该损失能有效捕捉全局和局部纹理模式，同时缓解几何与外观之间的冲突。还应用了缩放正则化来防止伪影并保留风格图像的模式。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，SIC3D在几何保真度和风格一致性方面都有显著提升，在定性和定量评估中都优于先前的方法。
AI.conclusion: SIC3D通过结合文本到3D生成和图像条件风格迁移，解决了现有方法在可控性和纹理模糊方面的局限性，提供了一种更有效、更可控的3D内容生成方案。

title: HiL-Bench (Human-in-Loop Benchmark): Do Agents Know When to Ask for Help?
summary:
Frontier coding agents solve complex tasks when given complete context but collapse when specifications are incomplete or ambiguous. The bottleneck is not raw capability, but judgment: knowing when to act autonomously and when to ask for help. Current benchmarks are blind to this failure mode. They supply unambiguous detailed instructions and solely reward execution correctness, so an agent that makes a lucky guess for a missing requirement will score identically to one that would have asked to be certain.
  We present HiL-Bench (Human-in-the-Loop Benchmark) to measure this selective escalation skill. Each task contains human-validated blockers (missing information, ambiguous requests, contradictory information) that surface only through progressive exploration, not upfront inspection. Our core metric, Ask-F1, the harmonic mean of question precision and blocker recall, captures the tension between over-asking and silent guessing; its structure architecturally prevents gaming through question spam.
  Evaluation across SWE and text-to-SQL domains reveals a large universal judgment gap: no frontier model recovers more than a fraction of its full-information performance when deciding whether to ask. Failure analysis identifies three key help-seeking patterns: overconfident wrong beliefs with no gap detection; high uncertainty detection yet persistent errors; broad, imprecise escalation without self-correction. These consistent patterns confirm poor help-seeking is a model-level flaw, not task-specific. RL training on shaped Ask-F1 reward shows judgment is trainable: a 32B model improves both help-seeking quality and task pass rate, with gains that transfer across domains. The model does not learn domain-specific heuristics for when to ask; it learns to detect unresolvable uncertainty and act on it.

AI.tldr: HiL-Bench是一个评估AI代理在面临不完整或模糊规范时选择性寻求帮助能力的基准，通过Ask-F1指标衡量代理在过度询问和沉默猜测之间的平衡能力。
AI.motivation: 当前前沿编码代理在完整上下文下能解决复杂任务，但在规范不完整或模糊时会崩溃。瓶颈不在于原始能力，而在于判断力：知道何时自主行动、何时寻求帮助。现有基准测试无法检测这种失败模式，因为它们提供明确详细的指令，只奖励执行正确性。
AI.method: 提出HiL-Bench基准，包含经过人工验证的障碍（缺失信息、模糊请求、矛盾信息），这些障碍只能通过渐进探索而非前期检查发现。核心指标Ask-F1（问题精确度和障碍召回率的调和平均数）捕捉过度询问和沉默猜测之间的张力，其结构从架构上防止通过问题垃圾邮件进行博弈。
AI.result: 在SWE和text-to-SQL领域的评估显示存在普遍的判断力差距：没有前沿模型在决定是否询问时能恢复其完整信息性能的一小部分。失败分析识别出三种关键帮助寻求模式：过度自信的错误信念且无差距检测；高不确定性检测但持续错误；广泛不精确的升级而无自我修正。基于Ask-F1奖励的RL训练显示判断力是可训练的：32B模型在帮助寻求质量和任务通过率上都有提升，且增益能跨领域迁移。
AI.conclusion: 帮助寻求能力差是模型层面的缺陷而非任务特定的。模型学习检测不可解决的不确定性并据此行动，而不是学习何时询问的领域特定启发式方法。判断力是可训练的，这为改进AI代理在现实世界模糊环境中的表现提供了方向。

title: LLMs Underperform Graph-Based Parsers on Supervised Relation Extraction for Complex Graphs
summary: Relation extraction represents a fundamental component in the process of creating knowledge graphs, among other applications. Large language models (LLMs) have been adopted as a promising tool for relation extraction, both in supervised and in-context learning settings. However, in this work we show that their performance still lags behind much smaller architectures when the linguistic graph underlying a text has great complexity. To demonstrate this, we evaluate four LLMs against a graph-based parser on six relation extraction datasets with sentence graphs of varying sizes and complexities. Our results show that the graph-based parser increasingly outperforms the LLMs, as the number of relations in the input documents increases. This makes the much lighter graph-based parser a superior choice in the presence of complex linguistic graphs.

AI.tldr: LLMs在关系抽取任务中表现不如轻量级图解析器，尤其是在处理复杂语言图时
AI.motivation: 关系抽取是构建知识图谱等应用的基础组件，虽然大型语言模型（LLMs）在监督学习和上下文学习设置中显示出潜力，但在处理复杂语言图时性能可能不如更小的架构
AI.method: 评估了四种LLMs与基于图的解析器在六个关系抽取数据集上的表现，这些数据集包含不同大小和复杂度的句子图
AI.result: 随着输入文档中关系数量的增加，基于图的解析器逐渐超越LLMs的表现，在处理复杂语言图时，更轻量的图解析器成为更优选择
AI.conclusion: 在处理复杂语言图的关系抽取任务中，轻量级图解析器比大型语言模型更具优势，特别是在关系数量较多的情况下

title: State Space Models are Effective Sign Language Learners: Exploiting Phonological Compositionality for Vocabulary-Scale Recognition
comment: 8 pages, 3 figures. Accepted to workshop on Algorithmic Fairness Across Alignment Procedures and Agentic Systems at ICLR 2026
summary: Sign language recognition suffers from catastrophic scaling failure: models achieving high accuracy on small vocabularies collapse at realistic sizes. Existing architectures treat signs as atomic visual patterns, learning flat representations that cannot exploit the compositional structure of sign languages-systematically organized from discrete phonological parameters (handshape, location, movement, orientation) reused across the vocabulary. We introduce PHONSSM, enforcing phonological decomposition through anatomically-grounded graph attention, explicit factorization into orthogonal subspaces, and prototypical classification enabling few-shot transfer. Using skeleton data alone on the largest ASL dataset ever assembled (5,565 signs), PHONSSM achieves 72.1% on WLASL2000 (+18.4pp over skeleton SOTA), surpassing most RGB methods without video input. Gains are most dramatic in the few-shot regime (+225% relative), and the model transfers zero-shot to ASL Citizen, exceeding supervised RGB baselines. The vocabulary scaling bottleneck is fundamentally a representation learning problem, solvable through compositional inductive biases mirroring linguistic structure.

AI.tldr: PHONSSM通过强制音系分解、基于解剖学的图注意力、正交子空间显式分解和原型分类，解决了手语识别中的灾难性扩展问题，在WLASL2000上达到72.1%准确率，比骨架SOTA提升18.4个百分点。
AI.motivation: 手语识别存在灾难性扩展失败问题：在小词汇量上高精度的模型在现实规模下崩溃。现有架构将手语视为原子视觉模式，学习平坦表示，无法利用手语从离散音系参数（手形、位置、运动、方向）重用的组合结构。
AI.method: PHONSSM通过基于解剖学的图注意力强制音系分解，将表示显式分解为正交子空间，并使用原型分类实现少样本迁移。仅使用骨架数据，在迄今最大的ASL数据集（5,565个手语）上验证。
AI.result: 在WLASL2000上达到72.1%准确率，比骨架SOTA提升18.4个百分点，超越大多数无需视频输入的RGB方法。少样本场景提升最显著（+225%相对），零样本迁移到ASL Citizen超过监督RGB基线。
AI.conclusion: 词汇扩展瓶颈本质上是表示学习问题，可通过反映语言结构的组合归纳偏置解决。PHONSSM证明了音系分解在手语识别中的有效性。

title: Do We Really Need to Approach the Entire Pareto Front in Many-Objective Bayesian Optimisation?
summary: Many-objective optimisation, a subset of multi-objective optimisation, involves optimisation problems with more than three objectives. As the number of objectives increases, the number of solutions needed to adequately represent the entire Pareto front typically grows substantially. This makes it challenging, if not infeasible, to design a search algorithm capable of effectively exploring the entire Pareto front. This difficulty is particularly acute in the Bayesian optimisation paradigm, where sample efficiency is critical and only a limited number of solutions (often a few hundred) are evaluated. Moreover, after the optimisation process, the decision-maker eventually selects just one solution for deployment, regardless of how many high-quality, diverse solutions are available. In light of this, we argue an idea that under a very limited evaluation budget, it may be more useful to focus on finding a single solution of the highest possible quality for the decision-maker, rather than aiming to approximate the entire Pareto front as existing many-/multi-objective Bayesian optimisation methods typically do. Bearing this idea in mind, this paper proposes a \underline{s}ingle \underline{p}oint-based \underline{m}ulti-\underline{o}bjective search framework (SPMO) that aims to improve the quality of solutions along a direction that leads to a good tradeoff between objectives. Within SPMO, we present a simple acquisition function, called expected single-point improvement (ESPI), working under both noiseless and noisy scenarios. We show that ESPI can be optimised effectively with gradient-based methods via the sample average approximation (SAA) approach and theoretically prove its convergence guarantees under the SAA. We also empirically demonstrate that the proposed SPMO is computationally tractable and outperforms state-of-the-arts on a wide range of benchmark and real-world problems.

AI.tldr: 提出SPMO框架，专注于在有限评估预算下寻找单个高质量解，而非近似整个帕累托前沿
AI.motivation: 在多目标优化中，随着目标数量增加，需要大量解来近似整个帕累托前沿，但在贝叶斯优化中评估预算有限，且决策者最终只选择一个解部署，因此需要专注于寻找单个高质量解
AI.method: 提出SPMO框架和ESPI采集函数，使用基于梯度的优化方法和样本平均近似方法，支持无噪声和噪声场景
AI.result: SPMO在计算上可行，在广泛的基准测试和实际问题中优于现有方法
AI.conclusion: 在有限评估预算下，专注于寻找单个高质量解比近似整个帕累托前沿更有效，SPMO框架为此提供了有效方法

title: Cards Against LLMs: Benchmarking Humor Alignment in Large Language Models
summary: Humor is one of the most culturally embedded and socially significant dimensions of human communication, yet it remains largely unexplored as a dimension of Large Language Model (LLM) alignment. In this study, five frontier language models play the same Cards Against Humanity games (CAH) as human players. The models select the funniest response from a slate of ten candidate cards across 9,894 rounds. While all models exceed the random baseline, alignment with human preference remains modest. More striking is that models agree with each other substantially more often than they agree with humans. We show that this preference is partly explained by systematic position biases and content preferences, raising the question whether LLM humor judgment reflects genuine preference or structural artifacts of inference and alignment.

AI.tldr: 研究探索大语言模型在幽默判断方面的对齐表现，通过让5个前沿模型与人类玩Cards Against Humanity游戏，发现模型表现优于随机基线但与人类偏好对齐有限，且模型间一致性远高于与人类的一致性。
AI.motivation: 幽默是人类交流中最具文化嵌入性和社会重要性的维度之一，但作为大语言模型对齐的一个维度，目前尚未得到充分探索。本研究旨在评估LLM在幽默判断方面与人类偏好的对齐程度。
AI.method: 让五个前沿语言模型与人类玩家玩相同的Cards Against Humanity游戏。模型从10张候选卡片中选择最有趣的回答，共进行了9,894轮游戏。通过比较模型选择与人类偏好的匹配度来评估对齐效果。
AI.result: 所有模型的表现都超过了随机基线，但与人类偏好的对齐程度仍然有限。更显著的是，模型之间的一致性远高于它们与人类的一致性。研究发现这种偏好部分可以由系统性的位置偏差和内容偏好来解释。
AI.conclusion: 研究提出了一个重要问题：LLM的幽默判断是否反映了真实的偏好，还是仅仅是推理和对齐过程中的结构性伪影。这表明需要进一步研究模型判断与人类幽默感知之间的差异。

title: InstrAct: Towards Action-Centric Understanding in Instructional Videos
summary: Understanding instructional videos requires recognizing fine-grained actions and modeling their temporal relations, which remains challenging for current Video Foundation Models (VFMs). This difficulty stems from noisy web supervision and a pervasive "static bias", where models rely on objects rather than motion cues. To address this, we propose InstrAction, a pretraining framework for instructional videos' action-centric representations. We first introduce a data-driven strategy, which filters noisy captions and generates action-centric hard negatives to disentangle actions from objects during contrastive learning. At the visual feature level, an Action Perceiver extracts motion-relevant tokens from redundant video encodings. Beyond contrastive learning, we introduce two auxiliary objectives: Dynamic Time Warping alignment (DTW-Align) for modeling sequential temporal structure, and Masked Action Modeling (MAM) for strengthening cross-modal grounding. Finally, we introduce the InstrAct Bench to evaluate action-centric understanding, where our method consistently outperforms state-of-the-art VFMs on semantic reasoning, procedural logic, and fine-grained retrieval tasks.

AI.tldr: InstrAction是一个针对教学视频的预训练框架，通过数据清洗、动作感知特征提取和多任务学习来克服现有视频基础模型在细粒度动作识别和时序关系建模上的局限性。
AI.motivation: 当前视频基础模型在教学视频理解上面临两个主要挑战：1）网络监督数据的噪声问题；2）模型存在"静态偏见"，过度依赖物体而非运动线索来识别动作。这导致模型难以理解细粒度动作和时序关系。
AI.method: 1）数据驱动策略：过滤噪声标注并生成动作中心的困难负样本，在对比学习中解耦动作与物体；2）动作感知器：从冗余视频编码中提取运动相关token；3）两个辅助目标：动态时间规整对齐（DTW-Align）建模序列时序结构，掩码动作建模（MAM）加强跨模态对齐。
AI.result: 在提出的InstrAct评测基准上，该方法在语义推理、程序逻辑和细粒度检索任务上持续优于最先进的视频基础模型。
AI.conclusion: InstrAction框架通过动作中心的表示学习，有效解决了教学视频理解中的静态偏见问题，提升了细粒度动作识别和时序关系建模能力。

title: E3-TIR: Enhanced Experience Exploitation for Tool-Integrated Reasoning
summary: While Large Language Models (LLMs) have demonstrated significant potential in Tool-Integrated Reasoning (TIR), existing training paradigms face significant limitations: Zero-RL suffers from inefficient exploration and mode degradation due to a lack of prior guidance, while SFT-then-RL is limited by high data costs and capability plateaus caused by low-entropy collapse. To address these challenges, we propose E3-TIR (Enhanced Experience Exploitation), a warm-up paradigm for the early stages of agent training. Specifically, we formulate training as the dynamic integration of three experience types: Expert Prefixes, Expert Guided, and Self-Exploration. By executing diverse branching exploration around expert "anchors" and employing a mix policy optimization mechanism, we effectively mitigate distribution shifts and resolve optimization conflicts arising from shared prefixes. Our method dynamically adapts the model's knowledge boundaries, effectively balancing exploration diversity with training efficiency.Experimental results demonstrate that E3-TIR achieves a 6 performance improvement over traditional paradigms on tool-use tasks, while requiring less than 10 of the synthetic data. Furthermore, in terms of ROI, a comprehensive metric integrating performance, data cost, and training efficiency we achieve a 1.46x gain compared to baselines. Code is available at https://github.com/yuki-younai/E3-TIR.

AI.tldr: E3-TIR是一种针对工具集成推理（TIR）的预热训练范式，通过动态整合专家前缀、专家引导和自主探索三种经验类型，解决现有训练范式在探索效率和数据成本方面的问题。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM工具集成推理训练范式存在显著限制：Zero-RL由于缺乏先验指导导致探索效率低下和模式退化，而SFT-then-RL则受限于高数据成本和低熵崩溃导致的能力瓶颈。
AI.method: 提出E3-TIR预热范式，将训练形式化为三种经验类型的动态整合：专家前缀、专家引导和自主探索。通过围绕专家"锚点"执行多样化分支探索，并采用混合策略优化机制，有效缓解分布偏移和共享前缀引起的优化冲突。
AI.result: 在工具使用任务上，E3-TIR相比传统范式实现了6%的性能提升，同时仅需不到10%的合成数据。在综合性能、数据成本和训练效率的ROI指标上，相比基线获得了1.46倍的增益。
AI.conclusion: E3-TIR通过动态整合专家指导和自主探索，有效平衡了探索多样性与训练效率，为LLM工具集成推理的早期训练阶段提供了有效的预热解决方案。

title: Revisiting Anisotropy in Language Transformers: The Geometry of Learning Dynamics
summary: Since their introduction, Transformer architectures have dominated Natural Language Processing (NLP). However, recent research has highlighted an inherent anisotropy phenomenon in these models, presenting a significant challenge to their geometric interpretation. Previous theoretical studies on this phenomenon are rarely grounded in the underlying representation geometry. In this paper, we extend them by deriving geometric arguments for how frequency-biased sampling attenuates curvature visibility and why training preferentially amplify tangent directions. Empirically, we then use concept-based mechanistic interpretability during training, rather than only post hoc, to fit activation-derived low-rank tangent proxies and test them against ordinary backpropagated true gradients. Across encoder-style and decoder-style language models, we find that these activation-derived directions capture both unusually large gradient energy and a substantially larger share of gradient anisotropy than matched-rank normal controls, providing strong empirical support for a tangent-aligned account of anisotropy.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究了Transformer模型中的各向异性现象，从几何角度解释了频率偏置采样如何减弱曲率可见性，以及训练为何优先放大切线方向，并通过概念机制可解释性方法提供了实证支持。
AI.motivation: Transformer架构在自然语言处理中占主导地位，但最近研究发现这些模型存在固有的各向异性现象，这对它们的几何解释构成了重大挑战。先前对该现象的理论研究很少基于底层表示几何，因此需要从几何角度深入理解这一现象。
AI.method: 论文首先从几何角度推导了频率偏置采样如何减弱曲率可见性以及训练为何优先放大切线方向的理论论证。然后使用基于概念的机制可解释性方法，在训练过程中（而非仅事后分析）拟合激活派生的低秩切线代理，并将其与普通反向传播的真实梯度进行对比测试。
AI.result: 在编码器风格和解码器风格的语言模型中，研究发现这些激活派生的方向不仅捕获了异常大的梯度能量，而且比匹配秩的正常控制组捕获了更大比例的梯度各向异性，为切线对齐的各向异性解释提供了强有力的实证支持。
AI.conclusion: 该研究通过几何论证和实证分析，为Transformer模型中的各向异性现象提供了基于切线对齐的解释框架，深化了对这些模型几何特性的理解，并为未来的模型解释和改进提供了理论基础。

title: R2G: A Multi-View Circuit Graph Benchmark Suite from RTL to GDSII
comment: Accepted as a poster by CVPR2026
summary: Graph neural networks (GNNs) are increasingly applied to physical design tasks such as congestion prediction and wirelength estimation, yet progress is hindered by inconsistent circuit representations and the absence of controlled evaluation protocols. We present R2G (RTL-to-GDSII), a multi-view circuit-graph benchmark suite that standardizes five stage-aware views with information parity (every view encodes the same attribute set, differing only in where features attach) over 30 open-source IP cores (up to $10^6$ nodes/edges). R2G provides an end-to-end DEF-to-graph pipeline spanning synthesis, placement, and routing stages, together with loaders, unified splits, domain metrics, and reproducible baselines. By decoupling representation choice from model choice, R2G isolates a confound that prior EDA and graph-ML benchmarks leave uncontrolled. In systematic studies with GINE, GAT, and ResGatedGCN, we find: (i) view choice dominates model choice, with Test R$^2$ varying by more than 0.3 across representations for a fixed GNN; (ii) node-centric views generalize best across both placement and routing; and (iii) decoder-head depth (3--4 layers) is the primary accuracy driver, turning divergent training into near-perfect predictions (R$^2$$>$0.99). Code and datasets are available at https://github.com/ShenShan123/R2G.

AI.tldr: R2G是一个多视图电路图基准套件，标准化了5个阶段感知的电路表示视图，用于评估GNN在物理设计任务中的性能，解决了现有基准中表示不一致和评估协议缺失的问题。
AI.motivation: 当前GNN在物理设计任务（如拥塞预测和线长估计）中的应用受到两个主要限制：1）电路表示不一致，不同研究使用不同的图表示方法；2）缺乏受控的评估协议，难以公平比较不同模型的性能。
AI.method: 提出了R2G基准套件，包含：1）5个阶段感知的多视图电路表示，确保信息对等（每个视图编码相同的属性集，仅在特征附着位置不同）；2）覆盖30个开源IP核心（最多10^6个节点/边）；3）提供从DEF到图的端到端流水线，涵盖综合、布局和布线阶段；4）包含加载器、统一划分、领域指标和可复现基线。
AI.result: 通过GINE、GAT和ResGatedGCN模型的系统研究发现：1）视图选择比模型选择更重要，固定GNN下测试R²变化超过0.3；2）节点中心视图在布局和布线任务中泛化能力最好；3）解码器头深度（3-4层）是主要精度驱动因素，能将发散训练转变为接近完美的预测（R²>0.99）。
AI.conclusion: R2G基准套件通过解耦表示选择与模型选择，解决了EDA和图机器学习基准中未受控制的混淆因素。研究表明电路表示选择对GNN性能有决定性影响，为未来研究提供了标准化评估框架。

title: MT-OSC: Path for LLMs that Get Lost in Multi-Turn Conversation
summary: Large language models (LLMs) suffer significant performance degradation when user instructions and context are distributed over multiple conversational turns, yet multi-turn (MT) interactions dominate chat interfaces. The routine approach of appending full chat history to prompts rapidly exhausts context windows, leading to increased latency, higher computational costs, and diminishing returns as conversations extend. We introduce MT-OSC, a One-off Sequential Condensation framework that efficiently and automatically condenses chat history in the background without disrupting the user experience. MT-OSC employs a Condenser Agent that uses a few-shot inference-based Condenser and a lightweight Decider to selectively retain essential information, reducing token counts by up to 72% in 10-turn dialogues. Evaluated across 13 state-of-the-art LLMs and diverse multi-turn benchmarks, MT-OSC consistently narrows the multi-turn performance gap - yielding improved or preserved accuracy across datasets while remaining robust to distractors and irrelevant turns. Our results establish MT-OSC as a scalable solution for multi-turn chats, enabling richer context within constrained input spaces, reducing latency and operational cost, while balancing performance.

AI.tldr: MT-OSC框架通过一次性顺序压缩技术，自动高效地压缩多轮对话历史，减少72%的token使用，在多轮对话中提升LLM性能表现。
AI.motivation: 大型语言模型在多轮对话中性能显著下降，而将完整聊天历史附加到提示中的常规方法会快速耗尽上下文窗口，导致延迟增加、计算成本上升，且随着对话延长收益递减。
AI.method: 引入MT-OSC（一次性顺序压缩框架），使用包含少量样本推理的压缩器和轻量级决策器的压缩代理，在后台自动压缩聊天历史而不中断用户体验，选择性保留关键信息。
AI.result: 在10轮对话中token数量减少高达72%，在13个最先进的LLM和多样多轮基准测试中，MT-OSC持续缩小多轮性能差距，在数据集上保持或提高准确性，同时对干扰项和不相关轮次保持鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: MT-OSC作为多轮聊天的可扩展解决方案，能够在受限输入空间中实现更丰富的上下文，降低延迟和运营成本，同时平衡性能表现。

title: Strategic Algorithmic Monoculture:Experimental Evidence from Coordination Games
summary: AI agents increasingly operate in multi-agent environments where outcomes depend on coordination. We distinguish primary algorithmic monoculture -- baseline action similarity -- from strategic algorithmic monoculture, whereby agents adjust similarity in response to incentives. We implement a simple experimental design that cleanly separates these forces, and deploy it on human and large language model (LLM) subjects. LLMs exhibit high levels of baseline similarity (primary monoculture) and, like humans, they regulate it in response to coordination incentives (strategic monoculture). While LLMs coordinate extremely well on similar actions, they lag behind humans in sustaining heterogeneity when divergence is rewarded.

AI.tldr: 论文研究了AI代理在多智能体环境中的算法单一化现象，区分了基础行为相似性（主要单一化）和策略性算法单一化（根据激励调整相似性），并通过实验对比了人类和LLM在这方面的表现。
AI.motivation: 随着AI代理在多智能体环境中越来越普遍，协调结果变得至关重要。需要理解算法单一化现象，特别是区分基础行为相似性和策略性调整相似性，以评估AI代理在协调环境中的表现。
AI.method: 设计了一个简单的实验框架，清晰分离主要算法单一化（基础行为相似性）和策略性算法单一化（根据激励调整相似性）。在人类和大型语言模型（LLM）受试者上部署该实验设计，比较两者的表现差异。
AI.result: LLM表现出高水平的基础行为相似性（主要单一化），并且像人类一样能够根据协调激励调节相似性（策略性单一化）。LLM在相似行动上协调能力极强，但在奖励差异化的情境中，维持异质性的能力落后于人类。
AI.conclusion: 研究揭示了AI代理在多智能体协调中的双重特性：既表现出强烈的算法单一化倾向，又具备策略性调整能力。虽然LLM在协调相似行动方面表现出色，但在需要维持多样性的情境中仍有改进空间，这对设计更灵活的AI协调系统具有重要意义。

title: Lessons Without Borders? Evaluating Cultural Alignment of LLMs Using Multilingual Story Moral Generation
summary: Stories are key to transmitting values across cultures, but their interpretation varies across linguistic and cultural contexts. Thus, we introduce multilingual story moral generation as a novel culturally grounded evaluation task. Using a new dataset of human-written story morals collected across 14 language-culture pairs, we compare model outputs with human interpretations via semantic similarity, a human preference survey, and value categorization. We show that frontier models such as GPT-4o and Gemini generate story morals that are semantically similar to human responses and preferred by human evaluators. However, their outputs exhibit markedly less cross-linguistic variation and concentrate on a narrower set of widely shared values. These findings suggest that while contemporary models can approximate central tendencies of human moral interpretation, they struggle to reproduce the diversity that characterizes human narrative understanding. By framing narrative interpretation as an evaluative task, this work introduces a new approach to studying cultural alignment in language models beyond static benchmarks or knowledge-based tests.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出多语言故事寓意生成作为文化基础评估任务，通过14种语言-文化对的数据集评估模型，发现前沿模型能生成语义相似且受人类偏好的寓意，但缺乏人类解释的多样性。
AI.motivation: 故事是跨文化传递价值观的关键，但其解释因语言文化背景而异。现有评估方法（静态基准或知识测试）不足以评估语言模型的文化对齐能力，需要一种基于叙事理解的文化基础评估任务。
AI.method: 1) 创建包含14种语言-文化对的人类撰写故事寓意数据集；2) 通过语义相似度、人类偏好调查和价值观分类三种方法比较模型输出与人类解释；3) 评估GPT-4o、Gemini等前沿模型的表现。
AI.result: 前沿模型能生成语义上与人类响应相似且受人类评估者偏好的故事寓意。但模型输出显示：1) 跨语言变异显著减少；2) 集中在更狭窄的广泛共享价值观集合上。模型能近似人类道德解释的中心趋势，但无法复现人类叙事理解的多样性。
AI.conclusion: 通过将叙事解释构建为评估任务，本研究为研究语言模型的文化对齐提供了超越静态基准的新方法。当代模型虽然能捕捉人类道德解释的共性，但缺乏捕捉文化多样性的能力，这对跨文化应用具有重要意义。

title: CatalogStitch: Dimension-Aware and Occlusion-Preserving Object Compositing for Catalog Image Generation
comment: CVPR 2026 HiGen Workshop. Project page, https://catalogstitch.github.io
summary: Generative object compositing methods have shown remarkable ability to seamlessly insert objects into scenes. However, when applied to real-world catalog image generation, these methods require tedious manual intervention: users must carefully adjust masks when product dimensions differ, and painstakingly restore occluded elements post-generation. We present CatalogStitch, a set of model-agnostic techniques that automate these corrections, enabling user-friendly content creation. Our dimension-aware mask computation algorithm automatically adapts the target region to accommodate products with different dimensions; users simply provide a product image and background, without manual mask adjustments. Our occlusion-aware hybrid restoration method guarantees pixel-perfect preservation of occluding elements, eliminating post-editing workflows. We additionally introduce CatalogStitch-Eval, a 58-example benchmark covering aspect-ratio mismatch and occlusion-heavy catalog scenarios, together with supplementary PDF and HTML viewers. We evaluate our techniques with three state-of-the-art compositing models (ObjectStitch, OmniPaint, and InsertAnything), demonstrating consistent improvements across diverse catalog scenarios. By reducing manual intervention and automating tedious corrections, our approach transforms generative compositing into a practical, human-friendly tool for production catalog workflows.

AI.tldr: CatalogStitch是一套模型无关的技术，通过维度感知掩码计算和遮挡感知混合修复，自动化产品目录图像生成中的繁琐手动校正，使生成式合成技术更实用。
AI.motivation: 现有生成式对象合成方法在应用于真实世界产品目录图像生成时，需要大量手动干预：用户必须根据产品尺寸差异仔细调整掩码，并在生成后费力恢复被遮挡元素。
AI.method: 提出CatalogStitch技术集：1) 维度感知掩码计算算法自动调整目标区域以适应不同尺寸产品；2) 遮挡感知混合修复方法保证像素级完美保留遮挡元素；3) 创建CatalogStitch-Eval基准数据集评估效果。
AI.result: 在三种最先进的合成模型（ObjectStitch、OmniPaint、InsertAnything）上评估，在多样化产品目录场景中均表现出持续改进，显著减少了手动干预需求。
AI.conclusion: 通过减少手动干预和自动化繁琐校正，CatalogStitch将生成式合成转变为实用的、人性化的生产目录工作流程工具。

title: DeFakeQ: Enabling Real-Time Deepfake Detection on Edge Devices via Adaptive Bidirectional Quantization
summary: Deepfake detection has become a fundamental component of modern media forensics. Despite significant progress in detection accuracy, most existing methods remain computationally intensive and parameter-heavy, limiting their deployment on resource-constrained edge devices that require real-time, on-site inference. This limitation is particularly critical in an era where mobile devices are extensively used for media-centric applications, including online payments, virtual meetings, and social networking. Meanwhile, due to the unique requirement of capturing extremely subtle forgery artifacts for deepfake detection, state-of-the-art quantization techniques usually underperform for such a challenging task. These fine-grained cues are highly sensitive to model compression and can be easily degraded during quantization, leading to noticeable performance drops. This challenge highlights the need for quantization strategies specifically designed to preserve the discriminative features essential for reliable deepfake detection. To address this gap, we propose DefakeQ, the first quantization framework tailored for deepfake detectors, enabling real-time deployment on edge devices. Our approach introduces a novel adaptive bidirectional compression strategy that simultaneously leverages feature correlations and eliminates redundancy, achieving an effective balance between model compactness and detection performance. Extensive experiments across five benchmark datasets and eleven state-of-the-art backbone detectors demonstrate that DeFakeQ consistently surpasses existing quantization and model compression baselines. Furthermore, we deploy DefakeQ on mobile devices in real-world scenarios, demonstrating its capability for real-time deepfake detection and its practical applicability in edge environments.

AI.tldr: DefakeQ是首个专为深度伪造检测器设计的量化框架，通过自适应双向压缩策略在边缘设备上实现实时检测，在保持检测性能的同时显著减少计算开销。
AI.motivation: 现有深度伪造检测方法计算密集、参数量大，难以部署到资源受限的边缘设备上实现实时检测。同时，由于深度伪造检测需要捕捉极其细微的伪造痕迹，现有的量化技术通常会显著降低检测性能，因为这些细微特征对模型压缩非常敏感。
AI.method: 提出DefakeQ量化框架，采用新颖的自适应双向压缩策略，同时利用特征相关性并消除冗余，在模型紧凑性和检测性能之间实现有效平衡。
AI.result: 在五个基准数据集和十一个最先进的骨干检测器上进行广泛实验，DefakeQ始终优于现有的量化和模型压缩基线方法。在实际移动设备上部署验证了其在真实场景中实时深度伪造检测的能力。
AI.conclusion: DefakeQ是首个专门为深度伪造检测设计的量化框架，成功解决了边缘设备上实时深度伪造检测的部署挑战，在保持检测性能的同时显著降低了计算需求，具有重要的实际应用价值。

title: Cross-Lingual Attention Distillation with Personality-Informed Generative Augmentation for Multilingual Personality Recognition
comment: IEEE Transactions on Cognitive and Developmental Systems (2026)
summary: While significant work has been done on personality recognition, the lack of multilingual datasets remains an unresolved challenge. To address this, we propose ADAM (Cross-Lingual (A)ttention (D)istillation with Personality-Guided Generative (A)ugmentation for (M)ultilingual Personality Recognition), a state-of-the-art approach designed to advance multilingual personality recognition. Our approach leverages an existing English-language personality dataset as the primary source and employs a large language model (LLM) for translationbased augmentation, enhanced by Personality-Informed Generative Augmentation (PIGA), to generate high-quality training data in multiple languages, including Japanese, Chinese, Malay, and French. We provide a thorough analysis to justify the effectiveness of these augmentation techniques. Building on these advancements, ADAM integrates Cross-Lingual Attention Distillation (CLAD) to train a model capable of understanding and recognizing personality traits across languages, bridging linguistic and cultural gaps in personality analysis. This research presents a thorough evaluation of the proposed augmentation method, incorporating an ablation study on recognition performance to ensure fair comparisons and robust validation. Overall, with PIGA augmentation, the findings demonstrate that CLAD significantly outperforms the standard BCE across all languages and personality traits, achieving notable improvements in average BA scores - 0.6332 (+0.0573) on the Essays dataset and 0.7448 (+0.0968) on the Kaggle dataset. The CLAD-trained model also demonstrated strong generalizability and achieved benchmark performance comparable to current leading encoder models. The model weight, dataset, and algorithm repository are available at https://research.jingjietan.com/?q=ADAM.

AI.tldr: ADAM提出了一种跨语言注意力蒸馏与人格引导生成增强的多语言人格识别方法，通过LLM翻译增强和人格信息生成增强创建多语言训练数据，显著提升了跨语言人格识别性能。
AI.motivation: 当前人格识别研究面临多语言数据集缺乏的挑战，现有研究主要集中在英语，限制了跨语言和文化的人格分析能力。
AI.method: ADAM采用人格引导生成增强（PIGA）利用大语言模型进行翻译增强，生成日语、中文、马来语和法语的高质量训练数据，并结合跨语言注意力蒸馏（CLAD）训练跨语言人格识别模型。
AI.result: PIGA增强后，CLAD在所有语言和人格特质上都显著优于标准BCE，在Essays数据集上平均BA得分0.6332（提升0.0573），在Kaggle数据集上0.7448（提升0.0968），模型表现出良好的泛化能力和与当前领先编码器模型相当的基准性能。
AI.conclusion: ADAM通过创新的数据增强和跨语言蒸馏方法有效解决了多语言人格识别中的数据稀缺问题，为跨语言和文化的人格分析提供了有效解决方案。

title: BIAS: A Biologically Inspired Algorithm for Video Saliency Detection
summary: We present BIAS, a fast, biologically inspired model for dynamic visual saliency detection in continuous video streams. Building on the Itti--Koch framework, BIAS incorporates a retina-inspired motion detector to extract temporal features, enabling the generation of saliency maps that integrate both static and motion information. Foci of attention (FOAs) are identified using a greedy multi-Gaussian peak-fitting algorithm that balances winner-take-all competition with information maximization. BIAS detects salient regions with millisecond-scale latency and outperforms heuristic-based approaches and several deep-learning models on the DHF1K dataset, particularly in videos dominated by bottom-up attention. Applied to traffic accident analysis, BIAS demonstrates strong real-world utility, achieving state-of-the-art performance in cause-effect recognition and anticipating accidents up to 0.72 seconds before manual annotation with reliable accuracy. Overall, BIAS bridges biological plausibility and computational efficiency to achieve interpretable, high-speed dynamic saliency detection.

AI.tldr: BIAS是一个快速、受生物学启发的动态视觉显著性检测模型，结合静态和运动信息，在视频流中实现毫秒级延迟的显著性检测，在交通事故分析中表现出色。
AI.motivation: 开发一个既具有生物学合理性又计算高效的动态视觉显著性检测模型，能够快速处理连续视频流，特别关注现实世界应用如交通事故分析。
AI.method: 基于Itti-Koch框架，结合视网膜启发的运动检测器提取时间特征，使用贪婪多高斯峰值拟合算法识别注意力焦点，平衡赢家通吃竞争与信息最大化。
AI.result: 在DHF1K数据集上优于启发式方法和多个深度学习模型，特别是在自下而上注意力主导的视频中；在交通事故分析中实现最先进的因果识别性能，能提前0.72秒预测事故。
AI.conclusion: BIAS成功桥接了生物学合理性和计算效率，实现了可解释、高速的动态显著性检测，在现实世界应用中表现出强大的实用性。

title: GRASP: Grounded CoT Reasoning with Dual-Stage Optimization for Multimodal Sarcasm Target Identification
summary: Moving beyond the traditional binary classification paradigm of Multimodal Sarcasm Detection, Multimodal Sarcasm Target Identification (MSTI) presents a more formidable challenge, requiring precise localization of fine-grained targets such as textual phrases and visual regions. Existing approaches predominantly rely on implicit cross-modal alignment, offering limited interpretability and suboptimal fine-grained localization. To address these limitations, we propose GRASP, Grounded Chain-of-Thought ReAsoning with Dual-Stage Optimization for Multimodal Sarcasm Prediction and Target Identification, a framework that integrates visual grounding with explicit Chain-of-Thought (CoT) reasoning to move beyond black-box MSTI. Specifically, we curate MSTI-MAX, a refined dataset that mitigates class imbalance and enriches multimodal sarcasm cues. We introduce Grounded CoT reasoning, which explicitly anchors sarcasm-related visual regions within the reasoning trajectory and prompts the model to articulate rationales before predicting the final classification labels and sarcasm targets. Furthermore, we employ a dual-stage outcome-supervised joint optimization strategy: Supervised Fine-Tuning with a coordinate-aware weighted loss, followed by Fine-Grained Target Policy Optimization. Extensive experiments demonstrate that GRASP outperforms existing baselines in fine-grained sarcasm target identification across modalities, and an LLM-as-a-Judge evaluation quantitatively measures the quality of internal reasoning chains. Our dataset and source code will be released on GitHub.

AI.tldr: GRASP框架通过视觉定位和显式思维链推理解决多模态讽刺目标识别问题，超越传统黑盒方法，在细粒度目标定位上表现优异。
AI.motivation: 传统多模态讽刺检测局限于二元分类，而多模态讽刺目标识别(MSTI)需要精确定位细粒度目标（如文本短语和视觉区域）。现有方法主要依赖隐式跨模态对齐，可解释性有限且细粒度定位效果不佳。
AI.method: 提出GRASP框架：1）构建MSTI-MAX数据集，缓解类别不平衡并丰富多模态讽刺线索；2）引入基于视觉定位的思维链推理，显式锚定讽刺相关视觉区域并让模型在预测前阐述推理过程；3）采用双阶段优化策略：坐标感知加权损失的监督微调，后接细粒度目标策略优化。
AI.result: 实验表明GRASP在多模态细粒度讽刺目标识别上优于现有基线，LLM-as-a-Judge评估定量测量了内部推理链的质量。
AI.conclusion: GRASP通过显式推理和视觉定位显著提升了多模态讽刺目标识别的性能和可解释性，为超越黑盒MSTI提供了有效框架。

title: Harnessing Weak Pair Uncertainty for Text-based Person Search
summary: In this paper, we study the text-based person search, which is to retrieve the person of interest via natural language description. Prevailing methods usually focus on the strict one-to-one correspondence pair matching between the visual and textual modality, such as contrastive learning. However, such a paradigm unintentionally disregards the weak positive image-text pairs, which are of the same person but the text descriptions are annotated from different views (cameras). To take full use of weak positives, we introduce an uncertainty-aware method to explicitly estimate image-text pair uncertainty, and incorporate the uncertainty into the optimization procedure in a smooth manner. Specifically, our method contains two modules: uncertainty estimation and uncertainty regularization. (1) Uncertainty estimation is to obtain the relative confidence on the given positive pairs; (2) Based on the predicted uncertainty, we propose the uncertainty regularization to adaptively adjust loss weight. Additionally, we introduce a group-wise image-text matching loss to further facilitate the representation space among the weak pairs. Compared with existing methods, the proposed method explicitly prevents the model from pushing away potentially weak positive candidates. Extensive experiments on three widely-used datasets, .e.g, CUHK-PEDES, RSTPReid and ICFG-PEDES, verify the mAP improvement of our method against existing competitive methods +3.06%, +3.55% and +6.94%, respectively.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于不确定性的文本行人搜索方法，通过显式估计图像-文本对的不确定性并融入优化过程，有效利用弱正样本对提升检索性能。
AI.motivation: 现有文本行人搜索方法通常关注视觉和文本模态之间严格的一对一对应匹配，但无意中忽略了弱正样本对（同一行人但文本描述来自不同视角）。这些弱正样本对包含有价值的信息，但现有方法未能充分利用。
AI.method: 提出包含两个模块的不确定性感知方法：1）不确定性估计模块获取给定正样本对的相对置信度；2）基于预测的不确定性，提出不确定性正则化来自适应调整损失权重。此外，引入分组图像-文本匹配损失来进一步促进弱对之间的表示空间。
AI.result: 在三个广泛使用的数据集（CUHK-PEDES、RSTPReid和ICFG-PEDES）上进行了大量实验，相比现有竞争方法，mAP分别提升了3.06%、3.55%和6.94%。
AI.conclusion: 该方法通过显式估计图像-文本对不确定性并融入优化过程，有效防止模型将潜在弱正样本推开，显著提升了文本行人搜索的性能。

title: NCL-BU at SemEval-2026 Task 3: Fine-tuning XLM-RoBERTa for Multilingual Dimensional Sentiment Regression
summary: Dimensional Aspect-Based Sentiment Analysis (DimABSA) extends traditional ABSA from categorical polarity labels to continuous valence-arousal (VA) regression. This paper describes a system developed for Track A - Subtask 1 (Dimensional Aspect Sentiment Regression), aiming to predict real-valued VA scores in the [1, 9] range for each given aspect in a text. A fine-tuning approach based on XLM-RoBERTa-base is adopted, constructing the input as [CLS] T [SEP] a_i [SEP] and training dual regression heads with sigmoid-scaled outputs for valence and arousal prediction. Separate models are trained for each language-domain combination (English and Chinese across restaurant, laptop, and finance domains), and training and development sets are merged for final test predictions. In development experiments, the fine-tuning approach is compared against several large language models including GPT-5.2, LLaMA-3-70B, LLaMA-3.3-70B, and LLaMA-4-Maverick under a few-shot prompting setting, demonstrating that task-specific fine-tuning substantially and consistently outperforms these LLM-based methods across all evaluation datasets. The code is publicly available at https://github.com/tongwu17/SemEval-2026-Task3-Track-A.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一种基于XLM-RoBERTa-base微调的维度方面情感分析系统，用于预测文本中每个方面的连续效价-唤醒值，相比少样本提示的大型语言模型有显著优势。
AI.motivation: 传统方面情感分析使用分类极性标签，而维度方面情感分析扩展到连续的效价-唤醒回归，能提供更丰富的情感信息。需要开发有效的系统来预测文本中每个方面的连续情感值。
AI.method: 采用基于XLM-RoBERTa-base的微调方法，输入格式为[CLS] T [SEP] a_i [SEP]，为效价和唤醒预测训练双回归头，使用sigmoid缩放输出到[1,9]范围。为每种语言-领域组合训练独立模型，合并训练集和开发集进行最终测试预测。
AI.result: 在开发实验中，与GPT-5.2、LLaMA-3-70B、LLaMA-3.3-70B和LLaMA-4-Maverick等大型语言模型的少样本提示方法相比，任务特定的微调方法在所有评估数据集上都显著且一致地表现更优。
AI.conclusion: 针对维度方面情感回归任务，基于预训练模型的微调方法优于大型语言模型的少样本提示方法，证明了任务特定训练的重要性。代码已公开可用。

title: Precise Shield: Explaining and Aligning VLLM Safety via Neuron-Level Guidance
summary: In real-world deployments, Vision-Language Large Models (VLLMs) face critical challenges from multilingual and multimodal composite attacks: harmful images paired with low-resource language texts can easily bypass defenses designed for high-resource language scenarios, exposing structural blind spots in current cross-lingual and cross-modal safety methods. This raises a mechanistic question: where is safety capability instantiated within the model, and how is it distributed across languages and modalities? Prior studies on pure-text LLMs have identified cross-lingual shared safety neurons, suggesting that safety may be governed by a small subset of critical neurons. Leveraging this insight, we propose Precise Shield, a two-stage framework that first identifies safety neurons by contrasting activation patterns between harmful and benign inputs, and then constrains parameter updates strictly within this subspace via gradient masking with affecting fewer than 0.03% of parameters. This strategy substantially improves safety while preserving multilingual and multimodal generalization. Further analysis reveals a moderate overlap of safety neurons across languages and modalities, enabling zero-shot cross-lingual and cross-modal transfer of safety capabilities, and offering a new direction for neuron-level, transfer-based safety enhancement.

AI.tldr: Precise Shield是一个两阶段框架，通过识别安全神经元并限制参数更新来增强视觉语言大模型的多语言多模态安全性，仅影响不到0.03%的参数。
AI.motivation: 现实部署中，视觉语言大模型面临多语言多模态复合攻击的挑战：有害图像与低资源语言文本的组合可以绕过针对高资源语言场景设计的防御，暴露了当前跨语言跨模态安全方法的结构性盲点。
AI.method: 提出Precise Shield两阶段框架：1) 通过对比有害和良性输入的激活模式识别安全神经元；2) 通过梯度掩码严格限制参数更新在该子空间内，影响不到0.03%的参数。
AI.result: 该方法显著提高了安全性，同时保持了多语言和多模态的泛化能力。分析显示安全神经元在语言和模态间存在适度重叠，实现了零样本跨语言跨模态安全能力转移。
AI.conclusion: Precise Shield为基于神经元级别的、可转移的安全增强提供了新方向，通过精确控制少量关键神经元有效防御多语言多模态复合攻击。

title: MuTSE: A Human-in-the-Loop Multi-use Text Simplification Evaluator
summary: As Large Language Models (LLMs) become increasingly prevalent in text simplification, systematically evaluating their outputs across diverse prompting strategies and architectures remains a critical methodological challenge in both NLP research and Intelligent Tutoring Systems (ITS). Developing robust prompts is often hindered by the absence of structured, visual frameworks for comparative text analysis. While researchers typically rely on static computational scripts, educators are constrained to standard conversational interfaces -- neither paradigm supports systematic multi-dimensional evaluation of prompt-model permutations. To address these limitations, we introduce \textbf{MuTSE}\footnote{The project code and the demo have been made available for peer review at the following anonymized URL. https://osf.io/njs43/overview?view_only=4b4655789f484110a942ebb7788cdf2a, an interactive human-in-the-loop web application designed to streamline the evaluation of LLM-generated text simplifications across arbitrary CEFR proficiency targets. The system supports concurrent execution of $P \times M$ prompt-model permutations, generating a comprehensive comparison matrix in real-time. By integrating a novel tiered semantic alignment engine augmented with a linearity bias heuristic ($λ$), MuTSE visually maps source sentences to their simplified counterparts, reducing the cognitive load associated with qualitative analysis and enabling reproducible, structured annotation for downstream NLP dataset construction.

AI.tldr: MuTSE是一个交互式人机协同Web应用，用于系统评估LLM在不同提示策略和架构下的文本简化输出，支持实时比较P×M的提示-模型组合，通过语义对齐引擎和线性偏差启发式方法可视化简化效果。
AI.motivation: 当前评估LLM文本简化效果存在方法学挑战：研究人员依赖静态计算脚本，教育工作者受限于标准对话界面，两者都无法系统评估不同提示策略和模型架构的组合效果，缺乏结构化、可视化的比较框架。
AI.method: 开发MuTSE交互式Web应用，支持并发执行P×M提示-模型组合，生成实时比较矩阵；集成分层语义对齐引擎，采用线性偏差启发式(λ)方法，可视化映射源句子到简化版本，降低定性分析的认知负荷。
AI.result: MuTSE系统能够实时生成全面的比较矩阵，通过可视化映射帮助用户直观评估不同提示-模型组合的文本简化效果，为下游NLP数据集构建提供可重复、结构化的标注框架。
AI.conclusion: MuTSE解决了LLM文本简化评估中的方法论挑战，提供了一个系统化、可视化的人机协同评估平台，支持多维度比较不同提示策略和模型架构，有助于提高评估效率和可重复性。

title: HM-Bench: A Comprehensive Benchmark for Multimodal Large Language Models in Hyperspectral Remote Sensing
summary: While multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have made significant strides in natural image understanding, their ability to perceive and reason over hyperspectral image (HSI) remains underexplored, which is a vital modality in remote sensing. The high dimensionality and intricate spectral-spatial properties of HSI pose unique challenges for models primarily trained on RGB data.To address this gap, we introduce Hyperspectral Multimodal Benchmark (HM-Bench), the first benchmark designed specifically to evaluate MLLMs in HSI understanding. We curate a large-scale dataset of 19,337 question-answer pairs across 13 task categories, ranging from basic perception to spectral reasoning. Given that existing MLLMs are not equipped to process raw hyperspectral cubes natively, we propose a dual-modality evaluation framework that transforms HSI data into two complementary representations: PCA-based composite images and structured textual reports. This approach facilitates a systematic comparison of different representation for model performance. Extensive evaluations on 18 representative MLLMs reveal significant difficulties in handling complex spatial-spectral reasoning tasks. Furthermore, our results demonstrate that visual inputs generally outperform textual inputs, highlighting the importance of grounding in spectral-spatial evidence for effective HSI understanding. Dataset and appendix can be accessed at https://github.com/HuoRiLi-Yu/HM-Bench.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了首个专门评估多模态大语言模型在遥感高光谱图像理解能力的基准HM-Bench，包含19,337个问答对，涵盖13个任务类别，通过双模态评估框架揭示现有模型在复杂光谱空间推理任务上的显著困难。
AI.motivation: 多模态大语言模型在自然图像理解方面取得了显著进展，但在遥感高光谱图像理解方面的能力尚未充分探索。高光谱图像的高维度和复杂的光谱空间特性对主要基于RGB数据训练的模型构成了独特挑战。
AI.method: 提出了HM-Bench基准，包含19,337个问答对，涵盖13个任务类别。针对现有MLLM无法原生处理原始高光谱立方体的问题，提出了双模态评估框架，将HSI数据转换为两种互补表示：基于PCA的合成图像和结构化文本报告。
AI.result: 对18个代表性MLLM的广泛评估显示，现有模型在处理复杂空间-光谱推理任务方面存在显著困难。结果还表明，视觉输入通常优于文本输入，强调了基于光谱空间证据进行接地的重要性。
AI.conclusion: HM-Bench是首个专门评估MLLM在高光谱图像理解能力的基准，揭示了现有模型在该领域的局限性，并强调了视觉表示在遥感高光谱图像理解中的重要性。

title: TaxPraBen: A Scalable Benchmark for Structured Evaluation of LLMs in Chinese Real-World Tax Practice
summary: While Large Language Models (LLMs) excel in various general domains, they exhibit notable gaps in the highly specialized, knowledge-intensive, and legally regulated Chinese tax domain. Consequently, while tax-related benchmarks are gaining attention, many focus on isolated NLP tasks, neglecting real-world practical capabilities. To address this issue, we introduce TaxPraBen, the first dedicated benchmark for Chinese taxation practice. It combines 10 traditional application tasks, along with 3 pioneering real-world scenarios: tax risk prevention, tax inspection analysis, and tax strategy planning, sourced from 14 datasets totaling 7.3K instances. TaxPraBen features a scalable structured evaluation paradigm designed through process of "structured parsing-field alignment extraction-numerical and textual matching", enabling end-to-end tax practice assessment while being extensible to other domains. We evaluate 19 LLMs based on Bloom's taxonomy. The results indicate significant performance disparities: all closed-source large-parameter LLMs excel, and Chinese LLMs like Qwen2.5 generally exceed multilingual LLMs, while the YaYi2 LLM, fine-tuned with some tax data, shows only limited improvement. TaxPraBen serves as a vital resource for advancing evaluations of LLMs in practical applications.

AI.tldr: TaxPraBen是首个专注于中国税务实践领域的基准测试，包含10个传统应用任务和3个真实场景，通过结构化评估范式评估19个LLM在税务领域的实践能力。
AI.motivation: 大型语言模型在通用领域表现出色，但在高度专业化、知识密集且受法律监管的中国税务领域存在显著差距。现有税务相关基准多关注孤立NLP任务，忽视了真实世界的实践能力。
AI.method: 引入TaxPraBen基准，包含10个传统应用任务和3个创新真实场景（税务风险防范、税务稽查分析、税务策略规划），源自14个数据集共7.3K实例。采用可扩展的结构化评估范式，通过"结构化解析-字段对齐提取-数值和文本匹配"流程实现端到端税务实践评估。
AI.result: 评估了19个LLM，结果显示显著性能差异：所有闭源大参数LLM表现优异；中文LLM如Qwen2.5普遍优于多语言LLM；而使用部分税务数据微调的YaYi2 LLM仅显示有限改进。
AI.conclusion: TaxPraBen作为重要资源，有助于推进LLM在实际应用中的评估，特别是在高度专业化的税务实践领域。

title: Adaptive Dual Residual U-Net with Attention Gate and Multiscale Spatial Attention Mechanisms (ADRUwAMS)
summary: Glioma is a harmful brain tumor that requires early detection to ensure better health results. Early detection of this tumor is key for effective treatment and requires an automated segmentation process. However, it is a challenging task to find tumors due to tumor characteristics like location and size. A reliable method to accurately separate tumor zones from healthy tissues is deep learning models, which have shown promising results over the last few years. In this research, an Adaptive Dual Residual U-Net with Attention Gate and Multiscale Spatial Attention Mechanisms (ADRUwAMS) is introduced. This model is an innovative combination of adaptive dual residual networks, attention mechanisms, and multiscale spatial attention. The dual adaptive residual network architecture captures high-level semantic and intricate low-level details from brain images, ensuring precise segmentation of different tumor parts, types, and hard regions. The attention gates use gating and input signals to compute attention coefficients for the input features, and multiscale spatial attention generates scaled attention maps and combines these features to hold the most significant information about the brain tumor. We trained the model for 200 epochs using the ReLU activation function on BraTS 2020 and BraTS 2019 datasets. These improvements resulted in high accuracy for tumor detection and segmentation on BraTS 2020, achieving dice scores of 0.9229 for the whole tumor, 0.8432 for the tumor core, and 0.8004 for the enhancing tumor.

AI.tldr: 提出ADRUwAMS模型用于脑胶质瘤自动分割，结合自适应双残差网络、注意力门和多尺度空间注意力机制，在BraTS数据集上取得优异分割性能
AI.motivation: 脑胶质瘤是一种有害的脑肿瘤，早期检测对治疗效果至关重要。由于肿瘤位置、大小等特性，自动分割具有挑战性。深度学习模型在肿瘤分割中显示出良好前景，需要更精确的方法来区分肿瘤区域与健康组织。
AI.method: 提出ADRUwAMS模型，结合自适应双残差网络、注意力门和多尺度空间注意力机制。双自适应残差网络架构捕获脑图像中的高级语义和复杂低级细节；注意力门使用门控和输入信号计算注意力系数；多尺度空间注意力生成缩放注意力图并组合特征以保留肿瘤关键信息。使用ReLU激活函数，在BraTS 2020和2019数据集上训练200个epoch。
AI.result: 在BraTS 2020数据集上获得优异分割结果：全肿瘤Dice分数0.9229，肿瘤核心0.8432，增强肿瘤0.8004。模型能够精确分割不同肿瘤部分、类型和困难区域。
AI.conclusion: ADRUwAMS模型通过创新的架构组合，在脑胶质瘤分割任务中表现出高精度，为早期肿瘤检测提供了有效的自动化解决方案。

title: MAB-DQA: Addressing Query Aspect Importance in Document Question Answering with Multi-Armed Bandits
comment: Accepted by ACL 2026. 19 pages, 9 figures, 6 tables
summary: Document Question Answering (DQA) involves generating answers from a document based on a user's query, representing a key task in document understanding. This task requires interpreting visual layouts, which has prompted recent studies to adopt multimodal Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) that processes page images for answer generation. However, in multimodal RAG, visual DQA struggles to utilize a large number of images effectively, as the retrieval stage often retains only a few candidate pages (e.g., Top-4), causing informative but less visually salient content to be overlooked in favor of common yet low-information pages. To address this issue, we propose a Multi-Armed Bandit-based DQA framework (MAB-DQA) to explicitly model the varying importance of multiple implicit aspects in a query. Specifically, MAB-DQA decomposes a query into aspect-aware subqueries and retrieves an aspect-specific candidate set for each. It treats each subquery as an arm and uses preliminary reasoning results from a small number of representative pages as reward signals to estimate aspect utility. Guided by an exploration-exploitation policy, MAB-DQA dynamically reallocates retrieval budgets toward high-value aspects. With the most informative pages and their correlations, MAB-DQA generates the expected results. On four benchmarks, MAB-DQA shows an average improvement of 5%-18% over the state-of-the-art method, consistently enhancing document understanding. Code at https://github.com/ElephantOH/MAB-DQA.

AI.tldr: MAB-DQA是一个基于多臂老虎机的文档问答框架，通过将查询分解为多个方面感知的子查询，动态分配检索预算，有效利用文档中的多个页面图像，解决了传统多模态RAG方法因只保留少数候选页面而忽略重要信息的问题。
AI.motivation: 当前多模态检索增强生成(RAG)方法在文档问答中存在局限性：检索阶段通常只保留少数候选页面（如Top-4），导致信息丰富但视觉显著性较低的内容被忽略，而常见但信息量低的页面被优先选择。需要一种能有效利用大量文档图像的方法。
AI.method: 提出MAB-DQA框架：1）将查询分解为方面感知的子查询；2）为每个子查询检索方面特定的候选集；3）将每个子查询视为老虎机的一个臂，使用少量代表性页面的初步推理结果作为奖励信号来估计方面效用；4）通过探索-利用策略动态重新分配检索预算到高价值方面；5）利用最具信息量的页面及其相关性生成最终答案。
AI.result: 在四个基准测试上，MAB-DQA相比最先进方法平均提升了5%-18%，显著增强了文档理解能力。
AI.conclusion: MAB-DQA通过多臂老虎机框架有效建模查询中多个隐含方面的重要性变化，动态分配检索资源，解决了多模态RAG中视觉文档问答的局限性，显著提升了文档理解性能。

title: GeoMMBench and GeoMMAgent: Toward Expert-Level Multimodal Intelligence in Geoscience and Remote Sensing
summary: Recent advances in multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have accelerated progress in domain-oriented AI, yet their development in geoscience and remote sensing (RS) remains constrained by distinctive challenges: wide-ranging disciplinary knowledge, heterogeneous sensor modalities, and a fragmented spectrum of tasks. To bridge these gaps, we introduce GeoMMBench, a comprehensive multimodal question-answering benchmark covering diverse RS disciplines, sensors, and tasks, enabling broader and more rigorous evaluation than prior benchmarks. Using GeoMMBench, we assess 36 open-source and proprietary large language models, uncovering systematic deficiencies in domain knowledge, perceptual grounding, and reasoning--capabilities essential for expert-level geospatial interpretation. Beyond evaluation, we propose GeoMMAgent, a multi-agent framework that strategically integrates retrieval, perception, and reasoning through domain-specific RS models and tools. Extensive experimental results demonstrate that GeoMMAgent significantly outperforms standalone LLMs, underscoring the importance of tool-augmented agents for dynamically tackling complex geoscience and RS challenges.

AI.tldr: GeoMMBench是一个全面的多模态问答基准，用于评估地理科学和遥感领域的MLLMs性能，发现现有模型存在系统性缺陷，并提出了GeoMMAgent多智能体框架来提升性能。
AI.motivation: 地理科学和遥感领域的多模态大语言模型发展受到三个主要挑战制约：广泛的学科知识、异构的传感器模态和碎片化的任务谱系。现有基准无法全面评估这些复杂需求。
AI.method: 1) 开发GeoMMBench基准，涵盖多样化的遥感学科、传感器和任务；2) 评估36个开源和专有大型语言模型；3) 提出GeoMMAgent多智能体框架，通过领域特定的遥感模型和工具集成检索、感知和推理能力。
AI.result: 评估发现现有模型在领域知识、感知基础和推理能力方面存在系统性缺陷。GeoMMAgent框架显著优于独立的LLMs，证明了工具增强智能体在解决复杂地理科学和遥感挑战中的重要性。
AI.conclusion: GeoMMBench为地理科学和遥感领域的MLLMs提供了更全面和严格的评估基准，而GeoMMAgent框架展示了多智能体集成领域特定工具的有效性，为动态应对复杂地理科学挑战提供了解决方案。

title: Breaking Block Boundaries: Anchor-based History-stable Decoding for Diffusion Large Language Models
summary: Diffusion Large Language Models (dLLMs) have recently become a promising alternative to autoregressive large language models (ARMs). Semi-autoregressive (Semi-AR) decoding is widely employed in base dLLMs and advanced decoding strategies due to its superior performance. However, our observations reveal that Semi-AR decoding suffers from inherent block constraints, which cause the decoding of many cross-block stable tokens to be unnecessarily delayed. To address this challenge, we systematically investigate the identification of stable tokens and present three key findings: (1) naive lookahead decoding is unreliable, (2) token stability closely correlates with convergence trend, and (3) historical information is isolated. Building on these insights, we propose Anchor-based History-stable Decoding (AHD), a training-free, plug-and-play dynamic decoding strategy. Specifically, AHD monitors the stability trend of tokens in real time through dynamic anchors. Once a token reaches stability, it initiates early cross-block decoding to enhance efficiency and performance. Extensive experiments across language, vision-language, and audio-language domains demonstrate that AHD simultaneously improves both performance and inference efficiency. Notably, AHD effectively reverses the performance degradation typically observed in existing advanced decoding acceleration strategies. For instance, on the BBH benchmark, our approach reduces decoding steps by 80% while improving performance by 3.67%.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Anchor-based History-stable Decoding (AHD)，一种用于扩散大语言模型的训练免费、即插即用的动态解码策略，通过实时监控token稳定性趋势，实现早期跨块解码，同时提升性能和推理效率。
AI.motivation: 半自回归解码在扩散大语言模型中广泛使用，但存在固有的块约束问题，导致许多跨块稳定token的解码被不必要地延迟，需要解决这一效率瓶颈。
AI.method: 提出基于锚点的历史稳定解码(AHD)：1) 通过动态锚点实时监控token稳定性趋势；2) 一旦token达到稳定状态，立即启动早期跨块解码；3) 基于对稳定token识别的三个关键发现设计解码策略。
AI.result: 在语言、视觉语言和音频语言领域的广泛实验表明，AHD同时提升了性能和推理效率。在BBH基准测试中，解码步骤减少80%的同时性能提升3.67%，有效逆转了现有高级解码加速策略通常出现的性能下降。
AI.conclusion: AHD通过实时监控token稳定性并实现早期跨块解码，成功解决了半自回归解码的块约束问题，为扩散大语言模型提供了一种高效且性能优越的解码策略。

title: Fast Model-guided Instance-wise Adaptation Framework for Real-world Pansharpening with Fidelity Constraints
summary: Pansharpening aims to generate high-resolution multispectral (HRMS) images by fusing low-resolution multispectral (LRMS) and high-resolution panchromatic (PAN) images while preserving both spectral and spatial information. Although deep learning (DL)-based pansharpening methods achieve impressive performance, they require high training cost and large datasets, and often degrade when the test distribution differs from training, limiting generalization. Recent zero-shot methods, trained on a single PAN/LRMS pair, offer strong generalization but suffer from limited fusion quality, high computational overhead, and slow convergence. To address these issues, we propose FMG-Pan, a fast and generalizable model-guided instance-wise adaptation framework for real-world pansharpening, achieving both cross-sensor generality and rapid training-inference. The framework leverages a pretrained model to guide a lightweight adaptive network through joint optimization with spectral and physical fidelity constraints. We further design a novel physical fidelity term to enhance spatial detail preservation. Extensive experiments on real-world datasets under both intra- and cross-sensor settings demonstrate state-of-the-art performance. On the WorldView-3 dataset, FMG-Pan completes training and inference for a 512x512x8 image within 3 seconds on an RTX 3090 GPU, significantly faster than existing zero-shot methods, making it suitable for practical deployment.

AI.tldr: 提出FMG-Pan框架，通过模型引导的实例自适应方法实现快速、泛化性强的全色锐化，在跨传感器场景下保持高质量融合，训练推理速度显著优于现有零样本方法。
AI.motivation: 现有深度学习全色锐化方法需要大量训练数据和计算成本，且泛化能力有限；零样本方法虽有强泛化性但融合质量受限、计算开销大、收敛慢。需要一种既能保持高质量融合又具备跨传感器泛化能力且快速实用的解决方案。
AI.method: 提出FMG-Pan框架：1）利用预训练模型引导轻量级自适应网络；2）通过联合优化结合光谱保真和物理保真约束；3）设计新颖的物理保真项增强空间细节保留；4）实现实例级别的自适应调整。
AI.result: 在真实世界数据集上的实验表明，FMG-Pan在跨传感器和传感器内设置下均达到最先进性能。在WorldView-3数据集上，512x512x8图像在RTX 3090 GPU上仅需3秒完成训练和推理，显著快于现有零样本方法。
AI.conclusion: FMG-Pan框架成功解决了全色锐化中泛化性与计算效率的平衡问题，实现了高质量、快速、跨传感器通用的全色锐化，适合实际部署应用。

title: Litmus (Re)Agent: A Benchmark and Agentic System for Predictive Evaluation of Multilingual Models
summary: We study predictive multilingual evaluation: estimating how well a model will perform on a task in a target language when direct benchmark results are missing. This problem is common in multilingual deployment, where evaluation coverage is sparse and published evidence is uneven across languages, tasks, and model families. We introduce a controlled benchmark of 1,500 questions spanning six tasks and five evidence scenarios. The benchmark separates accessible evidence from ground truth, enabling evaluation of systems that must infer missing results from incomplete literature evidence. We also present Litmus (Re)Agent, a DAG-orchestrated agentic system that decomposes queries into hypotheses, retrieves evidence, and synthesises predictions through feature-aware aggregation. Across six systems, Litmus (Re)Agent achieves the best overall performance, with the largest gains in transfer-heavy scenarios where direct evidence is weak or absent. These results show that structured agentic reasoning is a promising approach to multilingual performance estimation under incomplete evidence.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出了预测性多语言评估方法，用于在缺乏直接基准测试结果时估计模型在目标语言任务上的表现，并开发了Litmus (Re)Agent系统来解决这一问题。
AI.motivation: 在多语言部署中，评估覆盖范围稀疏，已发布的证据在不同语言、任务和模型家族之间分布不均，导致难以准确评估模型在特定语言任务上的性能。
AI.method: 1) 创建包含1,500个问题、涵盖六个任务和五种证据场景的受控基准；2) 开发Litmus (Re)Agent系统，采用DAG编排的智能代理架构，将查询分解为假设、检索证据，并通过特征感知聚合合成预测。
AI.result: 在六个系统的比较中，Litmus (Re)Agent取得了最佳整体性能，在直接证据薄弱或缺失的转移密集型场景中表现尤为突出。
AI.conclusion: 结构化智能推理是在不完全证据条件下进行多语言性能估计的有前景的方法，Litmus (Re)Agent系统在预测性多语言评估方面表现出色。

title: Large-Scale Universal Defect Generation: Foundation Models and Datasets
summary: Existing defect/anomaly generation methods often rely on few-shot learning, which overfits to specific defect categories due to the lack of large-scale paired defect editing data. This issue is aggravated by substantial variations in defect scale and morphology, resulting in limited generalization, degraded realism, and category consistency. We address these challenges by introducing UDG, a large-scale dataset of 300K normal-abnormal-mask-caption quadruplets spanning diverse domains, and by presenting UniDG, a universal defect generation foundation model that supports both reference-based defect generation and text instruction-based defect editing without per-category fine-tuning. UniDG performs Defect-Context Editing via adaptive defect cropping and structured diptych input format, and fuses reference and target conditions through MM-DiT multimodal attention. A two-stage training strategy, Diversity-SFT followed by Consistency-RFT, further improves diversity while enhancing realism and reference consistency. Extensive experiments on MVTec-AD and VisA show that UniDG outperforms prior few-shot anomaly generation and image insertion/editing baselines in synthesis quality and downstream single- and multi-class anomaly detection/localization. Code will be available at https://github.com/RetoFan233/UniDG.

AI.tldr: UniDG是一个通用的缺陷生成基础模型，通过大规模数据集和两阶段训练策略，支持基于参考的缺陷生成和基于文本指令的缺陷编辑，无需针对每个类别进行微调。
AI.motivation: 现有缺陷/异常生成方法通常依赖少样本学习，由于缺乏大规模配对缺陷编辑数据，容易过拟合到特定缺陷类别。缺陷尺度和形态的巨大变化进一步限制了方法的泛化能力、真实感和类别一致性。
AI.method: 1) 引入UDG数据集（30万个正常-异常-掩码-描述四元组）；2) 提出UniDG模型，采用缺陷上下文编辑（自适应缺陷裁剪和结构化双联画输入格式）和MM-DiT多模态注意力融合参考与目标条件；3) 两阶段训练策略：多样性-SFT后接一致性-RFT。
AI.result: 在MVTec-AD和VisA数据集上的实验表明，UniDG在合成质量和下游单类/多类异常检测/定位方面优于现有的少样本异常生成和图像插入/编辑基线方法。
AI.conclusion: UniDG通过大规模数据集和创新的模型架构，解决了现有缺陷生成方法的泛化限制，实现了更真实、更一致的缺陷生成，为工业检测等应用提供了有效的解决方案。

title: Confident in a Confidence Score: Investigating the Sensitivity of Confidence Scores to Supervised Fine-Tuning
summary: Uncertainty quantification is a set of techniques that measure confidence in language models. They can be used, for example, to detect hallucinations or alert users to review uncertain predictions. To be useful, these confidence scores must be correlated with the quality of the output. However, recent work found that fine-tuning can affect the correlation between confidence scores and quality. Hence, we investigate the underlying behavior of confidence scores to understand its sensitivity to supervised fine-tuning (SFT). We find that post-SFT, the correlation of various confidence scores degrades, which can stem from changes in confidence scores due to factors other than the output quality, such as the output's similarity to the training distribution. We demonstrate via a case study how failing to address this miscorrelation reduces the usefulness of the confidence scores on a downstream task. Our findings show how confidence metrics cannot be used off-the-shelf without testing, and motivate the need for developing metrics which are more robust to fine-tuning.

AI.tldr: 研究发现监督微调会降低语言模型置信度分数与输出质量的相关性，导致置信度指标不能直接使用，需要开发更鲁棒的度量方法。
AI.motivation: 不确定性量化技术用于衡量语言模型的置信度，但最近研究发现微调会影响置信度分数与输出质量的相关性，需要深入理解监督微调对置信度分数的影响机制。
AI.method: 通过研究监督微调后各种置信度分数的相关性变化，分析置信度分数变化的潜在原因（如输出与训练分布的相似性），并通过案例研究展示相关性错误对下游任务的影响。
AI.result: 监督微调后，各种置信度分数与输出质量的相关性下降，这种相关性降低源于置信度分数受到输出质量之外的因素（如输出与训练分布的相似性）影响。
AI.conclusion: 置信度指标不能直接使用而不进行测试，需要开发对微调更鲁棒的度量方法，以确保置信度分数在实际应用中的有效性。

title: MV3DIS: Multi-View Mask Matching via 3D Guides for Zero-Shot 3D Instance Segmentation
summary: Conventional 3D instance segmentation methods rely on labor-intensive 3D annotations for supervised training, which limits their scalability and generalization to novel objects. Recent approaches leverage multi-view 2D masks from the Segment Anything Model (SAM) to guide the merging of 3D geometric primitives, thereby enabling zero-shot 3D instance segmentation. However, these methods typically process each frame independently and rely solely on 2D metrics, such as SAM prediction scores, to produce segmentation maps. This design overlooks multi-view correlations and inherent 3D priors, leading to inconsistent 2D masks across views and ultimately fragmented 3D segmentation. In this paper, we propose MV3DIS, a coarse-to-fine framework for zero-shot 3D instance segmentation that explicitly incorporates 3D priors. Specifically, we introduce a 3D-guided mask matching strategy that uses coarse 3D segments as a common reference to match 2D masks across views and consolidates multi-view mask consistency via 3D coverage distributions. Guided by these view-consistent 2D masks, the coarse 3D segments are further refined into precise 3D instances. Additionally, we introduce a depth consistency weighting scheme that quantifies projection reliability to suppress ambiguities from inter-object occlusions, thereby improving the robustness of 3D-to-2D correspondence. Extensive experiments on the ScanNetV2, ScanNet200, ScanNet++, Replica, and Matterport3D datasets demonstrate the effectiveness of MV3DIS, which achieves superior performance over previous methods

AI.tldr: MV3DIS提出了一种从粗到精的零样本3D实例分割框架，通过引入3D先验来改进基于SAM的多视图2D掩码匹配，解决了现有方法中多视图不一致和3D分割碎片化的问题。
AI.motivation: 传统3D实例分割方法依赖费力的3D标注进行监督训练，限制了其可扩展性和对新物体的泛化能力。现有基于SAM的方法虽然实现了零样本分割，但通常独立处理每帧图像，仅依赖2D指标（如SAM预测分数），忽略了多视图相关性和3D先验，导致跨视图2D掩码不一致和最终的3D分割碎片化。
AI.method: 提出MV3DIS框架，采用从粗到精的方法：1）引入3D引导的掩码匹配策略，使用粗糙的3D分割作为公共参考来匹配跨视图的2D掩码，并通过3D覆盖分布整合多视图掩码一致性；2）在视图一致的2D掩码指导下，将粗糙的3D分割进一步细化为精确的3D实例；3）引入深度一致性加权方案，量化投影可靠性以抑制物体间遮挡带来的模糊性，提高3D到2D对应关系的鲁棒性。
AI.result: 在ScanNetV2、ScanNet200、ScanNet++、Replica和Matterport3D数据集上的广泛实验表明，MV3DIS的有效性，其性能优于先前的方法。
AI.conclusion: MV3DIS通过显式整合3D先验，解决了基于SAM的零样本3D实例分割中多视图不一致和分割碎片化的问题，实现了更准确和鲁棒的3D实例分割。

title: Quantisation Reshapes the Metacognitive Geometry of Language Models
comment: 10 pages, 2 figures, 5 tables. Pre-registered study. Code and data: https://github.com/synthiumjp/sdt-calibration
summary: We report that model quantisation restructures domain-level metacognitive efficiency in LLMs rather than degrading it uniformly. Evaluating Llama-3-8B-Instruct on the same 3,000 questions at Q5_K_M and f16 precision, we find that M-ratio profiles across four knowledge domains are uncorrelated between formats (Spearman rho = 0.00). Arts & Literature moves from worst-monitored (M-ratio = 0.606 at Q5_K_M) to best-monitored (1.542 at f16). Geography moves from well-monitored (1.210) to under-monitored (0.798). However, Type-2 AUROC profiles are perfectly stable across formats (rho = 1.00), localising the restructuring to the M-ratio normalisation rather than the underlying discrimination signal. This finding emerged from a pre-registered attempt to improve metacognition through domain-conditional training. We prescribed confidence-amplification SFT for the diagnosed weak domain, with matched-budget agnostic and wrong-prescription controls. All four confirmatory hypotheses were null (10,000 bootstrap resamples, seed = 42). The training successfully reshaped confidence distributions, doubling the NLP gap in Science from 0.076 to 0.152, but did not improve meta-d' because the diagnostic profile did not transfer across formats. Any system relying on domain-level M-ratio profiles has an unexamined dependency on inference format. Systems using AUROC_2 are safer. We release all code, pre-registrations, and trial-level data.

AI.tldr: 模型量化会重组LLM在领域层面的元认知效率，而非均匀降低。研究发现M-ratio在不同量化格式间完全不相关，但Type-2 AUROC保持完美稳定，表明重组仅影响归一化而非基础判别信号。
AI.motivation: 研究旨在探索模型量化如何影响LLM的元认知效率，特别是不同知识领域的监控能力变化，以及这种变化是否会影响基于领域诊断的元认知训练效果。
AI.method: 使用Llama-3-8B-Instruct模型，在Q5_K_M和f16两种精度下评估3000个问题，分析四个知识领域的M-ratio和Type-2 AUROC变化。通过预注册实验设计，对诊断出的弱领域进行置信度增强SFT训练，并设置匹配预算的对照组。
AI.result: M-ratio在不同量化格式间完全不相关（Spearman rho=0.00），Arts & Literature从最差监控变为最佳监控，Geography则相反。Type-2 AUROC完全稳定（rho=1.00）。基于领域诊断的训练未能改善meta-d'，因为诊断特征在不同格式间不具可迁移性。
AI.conclusion: 依赖领域级M-ratio配置的系统存在对推理格式的未检依赖性，而使用AUROC_2的系统更安全。模型量化会重组而非均匀降低元认知效率，这对基于量化模型的元认知评估和训练具有重要意义。

title: TAIHRI: Task-Aware 3D Human Keypoints Localization for Close-Range Human-Robot Interaction
summary: Accurate 3D human keypoints localization is a critical technology enabling robots to achieve natural and safe physical interaction with users. Conventional 3D human keypoints estimation methods primarily focus on the whole-body reconstruction quality relative to the root joint. However, in practical human-robot interaction (HRI) scenarios, robots are more concerned with the precise metric-scale spatial localization of task-relevant body parts under the egocentric camera 3D coordinate. We propose TAIHRI, the first Vision-Language Model (VLM) tailored for close-range HRI perception, capable of understanding users' motion commands and directing the robot's attention to the most task-relevant keypoints. By quantizing 3D keypoints into a finite interaction space, TAIHRI precisely localize the 3D spatial coordinates of critical body parts by 2D keypoint reasoning via next token prediction, and seamlessly adapt to downstream tasks such as natural language control or global space human mesh recovery. Experiments on egocentric interaction benchmarks demonstrate that TAIHRI achieves superior estimation accuracy for task-critical body parts. We believe TAIHRI opens new research avenues in the field of embodied human-robot interaction. Code is available at: https://github.com/Tencent/TAIHRI.

AI.tldr: TAIHRI是一个专为近距离人机交互设计的视觉语言模型，通过量化3D关键点到有限交互空间，实现任务相关身体部位的精确度量尺度定位。
AI.motivation: 传统3D人体关键点估计方法主要关注相对于根关节的全身重建质量，但在实际人机交互场景中，机器人更关心在自我中心相机3D坐标系下任务相关身体部位的精确度量尺度空间定位。
AI.method: TAIHRI通过将3D关键点量化为有限交互空间，通过下一个token预测进行2D关键点推理，精确地定位关键身体部位的3D空间坐标，并能无缝适应下游任务如自然语言控制或全局空间人体网格恢复。
AI.result: 在自我中心交互基准测试中，TAIHRI在任务关键身体部位的估计精度上表现出优越性能。
AI.conclusion: TAIHRI为具身人机交互领域开辟了新的研究途径，能够理解用户的运动指令并将机器人注意力引导到最任务相关的关键点上。

title: Testing the Assumptions of Active Learning for Translation Tasks with Few Samples
summary: Active learning (AL) is a training paradigm for selecting unlabeled samples for annotation to improve model performance on a test set, which is useful when only a limited number of samples can be annotated. These algorithms often work by optimizing for the informativeness and diversity of the training data to be annotated. Recent work found that AL strategies fail to outperform random sampling on various language generation tasks when using 100-500 samples. To understand AL's poor performance when only using few samples, we investigate whether the core assumptions underlying AL strategies hold. We find that neither the informativeness nor diversity of the training data, which AL strategies optimize for, are correlated with test set performance. Instead, factors like the ordering of the training samples and interactions with pre-training data have a larger impact on performance. This suggests that future AL methods must take these factors into account in order to work with very few samples.

AI.tldr: 研究发现主动学习在语言生成任务中使用少量样本（100-500个）时表现不佳，因为其核心假设（信息量和多样性）与测试集性能不相关，而训练样本顺序和预训练数据交互等因素影响更大。
AI.motivation: 主动学习通常用于在标注资源有限时选择最有价值的未标注样本进行标注，但最近研究发现主动学习在语言生成任务中使用少量样本时表现不佳。本研究旨在探究主动学习在少量样本情况下表现不佳的原因，检验其核心假设是否成立。
AI.method: 通过实验研究主动学习策略在语言生成任务中的表现，特别关注当使用100-500个样本时的情况。分析主动学习优化的两个核心因素——训练数据的信息量和多样性——是否与测试集性能相关，并考察其他可能影响性能的因素。
AI.result: 研究发现主动学习策略优化的两个核心因素（信息量和多样性）与测试集性能没有相关性。相反，训练样本的顺序以及样本与预训练数据的交互作用对性能有更大影响。这表明现有的主动学习方法在少量样本情况下可能基于错误的假设。
AI.conclusion: 主动学习在语言生成任务中使用少量样本时表现不佳，因为其核心优化目标（信息量和多样性）并非影响性能的关键因素。未来的主动学习方法需要考虑训练样本顺序和预训练数据交互等实际影响因素，才能在少量样本情况下有效工作。

title: Degradation-Robust Fusion: An Efficient Degradation-Aware Diffusion Framework for Multimodal Image Fusion in Arbitrary Degradation Scenarios
summary: Complex degradations like noise, blur, and low resolution are typical challenges in real world image fusion tasks, limiting the performance and practicality of existing methods. End to end neural network based approaches are generally simple to design and highly efficient in inference, but their black-box nature leads to limited interpretability. Diffusion based methods alleviate this to some extent by providing powerful generative priors and a more structured inference process. However, they are trained to learn a single domain target distribution, whereas fusion lacks natural fused data and relies on modeling complementary information from multiple sources, making diffusion hard to apply directly in practice. To address these challenges, this paper proposes an efficient degradation aware diffusion framework for image fusion under arbitrary degradation scenarios. Specifically, instead of explicitly predicting noise as in conventional diffusion models, our method performs implicit denoising by directly regressing the fused image, enabling flexible adaptation to diverse fusion tasks under complex degradations with limited steps. Moreover, we design a joint observation model correction mechanism that simultaneously imposes degradation and fusion constraints during sampling to ensure high reconstruction accuracy. Experiments on diverse fusion tasks and degradation configurations demonstrate the superiority of the proposed method under complex degradation scenarios.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种高效的退化感知扩散框架，用于处理任意退化场景下的图像融合任务，通过隐式去噪和联合观测模型校正机制，在复杂退化条件下实现高性能的图像融合。
AI.motivation: 现实世界图像融合任务面临噪声、模糊、低分辨率等复杂退化挑战，现有方法性能受限。端到端神经网络方法设计简单、推理高效但可解释性有限；扩散方法提供生成先验但通常针对单一目标域训练，而融合任务缺乏自然融合数据且需要建模多源互补信息，难以直接应用扩散模型。
AI.method: 提出退化感知扩散框架：1）采用隐式去噪策略，直接回归融合图像而非预测噪声，实现有限步数下对复杂退化场景的灵活适应；2）设计联合观测模型校正机制，在采样过程中同时施加退化和融合约束，确保高重建精度。
AI.result: 在多种融合任务和退化配置下的实验表明，该方法在复杂退化场景下具有优越性，能够有效处理噪声、模糊、低分辨率等多种退化条件下的图像融合问题。
AI.conclusion: 该研究提出的退化感知扩散框架解决了传统方法在复杂退化场景下的局限性，通过隐式去噪和联合约束机制，为实际应用中的图像融合任务提供了高效且性能优越的解决方案。

title: PerMix-RLVR: Preserving Persona Expressivity under Verifiable-Reward Alignment
summary: Persona prompting has been widely adopted to steer large language models (LLMs) behavior and improve their instruction performance by assigning specific characters. However, identifying an optimal persona is time-consuming, and its impact on output quality remains poorly understood. Prior work has mainly addressed this issue at the prompt level via inference-time strategies, incurring additional computation. In this work, we avoid inference-time prompt search by tackling persona sensitivity during training, aiming to train models that adapt their behavior to diverse personas while preserving task performance. In particular, we find that reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) systematically reduces sensitivity to persona prompts, but also reveals an inherent trade-off of outcome-based optimization: while RLVR improves robustness on tasks with verifiable goals, it can also degrade persona expressivity when needed, e.g., in-character role-playing. To address this limitation, we propose PerMix-RLVR, a persona-mixed RLVR strategy that mitigates the persona robustness-fidelity trade-off, preserving strong robustness to harmful persona variation while enabling faithful persona adoption when required. Concretely, PerMix-RLVR improves persona stability score (PSS) over RLVR by +21.2% on MATH500, while also enhancing persona fidelity by +11.4% on PersonaGym.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出PerMix-RLVR方法，通过在训练阶段解决大语言模型对人物角色提示的敏感性，避免推理时的提示搜索，平衡人物角色鲁棒性和忠实性之间的权衡。
AI.motivation: 当前人物角色提示被广泛用于引导大语言模型行为，但寻找最优人物角色耗时且对输出质量影响不明确。现有方法主要在推理时通过提示策略解决，带来额外计算开销。
AI.method: 提出PerMix-RLVR方法，这是一种人物角色混合的强化学习与可验证奖励策略，在训练阶段解决人物角色敏感性，平衡鲁棒性和忠实性之间的权衡。
AI.result: PerMix-RLVR在MATH500上比RLVR提高人物角色稳定性分数21.2%，在PersonaGym上提高人物角色忠实性11.4%，有效缓解了人物角色鲁棒性与忠实性的权衡问题。
AI.conclusion: 通过训练阶段的PerMix-RLVR方法，可以在保持任务性能的同时，使模型适应不同人物角色，平衡人物角色鲁棒性和表达忠实性，避免推理时的提示搜索开销。

title: Customized Fusion: A Closed-Loop Dynamic Network for Adaptive Multi-Task-Aware Infrared-Visible Image Fusion
comment: This paper has been accepted by CVPR 2026
summary: Infrared-visible image fusion aims to integrate complementary information for robust visual understanding, but existing fusion methods struggle with simultaneously adapting to multiple downstream tasks. To address this issue, we propose a Closed-Loop Dynamic Network (CLDyN) that can adaptively respond to the semantic requirements of diverse downstream tasks for task-customized image fusion. Specifically, CLDyN introduces a closed-loop optimization mechanism that establishes a semantic transmission chain to achieve explicit feedback from downstream tasks to the fusion network through a Requirement-driven Semantic Compensation (RSC) module. The RSC module leverages a Basis Vector Bank (BVB) and an Architecture-Adaptive Semantic Injection (A2SI) block to customize the network architecture according to task requirements, thereby enabling task-specific semantic compensation and allowing the fusion network to actively adapt to diverse tasks without retraining. To promote semantic compensation, a reward-penalty strategy is introduced to reward or penalize the RSC module based on task performance variations. Experiments on the M3FD, FMB, and VT5000 datasets demonstrate that CLDyN not only maintains high fusion quality but also exhibits strong multi-task adaptability. The code is available at https://github.com/YR0211/CLDyN.

AI.tldr: 提出闭环动态网络CLDyN，通过需求驱动的语义补偿模块实现任务定制化红外-可见光图像融合，无需重新训练即可适应多种下游任务
AI.motivation: 现有红外-可见光图像融合方法难以同时适应多个下游任务，需要一种能够根据任务语义需求自适应调整的融合方法
AI.method: 提出闭环动态网络CLDyN，包含需求驱动的语义补偿模块，使用基向量库和架构自适应语义注入块，通过奖励-惩罚策略优化语义补偿
AI.result: 在M3FD、FMB和VT5000数据集上实验表明，CLDyN不仅保持高融合质量，还表现出强大的多任务适应能力
AI.conclusion: CLDyN通过闭环优化机制实现了任务定制化的图像融合，能够根据下游任务需求自适应调整，为多任务图像融合提供了有效解决方案

title: ASTRA: Adaptive Semantic Tree Reasoning Architecture for Complex Table Question Answering
summary: Table serialization remains a critical bottleneck for Large Language Models (LLMs) in complex table question answering, hindered by challenges such as structural neglect, representation gaps, and reasoning opacity. Existing serialization methods fail to capture explicit hierarchies and lack schema flexibility, while current tree-based approaches suffer from limited semantic adaptability. To address these limitations, we propose ASTRA (Adaptive Semantic Tree Reasoning Architecture) including two main modules, AdaSTR and DuTR. First, we introduce AdaSTR, which leverages the global semantic awareness of LLMs to reconstruct tables into Logical Semantic Trees. This serialization explicitly models hierarchical dependencies and employs an adaptive mechanism to optimize construction strategies based on table scale. Second, building on this structure, we present DuTR, a dual-mode reasoning framework that integrates tree-search-based textual navigation for linguistic alignment and symbolic code execution for precise verification. Experiments on complex table benchmarks demonstrate that our method achieves state-of-the-art (SOTA) performance.

AI.tldr: ASTRA框架通过AdaSTR将表格重构为逻辑语义树，结合DuTR的双模式推理，在复杂表格问答任务中实现SOTA性能。
AI.motivation: 现有表格序列化方法存在结构忽视、表示差距和推理不透明等问题，无法捕捉显式层次结构且缺乏模式灵活性，树基方法语义适应性有限。
AI.method: 提出ASTRA框架，包含两个核心模块：1) AdaSTR利用LLM的全局语义感知将表格重构为逻辑语义树，显式建模层次依赖关系，并基于表格规模自适应优化构建策略；2) DuTR双模式推理框架，集成基于树搜索的文本导航实现语言对齐，结合符号代码执行进行精确验证。
AI.result: 在复杂表格基准测试中，该方法实现了最先进的性能表现。
AI.conclusion: ASTRA通过自适应语义树推理架构有效解决了表格序列化的关键瓶颈，在复杂表格问答任务中展现出优越性能。

title: Towards Linguistically-informed Representations for English as a Second or Foreign Language: Review, Construction and Application
summary: The widespread use of English as a Second or Foreign Language (ESFL) has sparked a paradigm shift: ESFL is not seen merely as a deviation from standard English but as a distinct linguistic system in its own right. This shift highlights the need for dedicated, knowledge-intensive representations of ESFL. In response, this paper surveys existing ESFL resources, identifies their limitations, and proposes a novel solution. Grounded in constructivist theories, the paper treats constructions as the fundamental units of analysis, allowing it to model the syntax--semantics interface of both ESFL and standard English. This design captures a wide range of ESFL phenomena by referring to syntactico-semantic mappings of English while preserving ESFL's unique characteristics, resulting a gold-standard syntactico-semantic resource comprising 1643 annotated ESFL sentences. To demonstrate the sembank's practical utility, we conduct a pilot study testing the Linguistic Niche Hypothesis, highlighting its potential as a valuable tool in Second Language Acquisition research.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一种基于构式语法理论的新方法，为英语作为第二语言/外语（ESFL）创建了包含1643个标注句子的句法-语义资源库，用于支持二语习得研究。
AI.motivation: 英语作为第二语言/外语（ESFL）的广泛使用引发了范式转变：ESFL不再被视为标准英语的偏差，而是被视为一个独立的语言系统。这一转变凸显了对专门的、知识密集型的ESFL表征的需求。
AI.method: 基于建构主义理论，将构式作为基本分析单位，能够同时建模ESFL和标准英语的句法-语义接口。该方法通过参考英语的句法-语义映射来捕捉广泛的ESFL现象，同时保留ESFL的独特特征。
AI.result: 创建了一个包含1643个标注句子的黄金标准句法-语义资源库。通过测试语言生态位假说的试点研究，展示了该资源库在二语习得研究中的实用价值。
AI.conclusion: 该研究为ESFL提供了创新的表征方法，创建的资源库可作为二语习得研究的宝贵工具，有助于更深入地理解ESFL作为独立语言系统的特性。

title: CONDESION-BENCH: Conditional Decision-Making of Large Language Models in Compositional Action Space
