summary: Large language models have been widely explored as decision-support tools in high-stakes domains due to their contextual understanding and reasoning capabilities. However, existing decision-making benchmarks rely on two simplifying assumptions: actions are selected from a finite set of pre-defined candidates, and explicit conditions restricting action feasibility are not incorporated into the decision-making process. These assumptions fail to capture the compositional structure of real-world actions and the explicit conditions that constrain their validity. To address these limitations, we introduce CONDESION-BENCH, a benchmark designed to evaluate conditional decision-making in compositional action space. In CONDESION-BENCH, actions are defined as allocations to decision variables and are restricted by explicit conditions at the variable, contextual, and allocation levels. By employing oracle-based evaluation of both decision quality and condition adherence, we provide a more rigorous assessment of LLMs as decision-support tools.

AI.tldr: CONDESION-BENCH是一个评估大语言模型在组合动作空间中条件决策能力的基准，解决了现有基准中动作候选集有限和缺乏显式条件约束的问题。
AI.motivation: 现有决策支持基准存在两个简化假设：1) 动作从预定义的有限候选集中选择；2) 决策过程中不考虑限制动作可行性的显式条件。这些假设未能捕捉现实世界动作的组合结构及其有效性约束条件。
AI.method: 引入CONDESION-BENCH基准，将动作定义为对决策变量的分配，并在变量、上下文和分配三个层次上施加显式条件约束。采用基于oracle的评估方法，同时评估决策质量和条件遵守情况。
AI.result: 该基准提供了更严格的评估框架，能够更准确地评估大语言模型作为决策支持工具的能力，特别是在处理组合动作空间和条件约束方面的表现。
AI.conclusion: CONDESION-BENCH通过引入组合动作空间和显式条件约束，为大语言模型的决策支持能力评估提供了更真实、更严格的基准，有助于推动该领域的发展。

title: TouchAnything: Diffusion-Guided 3D Reconstruction from Sparse Robot Touches
summary: Accurate object geometry estimation is essential for many downstream tasks, including robotic manipulation and physical interaction. Although vision is the dominant modality for shape perception, it becomes unreliable under occlusions or challenging lighting conditions. In such scenarios, tactile sensing provides direct geometric information through physical contact. However, reconstructing global 3D geometry from sparse local touches alone is fundamentally underconstrained. We present TouchAnything, a framework that leverages a pretrained large-scale 2D vision diffusion model as a semantic and geometric prior for 3D reconstruction from sparse tactile measurements. Unlike prior work that trains category-specific reconstruction networks or learns diffusion models directly from tactile data, we transfer the geometric knowledge encoded in pretrained visual diffusion models to the tactile domain. Given sparse contact constraints and a coarse class-level description of the object, we formulate reconstruction as an optimization problem that enforces tactile consistency while guiding solutions toward shapes consistent with the diffusion prior. Our method reconstructs accurate geometries from only a few touches, outperforms existing baselines, and enables open-world 3D reconstruction of previously unseen object instances. Our project page is https://grange007.github.io/touchanything .

AI.tldr: TouchAnything框架利用预训练的大规模2D视觉扩散模型作为语义和几何先验，从稀疏触觉测量中重建3D几何形状，仅需少量触摸即可实现精确重建。
AI.motivation: 视觉感知在遮挡或光照条件差的情况下不可靠，而触觉传感通过物理接触提供直接几何信息。然而，仅从稀疏局部触摸重建全局3D几何本质上是不确定的。
AI.method: 利用预训练的大规模2D视觉扩散模型作为语义和几何先验，将稀疏接触约束和粗略类别描述作为输入，将重建问题表述为优化问题，在保持触觉一致性的同时引导解向符合扩散先验的形状发展。
AI.result: 该方法仅需少量触摸即可重建准确几何形状，优于现有基线方法，能够实现先前未见物体实例的开放世界3D重建。
AI.conclusion: TouchAnything框架成功地将预训练视觉扩散模型的几何知识迁移到触觉领域，解决了从稀疏触觉测量重建3D几何的根本不确定性问题。

title: Anchored Sliding Window: Toward Robust and Imperceptible Linguistic Steganography
summary: Linguistic steganography based on language models typically assumes that steganographic texts are transmitted without alteration, making them fragile to even minor modifications. While previous work mitigates this fragility by limiting the context window, it significantly compromises text quality. In this paper, we propose the anchored sliding window (ASW) framework to improve imperceptibility and robustness. In addition to the latest tokens, the prompt and a bridge context are anchored within the context window, encouraging the model to compensate for the excluded tokens. We formulate the optimization of the bridge context as a variant of prompt distillation, which we further extend using self-distillation strategies. Experiments show that our ASW significantly and consistently outperforms the baseline method in text quality, imperceptibility, and robustness across diverse settings. The code is available at github.com/ryehr/ASW_steganography.

AI.tldr: 提出基于锚定滑动窗口的语言隐写框架，在保持文本质量的同时提升鲁棒性
AI.motivation: 传统语言模型隐写方法假设隐写文本在传输中不被修改，对微小改动非常脆弱。现有方法通过限制上下文窗口来缓解脆弱性，但严重损害了文本质量。
AI.method: 提出锚定滑动窗口框架，在上下文窗口中锚定提示词和桥接上下文，鼓励模型补偿被排除的标记。将桥接上下文优化公式化为提示蒸馏的变体，并进一步使用自蒸馏策略进行扩展。
AI.result: 实验表明，ASW在文本质量、不可感知性和鲁棒性方面显著且一致地优于基线方法，适用于多种设置。
AI.conclusion: 锚定滑动窗口框架有效解决了语言隐写中鲁棒性与文本质量之间的权衡问题，为实际应用提供了更可靠的解决方案。

title: Low-Data Supervised Adaptation Outperforms Prompting for Cloud Segmentation Under Domain Shift
comment: 10 pages, 6 figures, to be published in EarthVision @ CVPR 2026
summary: Adapting vision-language models to remote sensing imagery presents a fundamental challenge: both the visual and linguistic distributions of satellite data lie far outside natural image pretraining corpora. Despite this, prompting remains the dominant deployment paradigm, driven by the assumption that domain-specific language can guide frozen model representations toward specialized tasks. We test this assumption directly on a domain where the mismatch is prominent: cloud segmentation for satellite imagery. Using CLIPSeg on the CloudSEN12+ cloud segmentation benchmark, we evaluate 60 prompt variants spanning simple labels, domain terminology, appearance descriptors, and contextual cues, finding that every variant underperforms the zero-shot baseline (0.255 mIoU), with engineered prompts scoring as low as 0.07 mIoU. No amount of linguistic refinement bridges the gap between CLIP's natural image representations and satellite spectral imagery. In contrast, supervised fine-tuning with just 0.1% labeled data (~8 images) surpasses zero-shot performance overall, and 5-10% data recovers ~85% of maximum achievable mIoU. Full fine-tuning consistently outperforms low-rank adaptation by 0.03-0.09 mIoU, with the largest gaps for spectrally ambiguous classes, and at 0.5 to 1% labeled data, fine-tuning temporarily degrades performance on these classes before recovering, a supervision dip that aggregate mIoU can mask. For practitioners adapting vision-language models to specialized imagery, our results deliver a clear message: labeled data is not the expensive alternative to prompting; it is the worthwhile path.

AI.tldr: 在遥感影像云分割任务中，提示工程无法弥补CLIP自然图像预训练与卫星光谱影像之间的分布差异，而少量有标签数据的微调即可显著超越零样本性能
AI.motivation: 验证在视觉语言模型应用于遥感影像时，提示工程是否能够有效弥补自然图像预训练与卫星数据之间的分布差异，特别是在云分割这一典型任务上
AI.method: 在CloudSEN12+云分割基准上，使用CLIPSeg模型评估60种不同提示变体（包括简单标签、领域术语、外观描述符和上下文线索），并与有监督微调（包括全微调和低秩适应）进行对比，分析不同数据量下的性能表现
AI.result: 所有提示变体均低于零样本基线（0.255 mIoU），工程化提示最低仅0.07 mIoU；仅需0.1%有标签数据（约8张图像）的微调即可超越零样本性能，5-10%数据可恢复约85%的最大可达到mIoU；全微调始终优于低秩适应0.03-0.09 mIoU
AI.conclusion: 对于将视觉语言模型应用于专业影像领域，有标签数据不是提示工程的昂贵替代品，而是值得投入的有效路径，语言精炼无法弥补自然图像表示与卫星光谱影像之间的分布差异

title: NyayaMind- A Framework for Transparent Legal Reasoning and Judgment Prediction in the Indian Legal System
summary: Court Judgment Prediction and Explanation (CJPE) aims to predict a judicial decision and provide a legally grounded explanation for a given case based on the facts, legal issues, arguments, cited statutes, and relevant precedents. For such systems to be practically useful in judicial or legal research settings, they must not only achieve high predictive performance but also generate transparent and structured legal reasoning that aligns with established judicial practices. In this work, we present NyayaMind, an open-source framework designed to enable transparent and scalable legal reasoning for the Indian judiciary. The proposed framework integrates retrieval, reasoning, and verification mechanisms to emulate the structured decision-making process typically followed in courts. Specifically, NyayaMind consists of two main components: a Retrieval Module and a Prediction Module. The Retrieval Module employs a RAG pipeline to identify legally relevant statutes and precedent cases from large-scale legal corpora, while the Prediction Module utilizes reasoning-oriented LLMs fine-tuned for the Indian legal domain to generate structured outputs including issues, arguments, rationale, and the final decision. Our extensive results and expert evaluation demonstrate that NyayaMind significantly improves the quality of explanation and evidence alignment compared to existing CJPE approaches, providing a promising step toward trustworthy AI-assisted legal decision support systems.

AI.tldr: NyayaMind是一个用于印度司法系统的开源框架，通过检索-推理-验证机制实现透明可扩展的法律推理，显著提升法律解释质量和证据对齐。
AI.motivation: 当前法院判决预测与解释系统需要同时实现高预测性能和生成透明、结构化、符合司法实践的法律推理，以在实际司法或法律研究环境中具有实用价值。
AI.method: 框架包含检索模块和预测模块：检索模块使用RAG管道从大规模法律语料库中识别相关法律条文和先例案例；预测模块使用针对印度法律领域微调、面向推理的LLM生成结构化输出，包括问题、论点、理由和最终判决。
AI.result: 广泛的结果和专家评估表明，NyayaMind相比现有CJPE方法显著提高了解释质量和证据对齐，为可信的AI辅助法律决策支持系统迈出了有希望的一步。
AI.conclusion: NyayaMind通过集成检索、推理和验证机制，模拟法院的结构化决策过程，为印度司法系统提供了透明可扩展的法律推理框架，是迈向可信AI辅助法律决策支持系统的重要进展。

title: Hierarchical Alignment: Enforcing Hierarchical Instruction-Following in LLMs through Logical Consistency
summary: Large language models increasingly operate under multiple instructions from heterogeneous sources with different authority levels, including system policies, user requests, tool outputs, and retrieved context. While prior work on instruction hierarchy highlights the importance of respecting instruction priorities, it mainly focuses on adversarial attacks and overlooks the benign but common instruction conflicts that arise in real-world applications. In such settings, models must not only avoid security violations but also preserve task utility and behavioral consistency when instructions partially or implicitly conflict. We propose Neuro-Symbolic Hierarchical Alignment (NSHA) for hierarchical instruction-following by explicitly modeling and enforcing instruction priorities. At inference time, we introduce solver-guided reasoning that formulates instruction resolution as a constraint satisfaction problem, enabling the model to derive a maximally consistent set of applicable instructions under hierarchical constraints. At training time, NSHA distills solver-based decisions into model parameters using automatically constructed supervision. We evaluate our approach on rule following, task execution, tool use, and safety, covering both single-turn and multi-turn interactions, and show that NSHA significantly improves performance under such conflicts while maintaining competitive utility in reference settings.

AI.tldr: 本文提出神经符号层次对齐（NSHA）方法，通过显式建模和执行指令优先级来解决大语言模型在多源指令冲突下的层次化指令遵循问题，在推理时使用求解器引导的约束满足方法，在训练时通过自动构建的监督将求解器决策蒸馏到模型参数中。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型在实际应用中需要处理来自不同权威来源的多个指令，包括系统策略、用户请求、工具输出和检索上下文等。现有研究主要关注对抗性攻击，忽视了现实应用中常见的良性指令冲突。在这些场景下，模型不仅需要避免安全违规，还需要在指令部分或隐式冲突时保持任务效用和行为一致性。
AI.method: 提出神经符号层次对齐（NSHA）方法：1）推理时引入求解器引导推理，将指令解析建模为约束满足问题，使模型能够在层次约束下推导出最大一致的可适用指令集；2）训练时使用自动构建的监督将基于求解器的决策蒸馏到模型参数中。
AI.result: 在规则遵循、任务执行、工具使用和安全性等多个方面进行评估，涵盖单轮和多轮交互。结果显示NSHA在指令冲突情况下显著提升了性能，同时在参考设置中保持了竞争力的效用。
AI.conclusion: NSHA通过显式建模指令优先级和层次约束，有效解决了大语言模型在多源指令冲突下的层次化指令遵循问题，在保持安全性的同时提升了任务效用和行为一致性。

title: How Should Video LLMs Output Time? An Analysis of Efficient Temporal Grounding Paradigms
summary: While Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have advanced Video Temporal Grounding (VTG), existing methods often couple output paradigms with different backbones, datasets, and training protocols. This makes it challenging to isolate the specific impact of the output design. Additionally, as VTG systems are increasingly considered for resource-constrained edge deployment, the trade-off between output formulation and system-level efficiency requires systematic investigation. In this paper, we present a controlled empirical study comparing three dominant VTG output paradigms: Text Numeral Generation, Temporal Token Generation, and Continuous Temporal Decoding. We evaluate these paradigms across identical compact VLMs (SmolVLM2, FastVLM, and Molmo2) using consistent datasets and LoRA fine-tuning protocols. Evaluations on Charades-STA, QVHighlights, and YouCook2 measure both localization accuracy and system efficiency, including inference latency, training throughput, and parameter overhead. Our results demonstrate that the choice of output formulation significantly affects both grounding accuracy and computational cost, independent of model scale. Specifically, the continuous distribution paradigm consistently achieves the most favorable efficiency-accuracy trade-off on the Pareto frontier, delivering robust localization with minimal latency overhead. These findings provide objective empirical guidelines for designing efficient, deployment-ready VTG systems.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过控制实验比较了三种视频时序定位输出范式，发现连续分布范式在效率和准确性平衡上表现最佳，为资源受限的边缘部署提供了设计指导。
AI.motivation: 现有视频时序定位方法通常将输出范式与不同骨干网络、数据集和训练协议耦合，难以分离输出设计的具体影响。同时，随着VTG系统越来越多地考虑在资源受限的边缘设备上部署，需要系统研究输出公式与系统效率之间的权衡。
AI.method: 采用控制实验设计，在相同的紧凑视觉语言模型（SmolVLM2、FastVLM和Molmo2）上，使用一致的数据集和LoRA微调协议，比较三种主导的VTG输出范式：文本数字生成、时序标记生成和连续时序解码。
AI.result: 在Charades-STA、QVHighlights和YouCook2数据集上的评估显示，输出范式的选择显著影响定位准确性和计算成本，且与模型规模无关。连续分布范式在帕累托前沿上始终实现最有利的效率-准确性权衡，以最小的延迟开销提供稳健的定位。
AI.conclusion: 研究结果为设计高效、可部署的视频时序定位系统提供了客观的实证指导，特别强调了连续分布范式在资源受限边缘部署场景中的优势。

title: ActFER: Agentic Facial Expression Recognition via Active Tool-Augmented Visual Reasoning
summary: Recent advances in Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have created new opportunities for facial expression recognition (FER), moving it beyond pure label prediction toward reasoning-based affect understanding. However, existing MLLM-based FER methods still follow a passive paradigm: they rely on externally prepared facial inputs and perform single-pass reasoning over fixed visual evidence, without the capability for active facial perception. To address this limitation, we propose ActFER, an agentic framework that reformulates FER as active visual evidence acquisition followed by multimodal reasoning. Specifically, ActFER dynamically invokes tools for face detection and alignment, selectively zooms into informative local regions, and reasons over facial Action Units (AUs) and emotions through a visual Chain-of-Thought. To realize such behavior, we further develop Utility-Calibrated GRPO (UC-GRPO), a reinforcement learning algorithm tailored to agentic FER. UC-GRPO uses AU-grounded multi-level verifiable rewards to densify supervision, query-conditional contrastive utility estimation to enable sample-aware dynamic credit assignment for local inspection, and emotion-aware EMA calibration to reduce noisy utility estimates while capturing emotion-wise inspection tendencies. This algorithm enables ActFER to learn both when local inspection is beneficial and how to reason over the acquired evidence. Comprehensive experiments show that ActFER trained with UC-GRPO consistently outperforms passive MLLM-based FER baselines and substantially improves AU prediction accuracy.

AI.tldr: ActFER：一个将面部表情识别重构为主动视觉证据获取+多模态推理的智能体框架，通过UC-GRPO强化学习算法实现动态面部感知
AI.motivation: 现有基于MLLM的面部表情识别方法仍是被动范式：依赖外部准备的面部输入，在固定视觉证据上进行单次推理，缺乏主动面部感知能力。需要将FER从被动标签预测转变为主动的视觉证据获取和推理过程。
AI.method: 提出ActFER框架：1）动态调用人脸检测和对齐工具；2）选择性放大信息丰富的局部区域；3）通过视觉思维链对面部动作单元和情绪进行推理。开发UC-GRPO强化学习算法：使用AU基础的多级可验证奖励、查询条件对比效用估计、情绪感知EMA校准来训练智能体。
AI.result: ActFER在UC-GRPO训练下持续优于被动MLLM-based FER基线方法，显著提高了AU预测准确率，证明了主动感知在面部表情识别中的有效性。
AI.conclusion: ActFER成功将FER从被动范式转变为主动视觉证据获取和推理过程，UC-GRPO算法使智能体能够学习何时进行局部检查以及如何对获取的证据进行推理，为基于MLLM的FER开辟了新方向。

title: Prototype-Regularized Federated Learning for Cross-Domain Aspect Sentiment Triplet Extraction
summary: Aspect Sentiment Triplet Extraction (ASTE) aims to extract all sentiment triplets of aspect terms, opinion terms, and sentiment polarities from a sentence. Existing methods are typically trained on individual datasets in isolation, failing to jointly capture the common feature representations shared across domains. Moreover, data privacy constraints prevent centralized data aggregation. To address these challenges, we propose Prototype-based Cross-Domain Span Prototype extraction (PCD-SpanProto), a prototype-regularized federated learning framework to enable distributed clients to exchange class-level prototypes instead of full model parameters. Specifically, we design a weighted performance-aware aggregation strategy and a contrastive regularization module to improve the global prototype under domain heterogeneity and the promotion between intra-class compactness and inter-class separability across clients. Extensive experiments on four ASTE datasets demonstrate that our method outperforms baselines and reduces communication costs, validating the effectiveness of prototype-based cross-domain knowledge transfer.

AI.tldr: 本文提出PCD-SpanProto框架，通过原型正则化的联邦学习解决跨领域方面情感三元组提取问题，在保护数据隐私的同时实现跨领域知识共享。
AI.motivation: 现有方面情感三元组提取方法通常在单个数据集上独立训练，无法捕捉跨领域的共同特征表示，且数据隐私限制阻碍了集中式数据聚合。
AI.method: 提出原型正则化的联邦学习框架PCD-SpanProto，让分布式客户端交换类级原型而非完整模型参数，包含加权性能感知聚合策略和对比正则化模块。
AI.result: 在四个ASTE数据集上的实验表明，该方法优于基线方法，同时降低了通信成本，验证了基于原型的跨领域知识转移的有效性。
AI.conclusion: PCD-SpanProto通过原型交换实现了跨领域知识共享，在保护数据隐私的同时提升了方面情感三元组提取的性能和效率。

title: PinpointQA: A Dataset and Benchmark for Small Object-Centric Spatial Understanding in Indoor Videos
summary: Small object-centric spatial understanding in indoor videos remains a significant challenge for multimodal large language models (MLLMs), despite its practical value for object search and assistive applications. Although existing benchmarks have advanced video spatial intelligence, embodied reasoning, and diagnostic perception, no existing benchmark directly evaluates whether a model can localize a target object in video and express its position with sufficient precision for downstream use. In this work, we introduce PinpointQA, the first dataset and benchmark for small object-centric spatial understanding in indoor videos. Built from ScanNet++ and ScanNet200, PinpointQA comprises 1,024 scenes and 10,094 QA pairs organized into four progressively challenging tasks: Target Presence Verification (TPV), Nearest Reference Identification (NRI), Fine-Grained Spatial Description (FSD), and Structured Spatial Prediction (SSP). The dataset is built from intermediate spatial representations, with QA pairs generated automatically and further refined through quality control. Experiments on representative MLLMs reveal a consistent capability gap along the progressive chain, with SSP remaining particularly difficult. Supervised fine-tuning on PinpointQA yields substantial gains, especially on the harder tasks, demonstrating that PinpointQA serves as both a diagnostic benchmark and an effective training dataset. The dataset and project page are available at https://rainchowz.github.io/PinpointQA.

AI.tldr: PinpointQA是首个专注于室内视频中小物体空间理解的基准数据集，包含1,024个场景和10,094个问答对，分为四个渐进式任务，用于评估多模态大语言模型在精确定位目标物体方面的能力。
AI.motivation: 当前多模态大语言模型在室内视频中的小物体空间理解能力不足，缺乏能够直接评估模型是否能够精确定位目标物体并表达其位置以供下游使用的基准数据集。
AI.method: 基于ScanNet++和ScanNet200构建数据集，包含1,024个场景和10,094个问答对，分为四个渐进式任务：目标存在验证、最近参考物识别、细粒度空间描述和结构化空间预测。通过中间空间表示自动生成问答对，并进行质量控制。
AI.result: 实验显示代表性MLLMs在渐进式任务链上存在一致的能力差距，特别是结构化空间预测任务尤为困难。在PinpointQA上进行监督微调能带来显著提升，尤其是在更难的任务上。
AI.conclusion: PinpointQA既可作为诊断多模态大语言模型小物体空间理解能力的基准，也可作为有效的训练数据集，填补了该领域的空白。

title: Think Less, Know More: State-Aware Reasoning Compression with Knowledge Guidance for Efficient Reasoning
summary: Large Reasoning Models (LRMs) achieve strong performance on complex tasks by leveraging long Chain-of-Thought (CoT), but often suffer from overthinking, leading to excessive reasoning steps and high inference latency. Existing CoT compression methods struggle to balance accuracy and efficiency, and lack fine-grained, step-level adaptation to redundancy and reasoning bias. Therefore, we propose State-Aware Reasoning Compression with Knowledge Guidance (STACK), a framework that performs step-wise CoT compression by explicitly modeling stage-specific redundancy sources and integrating with a retrieval-augmented guidance. STACK constructs online long-short contrastive samples and dynamically switches between knowledge-guided compression for uncertain or biased reasoning state and self-prompted compression for overly long but confident state, complemented by an answer-convergence-based early stopping mechanism to suppress redundant verification. We further propose a reward-difference-driven training strategy by combining Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO) and Direct Preference Optimization (DPO), enabling models to learn state-conditioned compression strategies. Experiments on three mathematical reasoning benchmarks show that STACK achieves a superior accuracy-efficiency balance, reducing average response length by 59.9% while improving accuracy by 4.8 points over existing methods.

AI.tldr: STACK框架通过状态感知推理压缩，结合知识引导，显著减少大推理模型的推理步骤（减少59.9%），同时提高准确性（提升4.8%）。
AI.motivation: 大推理模型在复杂任务中使用长思维链时存在过度思考问题，导致推理步骤过多、推理延迟高。现有的思维链压缩方法难以平衡准确性和效率，且缺乏细粒度、步骤级别的适应能力来处理冗余和推理偏差。
AI.method: 提出STACK框架，通过显式建模阶段特定的冗余源，结合检索增强的知识引导，进行步骤级别的思维链压缩。构建在线长短对比样本，根据推理状态动态切换知识引导压缩（用于不确定或有偏差的推理状态）和自提示压缩（用于过长但自信的状态），并采用基于答案收敛的早停机制抑制冗余验证。使用结合PPO和DPO的奖励差异驱动训练策略，让模型学习状态条件化的压缩策略。
AI.result: 在三个数学推理基准测试中，STACK实现了优越的准确性与效率平衡，平均响应长度减少59.9%，同时准确率比现有方法提高4.8个百分点。
AI.conclusion: STACK框架通过状态感知推理压缩和知识引导，有效解决了大推理模型中的过度思考问题，在保持甚至提高准确性的同时显著提升了推理效率。

title: Matrix-Game 3.0: Real-Time and Streaming Interactive World Model with Long-Horizon Memory
summary: With the advancement of interactive video generation, diffusion models have increasingly demonstrated their potential as world models. However, existing approaches still struggle to simultaneously achieve memory-enabled long-term temporal consistency and high-resolution real-time generation, limiting their applicability in real-world scenarios. To address this, we present Matrix-Game 3.0, a memory-augmented interactive world model designed for 720p real-time longform video generation. Building upon Matrix-Game 2.0, we introduce systematic improvements across data, model, and inference. First, we develop an upgraded industrial-scale infinite data engine that integrates Unreal Engine-based synthetic data, large-scale automated collection from AAA games, and real-world video augmentation to produce high-quality Video-Pose-Action-Prompt quadruplet data at scale. Second, we propose a training framework for long-horizon consistency: by modeling prediction residuals and re-injecting imperfect generated frames during training, the base model learns self-correction; meanwhile, camera-aware memory retrieval and injection enable the base model to achieve long horizon spatiotemporal consistency. Third, we design a multi-segment autoregressive distillation strategy based on Distribution Matching Distillation (DMD), combined with model quantization and VAE decoder pruning, to achieve efficient real-time inference. Experimental results show that Matrix-Game 3.0 achieves up to 40 FPS real-time generation at 720p resolution with a 5B model, while maintaining stable memory consistency over minute-long sequences. Scaling up to a 2x14B model further improves generation quality, dynamics, and generalization. Our approach provides a practical pathway toward industrial-scale deployable world models.

AI.tldr: Matrix-Game 3.0是一个内存增强的交互式世界模型，用于720p实时长视频生成，通过数据、模型和推理的系统改进，实现了40 FPS的实时生成和分钟级序列的稳定内存一致性。
AI.motivation: 现有扩散模型在交互式视频生成中难以同时实现内存支持的长时时间一致性和高分辨率实时生成，限制了在实际场景中的应用。
AI.method: 1. 升级工业级无限数据引擎，整合虚幻引擎合成数据、AAA游戏自动采集和真实视频增强；2. 提出长时一致性训练框架，通过建模预测残差和重新注入不完美生成帧实现自校正，结合相机感知内存检索和注入；3. 设计基于分布匹配蒸馏的多段自回归蒸馏策略，结合模型量化和VAE解码器剪枝。
AI.result: Matrix-Game 3.0在5B模型上实现了720p分辨率下最高40 FPS的实时生成，同时保持分钟级序列的稳定内存一致性。扩展到2x14B模型进一步提升了生成质量、动态性和泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: 该方法为实现工业级可部署的世界模型提供了实用途径，解决了长时一致性和实时生成的关键挑战。

title: Persona-E$^2$: A Human-Grounded Dataset for Personality-Shaped Emotional Responses to Textual Events
summary: Most affective computing research treats emotion as a static property of text, focusing on the writer's sentiment while overlooking the reader's perspective. This approach ignores how individual personalities lead to diverse emotional appraisals of the same event. Although role-playing Large Language Models (LLMs) attempt to simulate such nuanced reactions, they often suffer from "personality illusion'' -- relying on surface-level stereotypes rather than authentic cognitive logic. A critical bottleneck is the absence of ground-truth human data to link personality traits to emotional shifts. To bridge the gap, we introduce Persona-E$^2$ (Persona-Event2Emotion), a large-scale dataset grounded in annotated MBTI and Big Five traits to capture reader-based emotional variations across news, social media, and life narratives. Extensive experiments reveal that state-of-the-art LLMs struggle to capture precise appraisal shifts, particularly in social media domains. Crucially, we find that personality information significantly improves comprehension, with the Big Five traits alleviating "personality illusion.'

AI.tldr: 该研究提出了Persona-E²数据集，用于解决情感计算中忽视读者个性差异导致的情绪评估多样性问题，通过标注MBTI和Big Five人格特质来捕捉基于读者的情绪变化。
AI.motivation: 当前情感计算研究将情感视为文本的静态属性，只关注作者情感而忽视读者视角，忽略了不同个性对同一事件的多样化情绪评估。现有角色扮演大语言模型存在"人格幻觉"问题，依赖刻板印象而非真实认知逻辑，缺乏连接人格特质与情绪变化的地面真实数据。
AI.method: 构建Persona-E²（Persona-Event2Emotion）大规模数据集，基于标注的MBTI和Big Five人格特质，捕捉新闻、社交媒体和生活叙事中读者视角的情绪变化。通过实验评估现有大语言模型在捕捉精确评估变化方面的表现。
AI.result: 实验表明，最先进的大语言模型难以捕捉精确的评估变化，尤其在社交媒体领域表现不佳。关键发现是人格信息显著提高了理解能力，Big Five特质能够缓解"人格幻觉"问题。
AI.conclusion: 该研究通过Persona-E²数据集填补了连接人格特质与情绪变化的数据空白，证明人格信息对于理解读者情绪反应的重要性，并为解决大语言模型的"人格幻觉"问题提供了有效途径。

title: StreamMeCo: Long-Term Agent Memory Compression for Efficient Streaming Video Understanding
summary: Vision agent memory has shown remarkable effectiveness in streaming video understanding. However, storing such memory for videos incurs substantial memory overhead, leading to high costs in both storage and computation. To address this issue, we propose StreamMeCo, an efficient Stream Agent Memory Compression framework. Specifically, based on the connectivity of the memory graph, StreamMeCo introduces edge-free minmax sampling for the isolated nodes and an edge-aware weight pruning for connected nodes, evicting the redundant memory nodes while maintaining the accuracy. In addition, we introduce a time-decay memory retrieval mechanism to further eliminate the performance degradation caused by memory compression. Extensive experiments on three challenging benchmark datasets (M3-Bench-robot, M3-Bench-web and Video-MME-Long) demonstrate that under 70% memory graph compression, StreamMeCo achieves a 1.87* speedup in memory retrieval while delivering an average accuracy improvement of 1.0%. Our code is available at https://github.com/Celina-love-sweet/StreamMeCo.

AI.tldr: StreamMeCo是一个高效的流式代理内存压缩框架，通过边缘感知的权重剪枝和时间衰减检索机制，在压缩70%内存图的同时提升检索速度1.87倍并提高准确率1.0%
AI.motivation: 视觉代理内存虽然对视频流理解有效，但存储成本高，计算开销大，需要高效的压缩方案来解决内存开销问题
AI.method: 基于内存图连通性，对孤立节点采用边缘无关的最小最大采样，对连接节点采用边缘感知的权重剪枝，并引入时间衰减内存检索机制
AI.result: 在三个基准数据集上，70%内存图压缩下实现1.87倍检索加速，平均准确率提升1.0%
AI.conclusion: StreamMeCo框架有效解决了视觉代理内存的存储和计算开销问题，在保持准确性的同时显著提升效率

title: Do LLMs Follow Their Own Rules? A Reflexive Audit of Self-Stated Safety Policies
summary: LLMs internalize safety policies through RLHF, yet these policies are never formally specified and remain difficult to inspect. Existing benchmarks evaluate models against external standards but do not measure whether models understand and enforce their own stated boundaries. We introduce the Symbolic-Neural Consistency Audit (SNCA), a framework that (1) extracts a model's self-stated safety rules via structured prompts, (2) formalizes them as typed predicates (Absolute, Conditional, Adaptive), and (3) measures behavioral compliance via deterministic comparison against harm benchmarks. Evaluating four frontier models across 45 harm categories and 47,496 observations reveals systematic gaps between stated policy and observed behavior: models claiming absolute refusal frequently comply with harmful prompts, reasoning models achieve the highest self-consistency but fail to articulate policies for 29% of categories, and cross-model agreement on rule types is remarkably low (11%). These results demonstrate that the gap between what LLMs say and what they do is measurable and architecture-dependent, motivating reflexive consistency audits as a complement to behavioral benchmarks.

AI.tldr: LLMs的安全策略通过RLHF内化但从未正式定义，难以检查。作者提出符号-神经一致性审计框架，提取模型自述安全规则并形式化，测量其行为合规性，发现模型声明与行为存在系统性差距。
AI.motivation: 现有基准测试评估模型是否符合外部标准，但无法衡量模型是否理解和执行其自述的安全边界。LLMs通过RLHF内化安全策略，但这些策略从未正式定义且难以检查。
AI.method: 提出符号-神经一致性审计框架：1) 通过结构化提示提取模型自述的安全规则；2) 将其形式化为类型化谓词（绝对、条件、自适应）；3) 通过确定性比较与危害基准测试测量行为合规性。
AI.result: 评估4个前沿模型在45个危害类别和47,496个观察中显示：声称绝对拒绝的模型经常遵守有害提示；推理模型自一致性最高但无法为29%类别阐明策略；跨模型规则类型一致性极低（11%）。
AI.conclusion: LLMs的声明与行为差距是可测量的且与架构相关，这促使将反思性一致性审计作为行为基准测试的补充。

title: Domain-generalizable Face Anti-Spoofing with Patch-based Multi-tasking and Artifact Pattern Conversion
comment: The published version is available at DOI: https://doi.org/10.1016/j.patcog.2026.113640
summary: Face Anti-Spoofing (FAS) algorithms, designed to secure face recognition systems against spoofing, struggle with limited dataset diversity, impairing their ability to handle unseen visual domains and spoofing methods. We introduce the Pattern Conversion Generative Adversarial Network (PCGAN) to enhance domain generalization in FAS. PCGAN effectively disentangles latent vectors for spoof artifacts and facial features, allowing to generate images with diverse artifacts. We further incorporate patch-based and multi-task learning to tackle partial attacks and overfitting issues to facial features. Our extensive experiments validate PCGAN's effectiveness in domain generalization and detecting partial attacks, giving a substantial improvement in facial recognition security.

AI.tldr: PCGAN通过解耦欺骗伪影和面部特征，生成多样化欺骗图像，提升人脸防伪系统的跨域泛化能力
AI.motivation: 现有的人脸防伪算法面临数据集多样性不足的问题，导致在处理未见视觉域和欺骗方法时表现不佳，需要提升跨域泛化能力
AI.method: 提出模式转换生成对抗网络（PCGAN），有效解耦欺骗伪影和面部特征的潜在向量，生成具有多样化伪影的图像；结合基于补丁和多任务学习来处理部分攻击和对面部特征的过拟合问题
AI.result: 大量实验验证了PCGAN在域泛化和检测部分攻击方面的有效性，显著提升了人脸识别系统的安全性
AI.conclusion: PCGAN通过生成多样化欺骗图像和解耦特征表示，有效解决了人脸防伪中的域泛化问题，增强了系统对未见攻击的鲁棒性

title: SPASM: Stable Persona-driven Agent Simulation for Multi-turn Dialogue Generation
comment: Accepted to Findings of the Association for Computational Linguistics (ACL 2026). Our code and data are available at https://github.com/lhannnn/SPASM
summary: Large language models are increasingly deployed in multi-turn settings such as tutoring, support, and counseling, where reliability depends on preserving consistent roles, personas, and goals across long horizons. This requirement becomes critical when LLMs are used to generate synthetic dialogues for training and evaluation, since LLM--LLM conversations can accumulate identity-related failures such as persona drift, role confusion, and "echoing", where one agent gradually mirrors its partner. We introduce SPASM (Stable Persona-driven Agent Simulation for Multi-turn dialogue generation), a modular, stability-first framework that decomposes simulation into (i) persona creation via schema sampling, plausibility validation, and natural-language persona crafting, (ii) Client--Responder dialogue generation, and (iii) termination detection for coherent stopping. To improve long-horizon stability without changing model weights, we propose Egocentric Context Projection (ECP): dialogue history is stored in a perspective-agnostic representation and deterministically projected into each agent's egocentric view before generation. Across three LLM backbones (GPT-4o-mini, DeepSeek-V3.2, Qwen-Plus) and nine Client--Responder pairings, we construct a dataset of 4,500 personas and 45,000 conversations (500 personas X 10 conversations per pairing). Ablations show ECP substantially reduces persona drift and, under human validation, eliminates echoing; embedding analyses recover persona structure and reveal strong responder-driven interaction geometry. Our code is available at https://github.com/lhannnn/SPASM.

AI.tldr: SPASM框架通过角色创建、对话生成和终止检测三个模块，结合自我中心上下文投影技术，解决了多轮对话中角色漂移和回声问题，显著提升了LLM对话的稳定性。
AI.motivation: 大型语言模型在多轮对话应用中存在角色漂移、角色混淆和"回声"等身份相关故障，这些问题在生成用于训练和评估的合成对话时尤为关键，需要提高对话的长期稳定性。
AI.method: 提出SPASM框架，包含三个模块：1)通过模式采样、合理性验证和自然语言角色创建进行角色构建；2)客户端-响应者对话生成；3)终止检测实现连贯停止。核心创新是自我中心上下文投影技术，将对话历史存储在视角无关的表示中，并在生成前确定性地投影到每个代理的自我中心视图中。
AI.result: 在三个LLM骨干网络和九种客户端-响应者配对中构建了包含4,500个角色和45,000个对话的数据集。消融实验显示ECP显著减少了角色漂移，在人工验证下消除了回声问题；嵌入分析恢复了角色结构并揭示了强烈的响应者驱动交互几何。
AI.conclusion: SPASM框架通过模块化设计和ECP技术，在不改变模型权重的情况下有效解决了多轮对话中的稳定性问题，为生成可靠的合成对话提供了系统化解决方案。

title: BlendFusion -- Scalable Synthetic Data Generation for Diffusion Model Training
summary: With the rapid adoption of diffusion models, synthetic data generation has emerged as a promising approach for addressing the growing demand for large-scale image datasets. However, images generated purely by diffusion models often exhibit visual inconsistencies, and training models on such data can create an autophagous feedback loop that leads to model collapse, commonly referred to as Model Autophagy Disorder (MAD). To address these challenges, we propose BlendFusion, a scalable framework for synthetic data generation from 3D scenes using path tracing. Our pipeline incorporates an object-centric camera placement strategy, robust filtering mechanisms, and automatic captioning to produce high-quality image-caption pairs. Using this pipeline, we curate FineBLEND, an image-caption dataset constructed from a diverse set of 3D scenes. We empirically analyze the quality of FineBLEND and compare it to several widely used image-caption datasets. We also demonstrate the effectiveness of our object-centric camera placement strategy relative to object-agnostic sampling approaches. Our open-source framework is designed for high configurability, enabling the community to create their own datasets from 3D scenes.

AI.tldr: BlendFusion是一个从3D场景生成高质量合成图像-文本对的可扩展框架，旨在解决扩散模型生成数据存在的视觉不一致和模型自噬问题。
AI.motivation: 随着扩散模型的快速采用，合成数据生成成为满足大规模图像数据集需求的有前景方法。然而，纯扩散模型生成的图像常存在视觉不一致问题，且在此类数据上训练模型会导致自噬反馈循环和模型崩溃（模型自噬障碍MAD）。
AI.method: 提出BlendFusion框架，使用路径追踪从3D场景生成合成数据。采用以对象为中心的相机放置策略、鲁棒过滤机制和自动标注，生成高质量图像-文本对。构建了FineBLEND数据集。
AI.result: 创建了FineBLEND图像-文本数据集，并实证分析了其质量，与多个广泛使用的图像-文本数据集进行比较。证明了以对象为中心的相机放置策略相对于对象无关采样方法的有效性。
AI.conclusion: BlendFusion是一个开源、高度可配置的框架，使社区能够从3D场景创建自己的数据集，为解决扩散模型生成数据的质量问题提供了有效方案。

title: ScheMatiQ: From Research Question to Structured Data through Interactive Schema Discovery
summary: Many disciplines pose natural-language research questions over large document collections whose answers typically require structured evidence, traditionally obtained by manually designing an annotation schema and exhaustively labeling the corpus, a slow and error-prone process. We introduce ScheMatiQ, which leverages calls to a backbone LLM to take a question and a corpus to produce a schema and a grounded database, with a web interface that lets steer and revise the extraction. In collaboration with domain experts, we show that ScheMatiQ yields outputs that support real-world analysis in law and computational biology. We release ScheMatiQ as open source with a public web interface, and invite experts across disciplines to use it with their own data. All resources, including the website, source code, and demonstration video, are available at: www.ScheMatiQ-ai.com

AI.tldr: ScheMatiQ是一个利用大语言模型从文档集合中自动生成结构化证据数据库的系统，通过网页界面支持专家引导和修订提取过程，已在法律和计算生物学领域验证其实际应用价值。
AI.motivation: 传统上，从大规模文档集合中提取结构化证据需要手动设计标注方案并进行详尽标注，这个过程既缓慢又容易出错。许多学科的研究问题需要从大量文档中获取结构化证据来回答自然语言问题。
AI.method: ScheMatiQ利用骨干大语言模型，根据问题和语料库自动生成标注方案和基于证据的数据库。系统提供网页界面，允许用户引导和修订提取过程，支持迭代优化。
AI.result: 通过与领域专家合作，ScheMatiQ在法律和计算生物学领域产生了支持实际分析的结果。系统已作为开源软件发布，并提供公共网页界面，供各领域专家使用自己的数据。
AI.conclusion: ScheMatiQ提供了一种自动化、可交互的方法，能够从大规模文档集合中高效提取结构化证据，解决了传统手动标注方法的局限性，具有跨学科应用的潜力。

title: CAD 100K: A Comprehensive Multi-Task Dataset for Car Related Visual Anomaly Detection
summary:
Multi-task visual anomaly detection is critical for car-related manufacturing quality assessment. However, existing methods remain task-specific, hindered by the absence of a unified benchmark for multi-task evaluation. To fill in this gap, We present the CAD Dataset, a large-scale and comprehensive benchmark designed for car-related multi-task visual anomaly detection. The dataset contains over 100
  images crossing 7 vehicle domains and 3 tasks, providing models a comprehensive view for car-related anomaly detection. It is the first car-related anomaly dataset specialized for multi-task learning(MTL), while combining synthesis data augmentation for few-shot anomaly images. We implement a multi-task baseline and conduct extensive empirical studies. Results show MTL promotes task interaction and knowledge transfer, while also exposing challenging conflicts between tasks. The CAD dataset serves as a standardized platform to drive future advances in car-related multi-task visual anomaly detection.

AI.tldr: 提出了CAD数据集，这是一个用于汽车相关多任务视觉异常检测的大规模综合基准，包含7个车辆领域和3个任务的100多张图像，首次专门针对多任务学习设计，并采用合成数据增强处理少样本异常图像。
AI.motivation: 现有的汽车制造质量评估中的视觉异常检测方法都是任务特定的，缺乏统一的多任务评估基准，阻碍了多任务视觉异常检测的发展。
AI.method: 构建了CAD数据集，包含7个车辆领域和3个任务的100多张图像，专门为多任务学习设计，结合合成数据增强来处理少样本异常图像问题，并实现了多任务基线模型进行实证研究。
AI.result: 多任务学习促进了任务间的交互和知识转移，但也暴露了任务间的冲突挑战。CAD数据集为汽车相关多任务视觉异常检测提供了标准化平台。
AI.conclusion: CAD数据集填补了汽车相关多任务视觉异常检测基准的空白，推动了该领域的发展，多任务学习在促进知识转移的同时也面临任务冲突的挑战。

title: EthicMind: A Risk-Aware Framework for Ethical-Emotional Alignment in Multi-Turn Dialogue
comment: 18 pages, Accepted to the ACL 2026 Main Conference
summary: Intelligent dialogue systems are increasingly deployed in emotionally and ethically sensitive settings, where failures in either emotional attunement or ethical judgment can cause significant harm. Existing dialogue models typically address empathy and ethical safety in isolation, and often fail to adapt their behavior as ethical risk and user emotion evolve across multi-turn interactions. We formulate ethical-emotional alignment in dialogue as an explicit turn-level decision problem, and propose \textsc{EthicMind}, a risk-aware framework that implements this formulation in multi-turn dialogue at inference time. At each turn, \textsc{EthicMind} jointly analyzes ethical risk signals and user emotion, plans a high-level response strategy, and generates context-sensitive replies that balance ethical guidance with emotional engagement, without requiring additional model training. To evaluate alignment behavior under ethically complex interactions, we introduce a risk-stratified, multi-turn evaluation protocol with a context-aware user simulation procedure. Experimental results show that \textsc{EthicMind} achieves more consistent ethical guidance and emotional engagement than competitive baselines, particularly in high-risk and morally ambiguous scenarios.

AI.tldr: EthicMind是一个风险感知的对话框架，能在推理时联合分析伦理风险和用户情绪，在多轮对话中实现伦理-情感对齐，无需额外模型训练。
AI.motivation: 现有对话模型通常孤立处理同理心和伦理安全，无法在多轮交互中随着伦理风险和用户情绪变化而调整行为，这在情感和伦理敏感场景中可能导致严重伤害。
AI.method: 将伦理-情感对齐形式化为显式的轮次级决策问题，提出EthicMind框架：在每轮对话中联合分析伦理风险信号和用户情绪，规划高级响应策略，生成平衡伦理指导和情感参与的上下文敏感回复。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，EthicMind比竞争基线实现了更一致的伦理指导和情感参与，特别是在高风险和道德模糊场景中表现更优。
AI.conclusion: EthicMind框架能够有效解决多轮对话中的伦理-情感对齐问题，在推理时实现风险感知的响应生成，为情感和伦理敏感场景中的对话系统提供了实用解决方案。

title: Leave My Images Alone: Preventing Multi-Modal Large Language Models from Analyzing Images via Visual Prompt Injection
summary: Multi-modal large language models (MLLMs) have emerged as powerful tools for analyzing Internet-scale image data, offering significant benefits but also raising critical safety and societal concerns. In particular, open-weight MLLMs may be misused to extract sensitive information from personal images at scale, such as identities, locations, or other private details. In this work, we propose ImageProtector, a user-side method that proactively protects images before sharing by embedding a carefully crafted, nearly imperceptible perturbation that acts as a visual prompt injection attack on MLLMs. As a result, when an adversary analyzes a protected image with an MLLM, the MLLM is consistently induced to generate a refusal response such as "I'm sorry, I can't help with that request." We empirically demonstrate the effectiveness of ImageProtector across six MLLMs and four datasets. Additionally, we evaluate three potential countermeasures, Gaussian noise, DiffPure, and adversarial training, and show that while they partially mitigate the impact of ImageProtector, they simultaneously degrade model accuracy and/or efficiency. Our study focuses on the practically important setting of open-weight MLLMs and large-scale automated image analysis, and highlights both the promise and the limitations of perturbation-based privacy protection.

AI.tldr: ImageProtector是一种用户端图像保护方法，通过在图像中嵌入几乎不可见的扰动，使多模态大语言模型在处理受保护图像时生成拒绝响应，从而防止敏感信息被提取。
AI.motivation: 多模态大语言模型虽然能分析海量图像数据，但也带来安全和隐私风险，特别是开源模型可能被滥用来大规模提取个人图像中的敏感信息（如身份、位置等私人细节）。
AI.method: 提出ImageProtector方法，在用户分享图像前主动保护图像，通过嵌入精心设计的、几乎不可见的扰动作为视觉提示注入攻击，诱导MLLM生成拒绝响应。
AI.result: 在6个MLLM和4个数据集上验证了ImageProtector的有效性。评估了三种对抗措施（高斯噪声、DiffPure、对抗训练），发现它们虽然能部分缓解ImageProtector的影响，但同时会降低模型准确性和/或效率。
AI.conclusion: 该研究聚焦于开源MLLM和大规模自动化图像分析的实际重要场景，强调了基于扰动的隐私保护的潜力和局限性。

title: Task-Aware LLM Routing with Multi-Level Task-Profile-Guided Data Synthesis for Cold-Start Scenarios
summary: Large language models (LLMs) exhibit substantial variability in performance and computational cost across tasks and queries, motivating routing systems that select models to meet user-specific cost-performance trade-offs. However, existing routers generalize poorly in cold-start scenarios where in-domain training data is unavailable. We address this limitation with a multi-level task-profile-guided data synthesis framework that constructs a hierarchical task taxonomy and produces diverse question-answer pairs to approximate the test-time query distribution. Building on this, we introduce TRouter, a task-type-aware router approach that models query-conditioned cost and performance via latent task-type variables, with prior regularization derived from the synthesized task taxonomy. This design enhances TRouter's routing utility under both cold-start and in-domain settings. Across multiple benchmarks, we show that our synthesis framework alleviates cold-start issues and that TRouter delivers effective LLM routing.

AI.tldr: 提出TRouter框架解决LLM路由中的冷启动问题，通过任务层次分类和合成数据增强路由性能
AI.motivation: 现有LLM路由系统在冷启动场景下泛化能力差，缺乏领域内训练数据时性能下降严重
AI.method: 采用多级任务轮廓引导的数据合成框架构建层次化任务分类，并设计TRouter任务类型感知路由器，通过潜在任务类型变量建模查询条件成本和性能
AI.result: 在多个基准测试中，合成框架有效缓解冷启动问题，TRouter在冷启动和领域内设置下都能提供有效的LLM路由
AI.conclusion: 提出的数据合成框架和TRouter路由器显著改善了LLM路由的冷启动性能，为实际部署提供了实用解决方案

title: Skill-Conditioned Visual Geolocation for Vision-Language
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) have shown a promising ability in image geolocation, but they still lack structured geographic reasoning and the capacity for autonomous self-evolution. Existing methods predominantly rely on implicit parametric memory, which often exploits outdated knowledge and generates hallucinated reasoning. Furthermore, current inference is a "one-off" process, lacking the feedback loops necessary for self-evolution based on reasoning outcomes. To address these issues, we propose GeoSkill, a training-free framework based on an evolving Skill-Graph. We first initialize the graph by refining human expert trajectories into atomic, natural-language skills. For execution, GeoSkill employs an inference model to perform direct reasoning guided by the current Skill-Graph. For continuous growth, an Autonomous Evolution mechanism leverages a larger model to conduct multiple reasoning rollouts on image-coordinate pairs sourced from web-scale data and verified real-world reasoning. By analyzing both successful and failed trajectories from these rollouts, the mechanism iteratively synthesizes and prunes skills, effectively expanding the Skill-Graph and correcting geographic biases without any parameter updates. Experiments demonstrate that GeoSkill achieves promising performance in both geolocation accuracy and reasoning faithfulness on GeoRC, while maintaining superior generalization across diverse external datasets. Furthermore, our autonomous evolution fosters the emergence of novel, verifiable skills, significantly enhancing the system's cognition of real-world geographic knowledge beyond isolated case studies.

AI.tldr: GeoSkill：基于演化技能图的训练免费框架，用于提升视觉语言模型的地理定位能力，通过自主演化机制增强结构化地理推理和持续学习能力
AI.motivation: 现有视觉语言模型在地理定位中缺乏结构化地理推理能力和自主演化能力，主要依赖隐式参数化记忆，容易产生过时知识和幻觉推理，且推理过程缺乏基于结果的反馈循环
AI.method: 提出GeoSkill框架，基于演化技能图：1）通过精炼专家轨迹初始化技能图为原子级自然语言技能；2）使用推理模型在当前技能图指导下进行直接推理；3）通过自主演化机制，利用更大模型在网页规模数据上进行多次推理推演，分析成功和失败轨迹来迭代合成和修剪技能，扩展技能图并纠正地理偏见
AI.result: 实验表明GeoSkill在GeoRC数据集上实现了有前景的地理定位准确性和推理忠实度，同时在多样化外部数据集上保持优越的泛化能力，自主演化促进了新颖、可验证技能的出现，显著增强了系统对现实世界地理知识的认知
AI.conclusion: GeoSkill通过演化技能图和自主演化机制，有效解决了现有视觉语言模型在地理定位中缺乏结构化推理和持续学习能力的问题，实现了无需参数更新的知识扩展和偏见纠正，为地理推理系统提供了新的发展方向

title: Automated Instruction Revision (AIR): A Structured Comparison of Task Adaptation Strategies for LLM
summary: This paper studies Automated Instruction Revision (AIR), a rule-induction-based method for adapting large language models (LLMs) to downstream tasks using limited task-specific examples. We position AIR within the broader landscape of adaptation strategies, including prompt optimization, retrieval-based methods, and fine-tuning. We then compare these approaches across a diverse benchmark suite designed to stress different task requirements, such as knowledge injection, structured extraction, label remapping, and logical reasoning. The paper argues that adaptation performance is strongly task-dependent: no single method dominates across all settings. Across five benchmarks, AIR was strongest or near-best on label-remapping classification, while KNN retrieval performed best on closed-book QA, and fine-tuning dominated structured extraction and event-order reasoning. AIR is most promising when task behavior can be captured by compact, interpretable instruction rules, while retrieval and fine-tuning remain stronger in tasks dominated by source-specific knowledge or dataset-specific annotation regularities.

AI.tldr: AIR是一种基于规则归纳的方法，通过有限任务示例来适应LLMs，性能表现因任务类型而异，没有单一方法在所有任务上表现最优。
AI.motivation: 研究如何有效适应大型语言模型到下游任务，比较不同适应策略（包括提示优化、检索方法、微调等）在不同任务类型上的表现，探索任务依赖性的适应方法选择。
AI.method: 提出Automated Instruction Revision (AIR)方法，基于规则归纳从有限任务示例中学习，将LLMs适应到下游任务。在五个基准测试上比较AIR与其他方法（KNN检索、微调等）在不同任务要求下的表现。
AI.result: 适应性能强烈依赖于任务类型：没有单一方法在所有设置中占优。AIR在标签重映射分类任务上表现最强或接近最佳；KNN检索在闭卷问答中表现最好；微调在结构化提取和事件顺序推理任务中占主导。
AI.conclusion: AIR在任务行为可以通过紧凑、可解释的指令规则捕获时最有前景，而检索和微调在由特定源知识或数据集特定标注规律主导的任务中仍然更强。适应方法的选择应基于任务特性。

title: NTIRE 2026 The 3rd Restore Any Image Model (RAIM) Challenge: Multi-Exposure Image Fusion in Dynamic Scenes (Track 2)
summary: This paper presents NTIRE 2026, the 3rd Restore Any Image Model (RAIM) challenge on multi-exposure image fusion in dynamic scenes. We introduce a benchmark that targets a practical yet difficult HDR imaging setting, where exposure bracketing must be fused under scene motion, illumination variation, and handheld camera jitter. The challenge data contains 100 training sequences with 7 exposure levels and 100 test sequences with 5 exposure levels, reflecting real-world scenarios that frequently cause misalignment and ghosting artefacts. We evaluate submissions with a leaderboard score derived from PSNR, SSIM, and LPIPS, while also considering perceptual quality, efficiency, and reproducibility during the final review. This track attracted 114 participating teams and received 987 submissions. The winning methods significantly improved the ability to remove artifacts from multi-exposure fusion and recover fine details. The dataset and the code of each team can be found at the repository: https://github.com/qulishen/RAIM-HDR.

AI.tldr: NTIRE 2026 RAIM挑战赛专注于动态场景下的多曝光图像融合，解决场景运动、光照变化和手持抖动导致的错位和重影问题，吸引了114个团队参与并显著提升了去伪影和细节恢复能力。
AI.motivation: 解决动态场景中多曝光图像融合的实际难题，包括场景运动、光照变化和手持相机抖动导致的错位和重影伪影，提升HDR成像在真实场景中的实用性。
AI.method: 建立包含100个训练序列（7个曝光级别）和100个测试序列（5个曝光级别）的基准数据集，通过PSNR、SSIM和LPIPS综合评分评估算法性能，同时考虑感知质量、效率和可复现性。
AI.result: 挑战赛吸引了114个团队参与，收到987份提交，获胜方法显著提升了多曝光融合的去伪影能力和细节恢复效果。
AI.conclusion: NTIRE 2026 RAIM挑战赛成功推动了动态场景下多曝光图像融合技术的发展，提供了实用的基准数据集和开源代码，为HDR成像的实际应用提供了重要参考。

title: UIPress: Bringing Optical Token Compression to UI-to-Code Generation
summary: UI-to-Code generation requires vision-language models (VLMs) to produce thousands of tokens of structured HTML/CSS from a single screenshot, making visual token efficiency critical. Existing compression methods either select tokens at inference time using task-agnostic heuristics, or zero out low-attention features without actually shortening the sequence -- neither truly reduces prefill latency or adapts to the non-uniform information density of UI screenshots. Meanwhile, optical (encoder-side learned) compression has shown strong results for document OCR, yet no prior work has adapted this paradigm to UI-to-Code generation. We propose UIPress, a lightweight learned compression module inserted between the frozen ViT encoder and the LLM decoder of Qwen3-VL-8B. UIPress combines depthwise-separable convolutions, element-guided spatial reweighting, and Transformer refinement to compress ${\sim}$6{,}700 visual tokens to a fixed budget of 256. Together with Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) on the decoder to bridge the representation gap, the entire system adds only ${\sim}$21.7M trainable parameters (0.26\% of the 8B base model). Under a fair comparison on the same base model against four baselines on Design2Code, UIPress at 256 tokens achieves a CLIP score of 0.8127, outperforming the uncompressed baseline by +7.5\% and the strongest inference-time method by +4.6\%, while delivering 9.1$\times$ time-to-first-token speedup. To the best of our knowledge, UIPress is the first encoder-side learned compression method for the UI-to-Code task.

AI.tldr: UIPress：首个针对UI到代码生成任务的编码器端学习压缩方法，通过轻量级压缩模块将约6700个视觉token压缩到256个固定预算，在保持性能的同时实现9.1倍的首token生成加速。
AI.motivation: UI到代码生成需要视觉语言模型从单张截图生成大量结构化HTML/CSS代码，视觉token效率至关重要。现有压缩方法要么使用任务无关启发式方法在推理时选择token，要么在不实际缩短序列的情况下置零低注意力特征，都无法真正减少预填充延迟或适应UI截图的非均匀信息密度。
AI.method: 提出UIPress轻量级学习压缩模块，插入在冻结的ViT编码器和LLM解码器之间。结合深度可分离卷积、元素引导的空间重加权和Transformer精炼，将约6700个视觉token压缩到256个固定预算。同时使用低秩适应（LoRA）在解码器上弥合表示差距，整个系统仅增加约2170万个可训练参数（占8B基础模型的0.26%）。
AI.result: 在Design2Code基准测试中，UIPress在256个token下获得0.8127的CLIP分数，比未压缩基线提升7.5%，比最强推理时方法提升4.6%，同时实现9.1倍的首token生成加速。
AI.conclusion: UIPress是首个针对UI到代码生成任务的编码器端学习压缩方法，通过高效压缩视觉token显著提升推理速度，同时保持甚至超越原始模型的生成质量。

title: Many-Tier Instruction Hierarchy in LLM Agents
summary: Large language model agents receive instructions from many sources-system messages, user prompts, tool outputs, and more-each carrying different levels of trust and authority. When these instructions conflict, models must reliably follow the highest-privilege instruction to remain safe and effective. The dominant paradigm, instruction hierarchy (IH), assumes a fixed, small set of privilege levels (typically fewer than five) defined by rigid role labels (e.g., system > user). This is inadequate for real-world agentic settings, where conflicts can arise across far more sources and contexts. In this work, we propose Many-Tier Instruction Hierarchy (ManyIH), a paradigm for resolving instruction conflicts among instructions with arbitrarily many privilege levels. We introduce ManyIH-Bench, the first benchmark for ManyIH. ManyIH-Bench requires models to navigate up to 12 levels of conflicting instructions with varying privileges, comprising 853 agentic tasks (427 coding and 426 instruction-following). ManyIH-Bench composes constraints developed by LLMs and verified by humans to create realistic and difficult test cases spanning 46 real-world agents. Our experiments show that even the current frontier models perform poorly (~40% accuracy) when instruction conflict scales. This work underscores the urgent need for methods that explicitly target fine-grained, scalable instruction conflict resolution in agentic settings.

AI.tldr: 论文提出ManyIH框架解决LLM代理中多层级指令冲突问题，创建包含12个权限级别、853个任务的ManyIH-Bench基准测试，发现前沿模型在指令冲突扩展时表现不佳（约40%准确率）。
AI.motivation: 当前指令层级（IH）范式假设固定的少数权限级别（通常少于5个），使用僵化的角色标签（如系统>用户），这在现实世界代理设置中不足，因为冲突可能来自更多来源和上下文。需要解决任意多权限级别的指令冲突问题。
AI.method: 提出Many-Tier Instruction Hierarchy（ManyIH）范式，用于解决具有任意多权限级别的指令冲突。引入ManyIH-Bench基准测试，包含12个权限级别的冲突指令，涵盖853个代理任务（427个编码和426个指令遵循任务），使用LLM开发并由人类验证的约束创建现实且困难的测试用例。
AI.result: 实验显示，即使当前的前沿模型在指令冲突扩展时表现也很差（约40%准确率）。ManyIH-Bench包含46个真实世界代理的测试用例，突显了现有方法在细粒度、可扩展指令冲突解决方面的不足。
AI.conclusion: 这项工作强调了在代理设置中明确针对细粒度、可扩展指令冲突解决方法的迫切需求。ManyIH框架和ManyIH-Bench基准为评估和改进LLM代理在复杂指令冲突场景中的表现提供了重要工具。

title: Scene-Agnostic Object-Centric Representation Learning for 3D Gaussian Splatting
summary: Recent works on 3D scene understanding leverage 2D masks from visual foundation models (VFMs) to supervise radiance fields, enabling instance-level 3D segmentation. However, the supervision signals from foundation models are not fundamentally object-centric and often require additional mask pre/post-processing or specialized training and loss design to resolve mask identity conflicts across views. The learned identity of the 3D scene is scene-dependent, limiting generalizability across scenes. Therefore, we propose a dataset-level, object-centric supervision scheme to learn object representations in 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS). Building on a pre-trained slot attention-based Global Object Centric Learning (GOCL) module, we learn a scene-agnostic object codebook that provides consistent, identity-anchored representations across views and scenes. By coupling the codebook with the module's unsupervised object masks, we can directly supervise the identity features of 3D Gaussians without additional mask pre-/post-processing or explicit multi-view alignment. The learned scene-agnostic codebook enables object supervision and identification without per-scene fine-tuning or retraining. Our method thus introduces unsupervised object-centric learning (OCL) into 3DGS, yielding more structured representations and better generalization for downstream tasks such as robotic interaction, scene understanding, and cross-scene generalization.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一种数据集级别的对象中心监督方案，用于3D高斯泼溅中的对象表示学习，通过预训练的槽注意力GOCL模块学习场景无关的对象码本，避免了传统方法中的掩码预处理/后处理和显式多视图对齐需求。
AI.motivation: 现有3D场景理解方法利用视觉基础模型的2D掩码来监督辐射场，但这些监督信号本质上不是对象中心的，需要额外的掩码预处理/后处理或专门训练来解决跨视图掩码身份冲突，且学习到的3D场景身份是场景依赖的，限制了跨场景泛化能力。
AI.method: 基于预训练的槽注意力全局对象中心学习(GOCL)模块，学习场景无关的对象码本，提供跨视图和跨场景的一致、身份锚定表示。通过将码本与模块的无监督对象掩码耦合，可以直接监督3D高斯的身份特征，无需额外的掩码预处理/后处理或显式多视图对齐。
AI.result: 学习到的场景无关码本能够在无需逐场景微调或重新训练的情况下实现对象监督和识别，将无监督对象中心学习引入3D高斯泼溅，产生更结构化的表示和更好的下游任务泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: 该方法通过数据集级别的对象中心监督方案，解决了现有方法在跨视图身份一致性和跨场景泛化方面的限制，为机器人交互、场景理解和跨场景泛化等下游任务提供了更好的基础。

title: From Reasoning to Agentic: Credit Assignment in Reinforcement Learning for Large Language Models
summary:
Reinforcement learning (RL) for large language models (LLMs) increasingly relies on sparse, outcome-level rewards -- yet determining which actions within a long trajectory caused the outcome remains difficult. This credit assignment (CA) problem manifests in two regimes: reasoning RL, where credit must be distributed across tokens and steps within a single chain-of-thought generation (500--30K+ tokens); and agentic RL, where multi-turn environment interaction introduces stochastic transitions, partial observability, and horizons of 100+ turns (100K--1M tokens), making episode-level credit increasingly uninformative.
  We survey 47 CA methods (41 core, 6 adjacent enablers) published between 2024 and early 2026, organizing them in a two-dimensional taxonomy by assignment granularity (token, segment, step, turn, multi-agent) and methodology (Monte Carlo, temporal difference, model-based, game-theoretic, information-theoretic). Beyond the survey itself, we contribute three reusable resources: (1) a structured, machine-readable paper inventory with taxonomy labels, baseline families, and evidence levels; (2) a reporting checklist for future CA papers, validated against the reviewed literature to identify systematic methodological gaps; and (3) a benchmark protocol specification with task families, metadata requirements, and controlled bifurcation tasks, accompanied by a method selection decision tree.
  Our synthesis suggests that the shift from reasoning to agentic RL complicates and reshapes the credit assignment landscape: reasoning CA is maturing around process reward models and critic-free group comparison, while agentic CA is driving genuinely new approaches -- hindsight counterfactual analysis, privileged asymmetric critics, and turn-level MDP reformulations -- that have no direct precedent in reasoning RL.

AI.tldr: 该论文系统综述了2024-2026年间47种大语言模型强化学习中的信用分配方法，提出了二维分类法，并为未来研究提供了结构化资源、报告清单和基准协议。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型强化学习中稀疏的结局级奖励难以确定长轨迹中哪些动作导致了结果，这种信用分配问题在推理RL（500-30K+ tokens）和代理RL（100K-1M tokens）中尤为突出，需要系统梳理现有解决方案。
AI.method: 采用文献综述方法，分析47种信用分配方法（41种核心方法，6种相邻支持方法），构建二维分类法：按分配粒度（token、片段、步骤、回合、多智能体）和方法论（蒙特卡洛、时序差分、基于模型、博弈论、信息论）。
AI.result: 提供了三个可重用资源：1）结构化、机器可读的论文清单；2）经文献验证的未来信用分配论文报告清单；3）包含任务族、元数据要求和控制分叉任务的基准协议规范及方法选择决策树。
AI.conclusion: 从推理RL到代理RL的转变重塑了信用分配格局：推理信用分配围绕过程奖励模型和无批评者群体比较趋于成熟，而代理信用分配推动了全新的方法（事后反事实分析、特权不对称批评者、回合级MDP重构），这些在推理RL中没有直接先例。

title: Text-Conditioned Multi-Expert Regression Framework for Fully Automated Multi-Abutment Design
summary: Dental implant abutments serve as the geometric and biomechanical interface between the implant fixture and the prosthetic crown, yet their design relies heavily on manual effort and is time-consuming. Although deep neural networks have been proposed to assist dentists in designing abutments, most existing approaches remain largely manual or semi-automated, requiring substantial clinician intervention and lacking scalability in multi-abutment scenarios. To address these limitations, we propose TEMAD, a fully automated, text-conditioned multi-expert architecture for multi-abutment design. This framework integrates implant site localization and implant system, compatible abutment parameter regression into a unified pipeline. Specifically, we introduce an Implant Site Identification Network (ISIN) to automatically localize implant sites and provide this information to the subsequent multi-abutment regression network. We further design a Tooth-Conditioned Feature-wise Linear Modulation (TC-FiLM) module, which adaptively calibrates mesh representations using tooth embeddings to enable position-specific feature modulation. Additionally, a System-Prompted Mixture-of-Experts (SPMoE) mechanism leverages implant system prompts to guide expert selection, ensuring system-aware regression. Extensive experiments on a large-scale abutment design dataset show that TEMAD achieves state-of-the-art performance compared to existing methods, particularly in multi-abutment settings, validating its effectiveness for fully automated dental implant planning.

AI.tldr: TEMAD是一个完全自动化的文本条件多专家架构，用于多基台设计，通过整合种植体位置定位、系统识别和基台参数回归，实现全自动牙科种植规划。
AI.motivation: 目前牙科种植基台设计主要依赖手动操作，耗时且效率低。现有深度学习辅助方法多为半自动化，需要大量临床干预，在多基台场景下缺乏可扩展性。
AI.method: 提出TEMAD框架：1）植入部位识别网络（ISIN）自动定位种植体位置；2）牙齿条件特征线性调制模块（TC-FiLM）使用牙齿嵌入自适应校准网格表示；3）系统提示专家混合机制（SPMoE）利用种植体系统提示指导专家选择。
AI.result: 在大规模基台设计数据集上的实验表明，TEMAD相比现有方法取得了最先进的性能，特别是在多基台设置中，验证了其全自动牙科种植规划的有效性。
AI.conclusion: TEMAD通过完全自动化的多基台设计框架，解决了现有方法需要大量手动干预的问题，为牙科种植规划提供了可扩展的解决方案。

title: Across the Levels of Analysis: Explaining Predictive Processing in Humans Requires More Than Machine-Estimated Probabilities
comment: 9 pages, Behavioral & Brain Sciences Commentary on Futrell & Mahowald (forthcoming)
summary: Under the lens of Marr's levels of analysis, we critique and extend two claims about language models (LMs) and language processing: first, that predicting upcoming linguistic information based on context is central to language processing, and second, that many advances in psycholinguistics would be impossible without large language models (LLMs). We further outline future directions that combine the strengths of LLMs with psycholinguistic models.

AI.tldr: 该论文从Marr分析层次的角度，批判性地审视并扩展了关于语言模型与语言处理的两个主张，并提出了结合LLMs与心理语言学模型优势的未来方向。
AI.motivation: 论文旨在从Marr的分析层次理论框架出发，重新审视当前关于语言模型在语言处理中作用的两个核心主张，为理解LLMs与人类语言处理的关联提供更系统的理论视角。
AI.method: 采用Marr的分析层次理论（计算、算法、实现三个层次）作为分析框架，对语言模型的两个核心主张进行批判性分析，并提出理论整合方案。
AI.result: 论文对两个主张进行了批判性扩展：1）基于上下文预测语言信息确实是语言处理的核心，但需要更精细的理论解释；2）LLMs确实推动了心理语言学发展，但需要更系统的理论整合。
AI.conclusion: 未来研究应结合LLMs的计算优势与心理语言学模型的认知解释力，建立更完善的语言处理理论框架，促进计算语言学与认知科学的交叉融合。

title: Agentic Jackal: Live Execution and Semantic Value Grounding for Text-to-JQL
summary: Translating natural language into Jira Query Language (JQL) requires resolving ambiguous field references, instance-specific categorical values, and complex Boolean predicates. Single-pass LLMs cannot discover which categorical values (e.g., component names or fix versions) actually exist in a given Jira instance, nor can they verify generated queries against a live data source, limiting accuracy on paraphrased or ambiguous requests. No open, execution-based benchmark exists for mapping natural language to JQL. We introduce Jackal, the first large-scale, execution-based text-to-JQL benchmark comprising 100,000 validated NL-JQL pairs on a live Jira instance with over 200,000 issues. To establish baselines on Jackal, we propose Agentic Jackal, a tool-augmented agent that equips LLMs with live query execution via the Jira MCP server and JiraAnchor, a semantic retrieval tool that resolves natural-language mentions of categorical values through embedding-based similarity search. Among 9 frontier LLMs evaluated, single-pass models average only 43.4% execution accuracy on short natural-language queries, highlighting that text-to-JQL remains an open challenge. The agentic approach improves 7 of 9 models, with a 9.0% relative gain on the most linguistically challenging variant; in a controlled ablation isolating JiraAnchor, categorical-value accuracy rises from 48.7% to 71.7%, with component-field accuracy jumping from 16.9% to 66.2%. Our analysis identifies inherent semantic ambiguities, such as issue-type disambiguation and text-field selection, as the dominant failure modes rather than value-resolution errors, pointing to concrete directions for future work. We publicly release the benchmark, all agent transcripts, and evaluation code to support reproducibility.

AI.tldr: Jackal：首个基于执行的大规模文本到JQL基准测试，包含10万对验证过的自然语言-JQL对，在真实Jira实例上评估模型性能。提出Agentic Jackal代理方法，通过工具增强提升LLM在JQL生成中的准确率。
AI.motivation: 现有方法无法解决JQL生成中的关键挑战：1) 无法发现特定Jira实例中的分类值（如组件名称、修复版本）；2) 无法验证生成的查询是否能在真实数据源上执行；3) 缺乏开放、基于执行的基准测试来评估自然语言到JQL的映射能力。
AI.method: 1) 创建Jackal基准：包含10万对验证过的NL-JQL对，基于包含20万+问题的真实Jira实例；2) 提出Agentic Jackal代理框架：为LLM配备Jira MCP服务器进行实时查询执行，以及JiraAnchor语义检索工具，通过嵌入相似性搜索解析自然语言中分类值的提及；3) 评估9个前沿LLM，比较单次生成与代理方法的性能差异。
AI.result: 1) 单次生成模型在简短自然语言查询上的平均执行准确率仅为43.4%；2) 代理方法提升了9个模型中的7个性能，在最具语言挑战性的变体上获得9.0%的相对提升；3) 在隔离JiraAnchor的消融实验中，分类值准确率从48.7%提升至71.7%，组件字段准确率从16.9%跃升至66.2%；4) 主要失败模式是语义歧义（如问题类型消歧和文本字段选择），而非值解析错误。
AI.conclusion: 文本到JQL转换仍是一个开放挑战，需要专门解决语义歧义问题。工具增强的代理方法能显著提升性能，特别是在分类值解析方面。研究指出了未来工作的具体方向：解决固有的语义歧义问题。公开了基准测试、所有代理记录和评估代码以支持可复现性。

title: Tora3: Trajectory-Guided Audio-Video Generation with Physical Coherence
summary: Audio-video (AV) generation has recently made strong progress in perceptual quality and multimodal coherence, yet generating content with plausible motion-sound relations remains challenging. Existing methods often produce object motions that are visually unstable and sounds that are only loosely aligned with salient motion or contact events, largely because they lack an explicit motion-aware structure shared by video and audio generation. We present Tora3, a trajectory-guided AV generation framework that improves physical coherence by using object trajectories as a shared kinematic prior. Rather than treating trajectories as a video-only control signal, Tora3 uses them to jointly guide visual motion and acoustic events. Specifically, we design a trajectory-aligned motion representation for video, a kinematic-audio alignment module driven by trajectory-derived second-order kinematic states, and a hybrid flow matching scheme that preserves trajectory fidelity in trajectory-conditioned regions while maintaining local coherence elsewhere. We further curate PAV, a large-scale AV dataset emphasizing motion-relevant patterns with automatically extracted motion annotations. Extensive experiments show that Tora3 improves motion realism, motion-sound synchronization, and overall AV generation quality over strong open-source baselines.

AI.tldr: Tora3是一个基于轨迹引导的音频-视频生成框架，通过使用物体轨迹作为共享的运动学先验，改善了物理一致性，解决了现有方法在运动-声音关系上的不足。
AI.motivation: 当前音频-视频生成方法在感知质量和多模态一致性方面已有进步，但在生成具有合理运动-声音关系的内容方面仍面临挑战。现有方法常产生视觉不稳定的物体运动，且声音与显著运动或接触事件的对应关系松散，主要因为它们缺乏视频和音频生成共享的显式运动感知结构。
AI.method: Tora3框架使用物体轨迹作为共享的运动学先验来联合引导视觉运动和声学事件。具体包括：1) 设计轨迹对齐的运动表示用于视频生成；2) 基于轨迹导出的二阶运动学状态驱动的运动-音频对齐模块；3) 混合流匹配方案，在轨迹条件区域保持轨迹保真度，在其他区域保持局部一致性。此外还构建了PAV大规模音频-视频数据集，强调运动相关模式并带有自动提取的运动标注。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，Tora3在运动真实性、运动-声音同步性和整体音频-视频生成质量方面优于强大的开源基线方法。
AI.conclusion: Tora3通过将物体轨迹作为共享的运动学先验，显著改善了音频-视频生成的物理一致性和运动-声音关系，为多模态生成提供了更合理的运动感知结构。

title: RecaLLM: Addressing the Lost-in-Thought Phenomenon with Explicit In-Context Retrieval
comment: Code, data, and models available at https://github.com/kswhitecross/RecaLLM
summary: We propose RecaLLM, a set of reasoning language models post-trained to make effective use of long-context information. In-context retrieval, which identifies relevant evidence from context, and reasoning are deeply intertwined: retrieval supports reasoning, while reasoning often determines what must be retrieved. However, their interaction remains largely underexplored. In preliminary experiments on several open-source LLMs, we observe that in-context retrieval performance substantially degrades even after a short reasoning span, revealing a key bottleneck for test-time scaling that we refer to as lost-in-thought: reasoning steps that improve performance also make subsequent in-context retrieval more challenging. To address this limitation, RecaLLM interleaves reasoning with explicit in-context retrieval, alternating between reasoning and retrieving context information needed to solve intermediate subproblems. We introduce a negligible-overhead constrained decoding mechanism that enables verbatim copying of evidence spans, improving the grounding of subsequent generation. Trained on diverse lexical and semantic retrieval tasks, RecaLLM achieves strong performance on two long-context benchmarks, RULER and HELMET, significantly outperforming baselines. Notably, we observe consistent gains at context windows of up to 128K tokens using training samples of at most 10K tokens, far shorter than those used by existing long-context approaches, highlighting a promising path toward improving long-context performance without expensive long-context training data.

AI.tldr: RecaLLM是一种推理语言模型，通过交替进行推理和显式上下文检索来解决长上下文信息利用中的"lost-in-thought"问题，在有限训练数据下实现长上下文性能提升。
AI.motivation: 现有LLMs在长上下文推理中存在"lost-in-thought"问题：推理步骤虽然提升性能，但会使得后续的上下文检索变得更加困难，这成为测试时扩展的关键瓶颈。
AI.method: RecaLLM采用交替推理与显式上下文检索的方法，引入低开销约束解码机制实现证据片段逐字复制，在多样化词汇和语义检索任务上进行训练。
AI.result: 在RULER和HELMET两个长上下文基准测试中表现优异，显著优于基线模型。仅使用最多10K token的训练样本，就能在128K token的上下文窗口中实现持续增益。
AI.conclusion: RecaLLM提供了一条无需昂贵长上下文训练数据即可改善长上下文性能的有前景路径，通过有效整合推理与检索来解决长上下文利用的核心挑战。

title: BERT-as-a-Judge: A Robust Alternative to Lexical Methods for Efficient Reference-Based LLM Evaluation
summary: Accurate evaluation is central to the large language model (LLM) ecosystem, guiding model selection and downstream adoption across diverse use cases. In practice, however, evaluating generative outputs typically relies on rigid lexical methods to extract and assess answers, which can conflate a model's true problem-solving ability with its compliance with predefined formatting guidelines. While recent LLM-as-a-Judge approaches mitigate this issue by assessing semantic correctness rather than strict structural conformity, they also introduce substantial computational overhead, making evaluation costly. In this work, we first systematically investigate the limitations of lexical evaluation through a large-scale empirical study spanning 36 models and 15 downstream tasks, demonstrating that such methods correlate poorly with human judgments. To address this limitation, we introduce BERT-as-a-Judge, an encoder-driven approach for assessing answer correctness in reference-based generative settings, robust to variations in output phrasing, and requiring only lightweight training on synthetically annotated question-candidate-reference triplets. We show that it consistently outperforms the lexical baseline while matching the performance of much larger LLM judges, providing a compelling tradeoff between the two and enabling reliable, scalable evaluation. Finally, through extensive experimentation, we provide detailed insights into BERT-as-a-Judge's performance to offer practical guidance for practitioners, and release all project artifacts to foster downstream adoption.

AI.tldr: 本文提出BERT-as-a-Judge方法，使用轻量级编码器评估生成式模型的答案正确性，在保持高性能的同时显著降低计算成本，解决了传统词汇评估方法的问题。
AI.motivation: 当前大语言模型评估主要依赖僵化的词汇匹配方法，这种方法将模型的实际问题解决能力与预定义格式合规性混为一谈。虽然LLM-as-a-Judge方法通过评估语义正确性缓解了这一问题，但带来了巨大的计算开销。
AI.method: 提出BERT-as-a-Judge方法，这是一种基于编码器的评估方法，通过轻量级训练在合成标注的问题-候选答案-参考答案三元组上，能够鲁棒地处理输出表达的变体。
AI.result: BERT-as-a-Judge方法在36个模型和15个下游任务的大规模实证研究中，始终优于词汇基线评估方法，同时与更大的LLM评估器性能相当，提供了更好的性能-成本权衡。
AI.conclusion: BERT-as-a-Judge为生成式模型评估提供了可靠、可扩展的解决方案，在保持高性能的同时显著降低计算成本，并通过详细实验分析为实践者提供实用指导。

title: You Can't Fight in Here! This is BBS!
comment: Accepted at Behavioral and Brain Sciences as a response to the commentaries to the accepted target article "How Linguistics Learned to Stop Worrying and Love the Language Models", whose preprint appears here: arXiv:2501.17047
summary: Norm, the formal theoretical linguist, and Claudette, the computational language scientist, have a lovely time discussing whether modern language models can inform important questions in the language sciences. Just as they are about to part ways until they meet again, 25 of their closest friends show up -- from linguistics, neuroscience, cognitive science, psychology, philosophy, and computer science. We use this discussion to highlight what we see as some common underlying issues: the String Statistics Strawman (the mistaken idea that LMs can't be linguistically competent or interesting because they, like their Markov model predecessors, are statistical models that learn from strings) and the As Good As it Gets Assumption (the idea that LM research as it stands in 2026 is the limit of what it can tell us about linguistics). We clarify the role of LM-based work for scientific insights into human language and advocate for a more expansive research program for the language sciences in the AI age, one that takes on the commentators' concerns in order to produce a better and more robust science of both human language and of LMs.

AI.tldr: 本文通过Norm和Claudette的对话讨论现代语言模型能否为语言科学提供洞见，批判了"字符串统计稻草人"和"已经够好假设"两种常见误解，主张在AI时代建立更广泛的语言科学研究计划。
AI.motivation: 探讨现代语言模型对语言科学研究的潜在价值，澄清对语言模型的常见误解，推动在AI时代建立更全面、更稳健的语言科学研究框架。
AI.method: 采用对话形式，通过Norm（理论语言学家）和Claudette（计算语言科学家）的讨论，结合来自语言学、神经科学、认知科学、心理学、哲学和计算机科学等25位专家的观点，分析语言模型研究中的关键问题。
AI.result: 识别并批判了两种主要误解：1）"字符串统计稻草人"——错误认为语言模型因为基于字符串统计而不具备语言能力或研究价值；2）"已经够好假设"——认为当前（2026年）的语言模型研究已经达到了其语言学价值的极限。
AI.conclusion: 语言模型研究对理解人类语言具有重要科学价值，需要建立更广泛的研究计划，充分考虑评论者的关切，以发展出更好、更稳健的人类语言科学和语言模型科学。

title: Frequency-Enhanced Diffusion Models: Curriculum-Guided Semantic Alignment for Zero-Shot Skeleton Action Recognition
summary: Human action recognition is pivotal in computer vision, with applications ranging from surveillance to human-robot interaction. Despite the effectiveness of supervised skeleton-based methods, their reliance on exhaustive annotation limits generalization to novel actions. Zero-Shot Skeleton Action Recognition (ZSAR) emerges as a promising paradigm, yet it faces challenges due to the spectral bias of diffusion models, which oversmooth high-frequency dynamics. Here, we propose Frequency-Aware Diffusion for Skeleton-Text Matching (FDSM), integrating a Semantic-Guided Spectral Residual Module, a Timestep-Adaptive Spectral Loss, and Curriculum-based Semantic Abstraction to address these challenges. Our approach effectively recovers fine-grained motion details, achieving state-of-the-art performance on NTU RGB+D, PKU-MMD, and Kinetics-skeleton datasets. Code has been made available at https://github.com/yuzhi535/FDSM. Project homepage: https://yuzhi535.github.io/FDSM.github.io/

AI.tldr: 本文提出FDSM方法，通过频率感知扩散模型解决骨架动作识别中的频谱偏差问题，在多个数据集上实现SOTA性能。
AI.motivation: 骨架动作识别在计算机视觉中很重要，但现有监督方法依赖大量标注，难以泛化到新动作。零样本骨架动作识别面临扩散模型频谱偏差问题，会过度平滑高频动态细节。
AI.method: 提出频率感知扩散骨架-文本匹配方法(FDSM)，包含语义引导频谱残差模块、时间步自适应频谱损失和课程式语义抽象三个核心组件。
AI.result: 在NTU RGB+D、PKU-MMD和Kinetics-skeleton三个数据集上实现了最先进的性能，有效恢复了细粒度运动细节。
AI.conclusion: FDSM通过频率感知方法成功解决了零样本骨架动作识别中的频谱偏差问题，为骨架动作识别提供了有效的解决方案。

title: Many Ways to Be Fake: Benchmarking Fake News Detection Under Strategy-Driven AI Generation
summary: Recent advances in large language models (LLMs) have enabled the large-scale generation of highly fluent and deceptive news-like content. While prior work has often treated fake news detection as a binary classification problem, modern fake news increasingly arises through human-AI collaboration, where strategic inaccuracies are embedded within otherwise accurate and credible narratives. These mixed-truth cases represent a realistic and consequential threat, yet they remain underrepresented in existing benchmarks. To address this gap, we introduce MANYFAKE, a synthetic benchmark containing 6,798 fake news articles generated through multiple strategy-driven prompting pipelines that capture many ways fake news can be constructed and refined. Using this benchmark, we evaluate a range of state-of-the-art fake news detectors. Our results show that even advanced reasoning-enabled models approach saturation on fully fabricated stories, but remain brittle when falsehoods are subtle, optimized, and interwoven with accurate information.

AI.tldr: 研究者创建了MANYFAKE基准测试，包含6,798篇合成假新闻文章，用于评估现有假新闻检测器在混合真假内容中的表现，发现即使先进模型也难以检测嵌入真实叙事中的细微虚假信息。
AI.motivation: 当前假新闻检测研究多关注二元分类问题，但现实中假新闻越来越多地通过人机协作产生，将策略性虚假信息嵌入到其他方面准确可信的叙事中。这种混合真假的情况是现实且严重的威胁，但在现有基准测试中代表性不足。
AI.method: 研究者引入了MANYFAKE基准测试，包含6,798篇合成假新闻文章，这些文章通过多种策略驱动的提示管道生成，捕捉了假新闻构建和优化的多种方式。使用该基准评估了一系列最先进的假新闻检测器。
AI.result: 结果显示，即使是先进的推理模型在完全虚构的故事上接近饱和性能，但在虚假信息微妙、优化且与准确信息交织的情况下仍然脆弱。这表明现有检测器难以处理混合真假的复杂情况。
AI.conclusion: 混合真假的假新闻是一个重要且未充分研究的威胁，需要更复杂的检测方法。MANYFAKE基准为评估和改进假新闻检测器提供了重要工具，特别是在处理人机协作生成的复杂虚假内容方面。

title: Case-Grounded Evidence Verification: A Framework for Constructing Evidence-Sensitive Supervision
summary: Evidence-grounded reasoning requires more than attaching retrieved text to a prediction: a model should make decisions that depend on whether the provided evidence supports the target claim. In practice, this often fails because supervision is weak, evidence is only loosely tied to the claim, and evaluation does not test evidence dependence directly. We introduce case-grounded evidence verification, a general framework in which a model receives a local case context, external evidence, and a structured claim, and must decide whether the evidence supports the claim for that case. Our key contribution is a supervision construction procedure that generates explicit support examples together with semantically controlled non-support examples, including counterfactual wrong-state and topic-related negatives, without manual evidence annotation. We instantiate the framework in radiology and train a standard verifier on the resulting support task. The learned verifier substantially outperforms both case-only and evidence-only baselines, remains strong under correct evidence, and collapses when evidence is removed or swapped, indicating genuine evidence dependence. This behavior transfers across unseen evidence articles and an external case distribution, though performance degrades under evidence-source shift and remains sensitive to backbone choice. Overall, the results suggest that a major bottleneck in evidence grounding is not only model capacity, but the lack of supervision that encodes the causal role of evidence.

AI.tldr: 提出case-grounded证据验证框架，通过自动生成支持与非支持示例训练验证器，在放射学领域实现真正的证据依赖推理，性能显著优于基线方法。
AI.motivation: 当前证据基础推理存在三个主要问题：监督信号弱、证据与主张关联松散、评估未直接测试证据依赖性。需要开发能够真正依赖证据进行决策的模型。
AI.method: 提出case-grounded证据验证框架：模型接收局部案例上下文、外部证据和结构化主张，判断证据是否支持该案例的主张。关键贡献是监督构建程序，自动生成明确的支持示例和语义控制的非支持示例（包括反事实错误状态和主题相关负例），无需人工证据标注。在放射学领域实例化该框架，训练标准验证器。
AI.result: 学习的验证器显著优于仅案例和仅证据基线；在正确证据下保持强大性能；当证据被移除或交换时性能崩溃，表明真正的证据依赖性。该行为能够迁移到未见过的证据文章和外部案例分布，但在证据源偏移下性能下降，且对骨干网络选择敏感。
AI.conclusion: 证据基础化的主要瓶颈不仅是模型容量，还包括缺乏编码证据因果作用的监督信号。提出的框架通过自动生成监督数据解决了这一问题，实现了真正的证据依赖推理。

title: Memory-Efficient Transfer Learning with Fading Side Networks via Masked Dual Path Distillation
summary: Memory-efficient transfer learning (METL) approaches have recently achieved promising performance in adapting pre-trained models to downstream tasks. They avoid applying gradient backpropagation in large backbones, thus significantly reducing the number of trainable parameters and high memory consumption during fine-tuning. However, since they typically employ a lightweight and learnable side network, these methods inevitably introduce additional memory and time overhead during inference, which contradicts the ultimate goal of efficient transfer learning. To address the above issue, we propose a novel approach dubbed Masked Dual Path Distillation (MDPD) to accelerate inference while retaining parameter and memory efficiency in fine-tuning with fading side networks. Specifically, MDPD develops a framework that enhances the performance by mutually distilling the frozen backbones and learnable side networks in fine-tuning, and discard the side network during inference without sacrificing accuracy. Moreover, we design a novel feature-based knowledge distillation method for the encoder structure with multiple layers. Extensive experiments on distinct backbones across vision/language-only and vision-and-language tasks demonstrate that our method not only accelerates inference by at least 25.2\% while keeping parameter and memory consumption comparable, but also remarkably promotes the accuracy compared to SOTA approaches. The source code is available at https://github.com/Zhang-VKk/MDPD.

AI.tldr: 提出MDPD方法，通过掩码双路径蒸馏在微调时提升性能，推理时丢弃侧网络，实现推理加速25.2%以上，同时保持参数和内存效率
AI.motivation: 现有内存高效迁移学习方法虽然减少了训练参数和内存消耗，但推理时引入的侧网络增加了额外内存和时间开销，这与高效迁移学习的最终目标相矛盾
AI.method: 提出掩码双路径蒸馏(MDPD)框架，在微调过程中通过相互蒸馏冻结主干网络和可学习侧网络来提升性能，推理时丢弃侧网络；设计了适用于多层编码器结构的基于特征的知识蒸馏方法
AI.result: 在视觉/语言单模态及多模态任务上的实验表明，MDPD不仅保持参数和内存消耗可比，推理加速至少25.2%，而且准确率显著优于现有SOTA方法
AI.conclusion: MDPD方法成功解决了现有内存高效迁移学习方法推理效率低的问题，实现了训练时的高效性和推理时的快速性，为高效迁移学习提供了新思路

title: Large Language Models Generate Harmful Content Using a Distinct, Unified Mechanism
summary: Large language models (LLMs) undergo alignment training to avoid harmful behaviors, yet the resulting safeguards remain brittle: jailbreaks routinely bypass them, and fine-tuning on narrow domains can induce ``emergent misalignment'' that generalizes broadly. Whether this brittleness reflects a fundamental lack of coherent internal organization for harmfulness remains unclear. Here we use targeted weight pruning as a causal intervention to probe the internal organization of harmfulness in LLMs. We find that harmful content generation depends on a compact set of weights that are general across harm types and distinct from benign capabilities. Aligned models exhibit a greater compression of harm generation weights than unaligned counterparts, indicating that alignment reshapes harmful representations internally--despite the brittleness of safety guardrails at the surface level. This compression explains emergent misalignment: if weights of harmful capabilities are compressed, fine-tuning that engages these weights in one domain can trigger broad misalignment.
