Consistent with this, pruning harm generation weights in a narrow domain substantially reduces emergent misalignment. Notably, LLMs harmful generation capability is dissociated from how they recognize and explain such content. Together, these results reveal a coherent internal structure for harmfulness in LLMs that may serve as a foundation for more principled approaches to safety.

AI.tldr: 通过权重剪枝技术发现，大语言模型中的有害内容生成依赖于一组紧凑的权重，这些权重在不同有害类型间通用且与良性能力分离。对齐训练压缩了这些权重，解释了微调时出现的"涌现错位"现象。
AI.motivation: 尽管大语言模型经过对齐训练以避免有害行为，但安全防护措施仍然脆弱：越狱攻击经常绕过它们，在特定领域微调可能导致"涌现错位"。这种脆弱性是否反映了模型内部缺乏对有害性的连贯组织尚不清楚。
AI.method: 使用目标权重剪枝作为因果干预手段，探测LLM中有害性的内部组织。通过剪除特定权重来观察对有害内容生成的影响，比较对齐和未对齐模型中有害权重分布的差异。
AI.result: 发现有害内容生成依赖于一组紧凑的权重，这些权重在不同有害类型间通用且与良性能力分离。对齐模型比未对齐模型表现出更强的有害权重压缩。这种压缩解释了涌现错位现象：在特定领域微调时激活这些压缩权重会触发广泛的错位。
AI.conclusion: 大语言模型内部存在连贯的有害性结构，这种结构可能为更原则性的安全方法提供基础。有害生成能力与识别和解释此类内容的能力是分离的。

title: Off-the-shelf Vision Models Benefit Image Manipulation Localization
summary: Image manipulation localization (IML) and general vision tasks are typically treated as two separate research directions due to the fundamental differences between manipulation-specific and semantic features. In this paper, however, we bridge this gap by introducing a fresh perspective: these two directions are intrinsically connected, and general semantic priors can benefit IML. Building on this insight, we propose a novel trainable adapter (named ReVi) that repurposes existing off-the-shelf general-purpose vision models (e.g., image generation and segmentation networks) for IML. Inspired by robust principal component analysis, the adapter disentangles semantic redundancy from manipulation-specific information embedded in these models and selectively enhances the latter. Unlike existing IML methods that require extensive model redesign and full retraining, our method relies on the off-the-shelf vision models with frozen parameters and only fine-tunes the proposed adapter. The experimental results demonstrate the superiority of our method, showing the potential for scalable IML frameworks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种新颖的图像篡改定位方法ReVi，通过可训练的适配器将通用视觉模型的语义先验知识用于篡改检测，无需重新设计模型或完全重训练。
AI.motivation: 传统上图像篡改定位（IML）和通用视觉任务被视为两个独立的研究方向，因为篡改特定特征和语义特征存在根本差异。本文认为这两个方向本质上是相互关联的，通用语义先验知识可以有益于IML任务。
AI.method: 提出名为ReVi的可训练适配器，重新利用现成的通用视觉模型（如图像生成和分割网络）进行IML。受鲁棒主成分分析启发，该适配器从这些模型中解耦语义冗余和篡改特定信息，并选择性地增强后者。方法仅微调适配器，保持预训练模型参数冻结。
AI.result: 实验结果表明该方法具有优越性，展示了可扩展IML框架的潜力。相比需要大量模型重新设计和完全重训练的现有IML方法，本方法更高效且性能更好。
AI.conclusion: 成功将通用视觉模型的语义先验知识应用于图像篡改定位任务，提出了一种新颖的适配器方法，为可扩展的IML框架开辟了新途径，证明了跨领域知识迁移的有效性。

title: Physically Grounded 3D Generative Reconstruction under Hand Occlusion using Proprioception and Multi-Contact Touch
summary: We propose a multimodal, physically grounded approach for metric-scale amodal object reconstruction and pose estimation under severe hand occlusion. Unlike prior occlusion-aware 3D generation methods that rely only on vision, we leverage physical interaction signals: proprioception provides the posed hand geometry, and multi-contact touch constrains where the object surface must lie, reducing ambiguity in occluded regions. We represent object structure as a pose-aware, camera-aligned signed distance field (SDF) and learn a compact latent space with a Structure-VAE. In this latent space, we train a conditional flow-matching diffusion model, pretraining on vision-only images and finetuning on occluded manipulation scenes while conditioning on visible RGB evidence, occluder/visibility masks, the hand latent representation, and tactile information. Crucially, we incorporate physics-based objectives and differentiable decoder-guidance during finetuning and inference to reduce hand--object interpenetration and to align the reconstructed surface with contact observations. Because our method produces a metric, physically consistent structure estimate, it integrates naturally into existing two-stage reconstruction pipelines, where a downstream module refines geometry and predicts appearance. Experiments in simulation show that adding proprioception and touch substantially improves completion under occlusion and yields physically plausible reconstructions at correct real-world scale compared to vision-only baselines; we further validate transfer by deploying the model on a real humanoid robot with an end-effector different from those used during training.

AI.tldr: 提出一种多模态物理基础方法，用于在严重手部遮挡下进行度量尺度的无模态物体重建和姿态估计，通过结合视觉、本体感觉和触觉信号来减少遮挡区域的模糊性。
AI.motivation: 现有遮挡感知的3D生成方法仅依赖视觉，在严重手部遮挡情况下效果有限。本文旨在利用物理交互信号（本体感觉和触觉）来约束物体表面位置，减少遮挡区域的模糊性，实现更准确的重建。
AI.method: 使用姿态感知、相机对齐的有符号距离场(SDF)表示物体结构，通过Structure-VAE学习紧凑潜在空间。在潜在空间中训练条件流匹配扩散模型，先在仅视觉图像上预训练，然后在遮挡操纵场景上微调。微调和推理时加入基于物理的目标和可微分解码器引导，减少手-物体穿透并对齐重建表面与接触观测。
AI.result: 模拟实验表明，加入本体感觉和触觉显著改善了遮挡下的补全效果，相比仅视觉基线产生了物理上合理的重建结果，并保持了正确的真实世界尺度。模型成功部署到真实人形机器人上，验证了跨平台的迁移能力。
AI.conclusion: 多模态物理基础方法通过结合视觉、本体感觉和触觉信号，在严重手部遮挡下实现了更准确、物理一致的度量尺度物体重建，为机器人操作提供了可靠的环境感知能力。

title: Detecting Diffusion-generated Images via Dynamic Assembly ForestsDetecting Diffusion-generated Images via Dynamic Assembly Forests
summary: Diffusion models are known for generating high-quality images, causing serious security concerns. To combat this, most efforts rely on deep neural networks (e.g., CNNs and Transformers), while largely overlooking the potential of traditional machine learning models. In this paper, we freshly investigate such alternatives and proposes a novel Dynamic Assembly Forest model (DAF) to detect diffusion-generated images. Built upon the deep forest paradigm, DAF addresses the inherent limitations in feature learning and scalable training, making it an effective diffusion-generated image detector. Compared to existing DNN-based methods, DAF has significantly fewer parameters, much lower computational cost, and can be deployed without GPUs, while achieving competitive performance under standard evaluation protocols. These results highlight the strong potential of the proposed method as a practical substitute for heavyweight DNN models in resource-constrained scenarios. Our code and models are available at https://github.com/OUC-VAS/DAF.

AI.tldr: 提出基于深度森林的动态组装森林模型(DAF)用于检测扩散模型生成的图像，相比传统DNN方法参数更少、计算成本更低、无需GPU，在资源受限场景下具有实用价值。
AI.motivation: 扩散模型生成高质量图像引发安全担忧，现有检测方法主要依赖深度神经网络(CNN、Transformer)，忽视了传统机器学习模型的潜力。
AI.method: 提出动态组装森林模型(DAF)，基于深度森林范式，解决了特征学习和可扩展训练的内在限制，使其成为有效的扩散生成图像检测器。
AI.result: 相比现有DNN方法，DAF参数显著减少，计算成本大幅降低，无需GPU即可部署，在标准评估协议下达到竞争性性能。
AI.conclusion: DAF在资源受限场景下具有作为重型DNN模型实用替代方案的强大潜力，为扩散生成图像检测提供了轻量高效的解决方案。

title: FIRE-CIR: Fine-grained Reasoning for Composed Fashion Image Retrieval
summary: Composed image retrieval (CIR) aims to retrieve a target image that depicts a reference image modified by a textual description. While recent vision-language models (VLMs) achieve promising CIR performance by embedding images and text into a shared space for retrieval, they often fail to reason about what to preserve and what to change. This limitation hinders interpretability and yields suboptimal results, particularly in fine-grained domains like fashion. In this paper, we introduce FIRE-CIR, a model that brings compositional reasoning and interpretability to fashion CIR. Instead of relying solely on embedding similarity, FIRE-CIR performs question-driven visual reasoning: it automatically generates attribute-focused visual questions derived from the modification text, and verifies the corresponding visual evidence in both reference and candidate images. To train such a reasoning system, we automatically construct a large-scale fashion-specific visual question answering dataset, containing questions requiring either single- or dual-image analysis. During retrieval, our model leverages this explicit reasoning to re-rank candidate results, filtering out images inconsistent with the intended modifications. Experimental results on the Fashion IQ benchmark show that FIRE-CIR outperforms state-of-the-art methods in retrieval accuracy. It also provides interpretable, attribute-level insights into retrieval decisions.

AI.tldr: FIRE-CIR是一个用于时尚领域组合图像检索的模型，通过问题驱动的视觉推理提升检索准确性和可解释性，超越了现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉语言模型在组合图像检索中主要依赖嵌入相似性，缺乏对"保留什么、改变什么"的推理能力，导致结果不理想且缺乏可解释性，特别是在时尚等细粒度领域。
AI.method: FIRE-CIR采用问题驱动的视觉推理方法：从修改文本自动生成属性聚焦的视觉问题，并在参考图像和候选图像中验证相应的视觉证据。为此构建了大规模时尚特定的视觉问答数据集，包含单图像和双图像分析问题。在检索时，利用显式推理对候选结果进行重排序。
AI.result: 在Fashion IQ基准测试中，FIRE-CIR在检索准确率上超越了最先进的方法，同时提供了可解释的属性级检索决策洞察。
AI.conclusion: FIRE-CIR通过引入组合推理和可解释性，显著提升了时尚组合图像检索的性能，为细粒度视觉推理任务提供了新的解决方案。

title: Few-Shot Personalized Age Estimation
summary: Existing age estimation methods treat each face as an independent sample, learning a global mapping from appearance to age. This ignores a well-documented phenomenon: individuals age at different rates due to genetics, lifestyle, and health, making the mapping from face to age identity-dependent. When reference images of the same person with known ages are available, we can exploit this context to personalize the estimate. The only existing benchmark for this task (NIST FRVT) is closed-source and limited to a single reference image. In this work, we introduce OpenPAE, the first open benchmark for $N$-shot personalized age estimation with strict evaluation protocols. We establish a hierarchy of increasingly sophisticated baselines: from arithmetic offset, through closed-form Bayesian linear regression, to a conditional attentive neural process. Our experiments show that personalization consistently improves performance, that the gains are not merely domain adaptation, and that nonlinear methods significantly outperform simpler alternatives. We release all models, code, protocols, and evaluation splits.

AI.tldr: OpenPAE：首个开放基准测试，用于N-shot个性化年龄估计，通过利用个体历史照片提升年龄预测准确性
AI.motivation: 现有年龄估计方法将每个面部视为独立样本，忽略了个人因遗传、生活方式和健康导致的衰老速率差异。当有同一人的已知年龄参考图像时，可以利用这些上下文信息进行个性化估计，但现有基准测试（NIST FRVT）是闭源的且仅限于单张参考图像。
AI.method: 引入OpenPAE开放基准测试，建立分层基线方法：从算术偏移、闭式贝叶斯线性回归到条件注意力神经过程。通过严格评估协议，利用N张参考图像进行个性化年龄估计。
AI.result: 实验表明个性化方法能持续提升性能，这种提升不仅仅是领域适应，非线性方法显著优于简单替代方案。所有模型、代码、协议和评估分割均已开源。
AI.conclusion: OpenPAE为个性化年龄估计提供了首个开放基准测试，证明了利用个体历史参考图像进行个性化估计的有效性，非线性方法在该任务中表现优异，为未来研究奠定了基础。

title: Visually-Guided Policy Optimization for Multimodal Reasoning
summary: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) has significantly advanced the reasoning ability of vision-language models (VLMs). However, the inherent text-dominated nature of VLMs often leads to insufficient visual faithfulness, characterized by sparse attention activation to visual tokens. More importantly, our empirical analysis reveals that temporal visual forgetting along reasoning steps exacerbates this deficiency. To bridge this gap, we propose Visually-Guided Policy Optimization (VGPO), a novel framework to reinforce visual focus during policy optimization. Specifically, VGPO initially introduces a Visual Attention Compensation mechanism that leverages visual similarity to localize and amplify visual cues, while progressively elevating visual expectations in later steps to counteract visual forgetting. Building on this mechanism, we implement a dual-grained advantage re-weighting strategy: the intra-trajectory level highlights tokens exhibiting relatively high visual activation, while the inter-trajectory level prioritizes trajectories demonstrating superior visual accumulation. Extensive experiments demonstrate that VGPO achieves better visual activation and superior performance in mathematical multimodal reasoning and visual-dependent tasks.

AI.tldr: VGPO通过视觉注意力补偿和双粒度优势重加权策略，增强视觉语言模型在推理过程中的视觉关注度，解决视觉遗忘问题，提升多模态推理性能。
AI.motivation: 现有基于可验证奖励的强化学习虽然提升了视觉语言模型的推理能力，但文本主导的特性导致视觉忠实性不足，表现为对视觉标记的注意力激活稀疏。更重要的是，经验分析发现推理步骤中的时间性视觉遗忘加剧了这一缺陷。
AI.method: 提出视觉引导策略优化（VGPO）框架：1）视觉注意力补偿机制，利用视觉相似性定位和放大视觉线索，并在后续步骤逐步提升视觉期望以对抗视觉遗忘；2）双粒度优势重加权策略：轨迹内层面突出视觉激活相对较高的标记，轨迹间层面优先考虑视觉积累更优的轨迹。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，VGPO在数学多模态推理和视觉依赖任务中实现了更好的视觉激活和更优的性能表现。
AI.conclusion: VGPO通过强化视觉关注机制有效解决了视觉语言模型中的视觉遗忘问题，显著提升了多模态推理任务的性能，为增强视觉语言模型的视觉忠实性提供了有效解决方案。

title: FaceLiVTv2: An Improved Hybrid Architecture for Efficient Mobile Face Recognition
summary: Lightweight face recognition is increasingly important for deployment on edge and mobile devices, where strict constraints on latency, memory, and energy consumption must be met alongside reliable accuracy. Although recent hybrid CNN-Transformer architectures have advanced global context modeling, striking an effective balance between recognition performance and computational efficiency remains an open challenge. In this work, we present FaceLiVTv2, an improved version of our FaceLiVT hybrid architecture designed for efficient global--local feature interaction in mobile face recognition. At its core is Lite MHLA, a lightweight global token interaction module that replaces the original multi-layer attention design with multi-head linear token projections and affine rescale transformations, reducing redundancy while preserving representational diversity across heads. We further integrate Lite MHLA into a unified RepMix block that coordinates local and global feature interactions and adopts global depthwise convolution for adaptive spatial aggregation in the embedding stage. Under our experimental setup, results on LFW, CA-LFW, CP-LFW, CFP-FP, AgeDB-30, and IJB show that FaceLiVTv2 consistently improves the accuracy-efficiency trade-off over existing lightweight methods. Notably, FaceLiVTv2 reduces mobile inference latency by 22% relative to FaceLiVTv1, achieves speedups of up to 30.8% over GhostFaceNets on mobile devices, and delivers 20-41% latency improvements over EdgeFace and KANFace across platforms while maintaining higher recognition accuracy. These results demonstrate that FaceLiVTv2 offers a practical and deployable solution for real-time face recognition. Code is available at https://github.com/novendrastywn/FaceLiVT.

AI.tldr: FaceLiVTv2是一个改进的轻量级人脸识别混合架构，通过Lite MHLA模块和RepMix块优化全局-局部特征交互，在移动设备上实现了更好的精度-效率平衡，相比前代和其他轻量方法显著降低了延迟。
AI.motivation: 在边缘和移动设备上部署人脸识别系统时，需要在严格的延迟、内存和能耗限制下保持可靠的识别精度。尽管现有的混合CNN-Transformer架构改进了全局上下文建模，但在识别性能与计算效率之间找到有效平衡仍然是一个挑战。
AI.method: 提出了FaceLiVTv2架构，核心是Lite MHLA模块，用多头线性令牌投影和仿射重缩放变换替代原始的多层注意力设计，减少冗余同时保持多头表示多样性。将Lite MHLA集成到统一的RepMix块中，协调局部和全局特征交互，并在嵌入阶段采用全局深度卷积进行自适应空间聚合。
AI.result: 在LFW、CA-LFW、CP-LFW、CFP-FP、AgeDB-30和IJB等基准测试中，FaceLiVTv2相比现有轻量方法持续改善了精度-效率权衡。相比FaceLiVTv1减少了22%的移动推理延迟，相比GhostFaceNets在移动设备上提速达30.8%，相比EdgeFace和KANFace在不同平台上实现了20-41%的延迟改进，同时保持更高的识别精度。
AI.conclusion: FaceLiVTv2为实时人脸识别提供了一个实用且可部署的解决方案，在移动设备上实现了更好的精度与效率平衡，代码已开源。

title: Mosaic: Multimodal Jailbreak against Closed-Source VLMs via Multi-View Ensemble Optimization
summary: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) are powerful but remain vulnerable to multimodal jailbreak attacks. Existing attacks mainly rely on either explicit visual prompt attacks or gradient-based adversarial optimization. While the former is easier to detect, the latter produces subtle perturbations that are less perceptible, but is usually optimized and evaluated under homogeneous open-source surrogate-target settings, leaving its effectiveness on commercial closed-source VLMs under heterogeneous settings unclear. To examine this issue, we study different surrogate-target settings and observe a consistent gap between homogeneous and heterogeneous settings, a phenomenon we term surrogate dependency. Motivated by this finding, we propose Mosaic, a Multi-view ensemble optimization framework for multimodal jailbreak against closed-source VLMs, which alleviates surrogate dependency under heterogeneous surrogate-target settings by reducing over-reliance on any single surrogate model and visual view. Specifically, Mosaic incorporates three core components: a Text-Side Transformation module, which perturbs refusal-sensitive lexical patterns; a Multi-View Image Optimization module, which updates perturbations under diverse cropped views to avoid overfitting to a single visual view; and a Surrogate Ensemble Guidance module, which aggregates optimization signals from multiple surrogate VLMs to reduce surrogate-specific bias. Extensive experiments on safety benchmarks demonstrate that Mosaic achieves state-of-the-art Attack Success Rate and Average Toxicity against commercial closed-source VLMs.

AI.tldr: Mosaic是一个针对闭源商业视觉语言模型的多模态越狱攻击框架，通过多视角集成优化减轻对单一代理模型的依赖，在异构设置下实现更高的攻击成功率。
AI.motivation: 现有梯度对抗优化攻击主要在开源同构代理-目标设置下优化和评估，在商业闭源VLMs的异构设置中效果不明确。研究发现同构与异构设置之间存在一致差距，称为代理依赖性。
AI.method: 提出Mosaic框架，包含三个核心组件：1)文本侧变换模块，扰动拒绝敏感词汇模式；2)多视角图像优化模块，在不同裁剪视图下更新扰动避免过拟合；3)代理集成指导模块，聚合多个代理VLMs的优化信号减少代理特定偏差。
AI.result: 在安全基准测试上的广泛实验表明，Mosaic在攻击成功率和平均毒性方面达到了最先进水平，能有效攻击商业闭源视觉语言模型。
AI.conclusion: Mosaic通过多视角集成优化框架有效缓解了异构代理-目标设置下的代理依赖性问题，为闭源商业VLMs的安全评估提供了有效工具。

title: Arbitration Failure, Not Perceptual Blindness: How Vision-Language Models Resolve Visual-Linguistic Conflicts
summary: When a Vision-Language Model (VLM) sees a blue banana and answers "yellow", is the problem of perception or arbitration? We explore the question in ten VLMs with various sizes and reveal an Encoding--Grounding Dissociation: models that fail to report what they see (and thus provide a wrong answer) still encode the visual evidence as strongly as models that provide the correct answer. Using Multimodal Arbitration Crossover (MAC) analysis with layer-by-layer Logit Lens probing, we track the competition between visual and prior signals across every layer of each model. We show that visual attributes can be linearly decodable from early layers (AUC > 0.86). The accuracy remains nearly identical for both successful and failed samples. However, the gap in the final-layer logit -- not the strength of encoding -- better predicts grounding outcomes with a correlation of . After having studied when VLMs base their answers on image clues rather than prior knowledge, we want to understand the causal relationships. We establish causality through full-sequence activation patching. The standard last-token interventions in LLM interpretability do not affect VLMs. In contrast, replacing the full token sequence at layers identified by MAC alters 60 to 84% of outputs. Partial-token decomposition shows that image tokens carry almost all of the causal impact, while text tokens have none. Scaling addresses the remaining architectural differences to achieve perfect retention. Moving from diagnosis to intervention, we show that training-free activation steering -- both linear and sparse autoencoder-guided -- in early layers can improve visual grounding by up to +3.8% with degrading performance in some setups. Overall, these findings lead to a clear conclusion: VLMs already see well, but the challenge is acting on what they see. Targeted interventions can help to bridge this gap.

AI.tldr: 研究发现视觉语言模型存在编码-基础分离现象：模型即使给出错误答案，其视觉编码能力与正确答案模型一样强。问题在于仲裁而非感知，通过激活干预可以改善视觉基础能力。
AI.motivation: 探索视觉语言模型在回答问题时，当看到蓝色香蕉却回答"黄色"时，问题究竟出在感知能力还是仲裁机制上。理解模型何时基于图像线索而非先验知识做出回答。
AI.method: 使用多模态仲裁交叉分析（MAC）和逐层Logit Lens探测，跟踪视觉信号与先验信号在模型各层的竞争。通过全序列激活修补建立因果关系，并采用训练自由的激活引导（线性和稀疏自编码器引导）进行干预。
AI.result: 视觉属性在早期层即可线性解码（AUC > 0.86），成功与失败样本的编码准确率几乎相同。最终层logit差距（而非编码强度）能更好预测基础结果。全序列激活修补可改变60-84%的输出，图像token承担几乎所有因果影响。早期层激活引导可将视觉基础能力提升达+3.8%。
AI.conclusion: 视觉语言模型已经具备良好的视觉感知能力，但挑战在于如何基于所见内容行动。编码-基础分离表明问题在于仲裁机制而非感知能力，针对性干预可以帮助弥合这一差距。

title: Strips as Tokens: Artist Mesh Generation with Native UV Segmentation
summary: Recent advancements in autoregressive transformers have demonstrated remarkable potential for generating artist-quality meshes. However, the token ordering strategies employed by existing methods typically fail to meet professional artist standards, where coordinate-based sorting yields inefficiently long sequences, and patch-based heuristics disrupt the continuous edge flow and structural regularity essential for high-quality modeling. To address these limitations, we propose Strips as Tokens (SATO), a novel framework with a token ordering strategy inspired by triangle strips. By constructing the sequence as a connected chain of faces that explicitly encodes UV boundaries, our method naturally preserves the organized edge flow and semantic layout characteristic of artist-created meshes. A key advantage of this formulation is its unified representation, enabling the same token sequence to be decoded into either a triangle or quadrilateral mesh. This flexibility facilitates joint training on both data types: large-scale triangle data provides fundamental structural priors, while high-quality quad data enhances the geometric regularity of the outputs. Extensive experiments demonstrate that SATO consistently outperforms prior methods in terms of geometric quality, structural coherence, and UV segmentation.

AI.tldr: SATO提出基于三角形条带的新型token排序策略，解决现有方法在网格生成中序列过长和破坏边缘连续性的问题，能同时生成三角形和四边形网格。
AI.motivation: 现有自回归transformer在生成艺术家级网格时，token排序策略存在缺陷：坐标排序导致序列过长，基于patch的启发式方法破坏了高质量建模所需的连续边缘流和结构规律性。
AI.method: 提出SATO框架，采用受三角形条带启发的token排序策略，将序列构建为显式编码UV边界的连接面链，保持艺术家创建网格的组织边缘流和语义布局。统一表示允许同一token序列解码为三角形或四边形网格。
AI.result: SATO在几何质量、结构连贯性和UV分割方面始终优于先前方法。通过联合训练大规模三角形数据（提供结构先验）和高质量四边形数据（增强几何规律性），实现更好的生成效果。
AI.conclusion: SATO通过创新的三角形条带token排序策略，有效解决了现有网格生成方法的局限性，在保持艺术家级质量的同时提供了灵活的统一表示，支持三角形和四边形网格的联合训练与生成。

title: VL-Calibration: Decoupled Confidence Calibration for Large Vision-Language Models Reasoning
summary: Large Vision Language Models (LVLMs) achieve strong multimodal reasoning but frequently exhibit hallucinations and incorrect responses with high certainty, which hinders their usage in high-stakes domains. Existing verbalized confidence calibration methods, largely developed for text-only LLMs, typically optimize a single holistic confidence score using binary answer-level correctness. This design is mismatched to LVLMs: an incorrect prediction may arise from perceptual failures or from reasoning errors given correct perception, and a single confidence conflates these sources while visual uncertainty is often dominated by language priors. To address these issues, we propose VL-Calibration, a reinforcement learning framework that explicitly decouples confidence into visual and reasoning confidence. To supervise visual confidence without ground-truth perception labels, we introduce an intrinsic visual certainty estimation that combines (i) visual grounding measured by KL-divergence under image perturbations and (ii) internal certainty measured by token entropy. We further propose token-level advantage reweighting to focus optimization on tokens based on visual certainty, suppressing ungrounded hallucinations while preserving valid perception. Experiments on thirteen benchmarks show that VL-Calibration effectively improves calibration while boosting visual reasoning accuracy, and it generalizes to out-of-distribution benchmarks across model scales and architectures.

AI.tldr: VL-Calibration：一个通过强化学习将视觉语言模型的置信度分解为视觉置信度和推理置信度的校准框架，旨在减少幻觉并提升视觉推理准确性
AI.motivation: 现有的大型视觉语言模型（LVLMs）经常表现出高确定性的幻觉和错误响应，这阻碍了它们在高风险领域的应用。现有的置信度校准方法主要针对纯文本LLMs设计，使用二元答案级正确性优化单一整体置信度，这与LVLMs不匹配：错误预测可能源于感知失败或基于正确感知的推理错误，而单一置信度混淆了这些来源，且视觉不确定性常被语言先验主导。
AI.method: 提出VL-Calibration强化学习框架，将置信度显式解耦为视觉置信度和推理置信度。在没有真实感知标签的情况下，引入内在视觉确定性估计，结合：（i）通过图像扰动下的KL散度测量的视觉基础性；（ii）通过标记熵测量的内部确定性。进一步提出基于标记级别的优势重加权，根据视觉确定性聚焦优化标记，抑制无基础的幻觉同时保留有效感知。
AI.result: 在13个基准测试上的实验表明，VL-Calibration有效改善了校准效果，同时提升了视觉推理准确性，并且能够泛化到分布外基准测试，适用于不同模型规模和架构。
AI.conclusion: VL-Calibration通过将置信度分解为视觉和推理组件，解决了LVLMs中置信度校准的关键问题，减少了幻觉，提高了模型可靠性和在高风险应用中的可用性。

title: Geometry Reinforced Efficient Attention Tuning Equipped with Normals for Robust Stereo Matching
summary: Despite remarkable advances in image-driven stereo matching over the past decade, Synthetic-to-Realistic Zero-Shot (Syn-to-Real) generalization remains an open challenge. This suboptimal generalization performance mainly stems from cross-domain shifts and ill-posed ambiguities inherent in image textures, particularly in occluded, textureless, repetitive, and non-Lambertian (specular/transparent) regions. To improve Syn-to-Real generalization, we propose GREATEN, a framework that incorporates surface normals as domain-invariant, object-intrinsic, and discriminative geometric cues to compensate for the limitations of image textures. The proposed framework consists of three key components. First, a Gated Contextual-Geometric Fusion (GCGF) module adaptively suppresses unreliable contextual cues in image features and fuses the filtered image features with normal-driven geometric features to construct domain-invariant and discriminative contextual-geometric representations. Second, a Specular-Transparent Augmentation (STA) strategy improves the robustness of GCGF against misleading visual cues in non-Lambertian regions. Third, sparse attention designs preserve the fine-grained global feature extraction capability of GREAT-Stereo for handling occlusion and texture-related ambiguities while substantially reducing computational overhead, including Sparse Spatial (SSA), Sparse Dual-Matching (SDMA), and Simple Volume (SVA) attentions. Trained exclusively on synthetic data such as SceneFlow, GREATEN-IGEV achieves outstanding Syn-to-Real performance. Specifically, it reduces errors by 30% on ETH3D, 8.5% on the non-Lambertian Booster, and 14.1% on KITTI-2015, compared to FoundationStereo, Monster-Stereo, and DEFOM-Stereo, respectively. In addition, GREATEN-IGEV runs 19.2% faster than GREAT-IGEV and supports high-resolution (3K) inference on Middlebury with disparity ranges up to 768.

AI.tldr: GREATEN是一个利用表面法线作为域不变几何线索来提升合成到真实零样本泛化能力的立体匹配框架，通过门控上下文-几何融合、镜面透明增强和稀疏注意力设计，在多个真实数据集上显著降低误差并提高效率。
AI.motivation: 合成到真实零样本泛化在立体匹配中仍面临挑战，主要源于跨域偏移和图像纹理的模糊性（如遮挡、无纹理、重复和非朗伯区域）。图像纹理在这些区域存在局限性，需要引入域不变、对象内在且具有区分性的几何线索来补偿。
AI.method: 1. 门控上下文-几何融合模块：自适应抑制图像特征中的不可靠上下文线索，将过滤后的图像特征与法线驱动的几何特征融合，构建域不变且具有区分性的上下文-几何表示。2. 镜面透明增强策略：提升GCGF对非朗伯区域误导性视觉线索的鲁棒性。3. 稀疏注意力设计：包括稀疏空间注意力、稀疏双匹配注意力和简单体积注意力，在保持细粒度全局特征提取能力的同时大幅降低计算开销。
AI.result: 仅在合成数据（如SceneFlow）上训练，GREATEN-IGEV在真实数据集上表现出色：在ETH3D上误差降低30%，在非朗伯Booster数据集上降低8.5%，在KITTI-2015上降低14.1%（相比FoundationStereo、Monster-Stereo和DEFOM-Stereo）。运行速度比GREAT-IGEV快19.2%，支持Middlebury上高达3K分辨率和768视差范围的高分辨率推理。
AI.conclusion: GREATEN通过引入表面法线作为域不变几何线索，有效解决了合成到真实零样本泛化中的跨域偏移和纹理模糊问题。该框架在保持高效计算的同时，显著提升了在真实场景中的立体匹配性能，特别是在具有挑战性的非朗伯区域。

title: PhysInOne: Visual Physics Learning and Reasoning in One Suite
comment: CVPR 2026. Siyuan, Hejun, Hu, Jinxi, Dongsheng, Junwei, Yixiao, Jiayue, and Shiwei are co-first authors. Project page: https://vlar-group.github.io/PhysInOne.html
summary: We present PhysInOne, a large-scale synthetic dataset addressing the critical scarcity of physically-grounded training data for AI systems. Unlike existing datasets limited to merely hundreds or thousands of examples, PhysInOne provides 2 million videos across 153,810 dynamic 3D scenes, covering 71 basic physical phenomena in mechanics, optics, fluid dynamics, and magnetism. Distinct from previous works, our scenes feature multiobject interactions against complex backgrounds, with comprehensive ground-truth annotations including 3D geometry, semantics, dynamic motion, physical properties, and text descriptions. We demonstrate PhysInOne's efficacy across four emerging applications: physics-aware video generation, long-/short-term future frame prediction, physical property estimation, and motion transfer. Experiments show that fine-tuning foundation models on PhysInOne significantly enhances physical plausibility, while also exposing critical gaps in modeling complex physical dynamics and estimating intrinsic properties. As the largest dataset of its kind, orders of magnitude beyond prior works, PhysInOne establishes a new benchmark for advancing physics-grounded world models in generation, simulation, and embodied AI.

AI.tldr: PhysInOne是一个大规模合成数据集，包含200万个视频，涵盖153,810个动态3D场景和71种基础物理现象，为AI系统提供物理基础训练数据，显著提升模型在物理感知任务上的性能。
AI.motivation: 当前AI系统缺乏物理基础训练数据，现有数据集规模有限（仅数百或数千个示例），无法有效训练物理感知模型。需要大规模、多样化的物理场景数据来推动物理基础世界模型的发展。
AI.method: 创建了包含200万个视频的大规模合成数据集，涵盖153,810个动态3D场景，覆盖力学、光学、流体动力学和磁学等71种基础物理现象。场景具有多物体交互和复杂背景，并提供全面的真实标注，包括3D几何、语义、动态运动、物理属性和文本描述。
AI.result: 实验表明，在PhysInOne上微调基础模型能显著提升物理合理性。数据集在四个新兴应用上表现出色：物理感知视频生成、长/短期未来帧预测、物理属性估计和运动迁移。同时暴露了现有模型在复杂物理动态建模和内在属性估计方面的关键差距。
AI.conclusion: PhysInOne作为同类最大数据集，比先前工作规模大几个数量级，为推进生成、模拟和具身AI中的物理基础世界模型建立了新的基准，填补了物理基础训练数据的严重短缺。

title: VisionFoundry: Teaching VLMs Visual Perception with Synthetic Images
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) still struggle with visual perception tasks such as spatial understanding and viewpoint recognition. One plausible contributing factor is that natural image datasets provide limited supervision for low-level visual skills. This motivates a practical question: can targeted synthetic supervision, generated from only a task keyword such as Depth Order, address these weaknesses? To investigate this question, we introduce VisionFoundry, a task-aware synthetic data generation pipeline that takes only the task name as input and uses large language models (LLMs) to generate questions, answers, and text-to-image (T2I) prompts, then synthesizes images with T2I models and verifies consistency with a proprietary VLM, requiring no reference images or human annotation. Using VisionFoundry, we construct VisionFoundry-10K, a synthetic visual question answering (VQA) dataset containing 10k image-question-answer triples spanning 10 tasks. Models trained on VisionFoundry-10K achieve substantial improvements on visual perception benchmarks: +7% on MMVP and +10% on CV-Bench-3D, while preserving broader capabilities and showing favorable scaling behavior as data size increases. Our results suggest that limited task-targeted supervision is an important contributor to this bottleneck and that synthetic supervision is a promising path toward more systematic training for VLMs.

AI.tldr: VisionFoundry：仅需任务关键词即可生成合成监督数据的系统，用于提升视觉语言模型在空间理解和视角识别等感知任务上的性能
AI.motivation: 视觉语言模型在空间理解和视角识别等视觉感知任务上表现不佳，自然图像数据集对这些低层视觉技能提供的监督有限。需要探索针对性合成监督能否解决这一问题。
AI.method: 提出VisionFoundry任务感知合成数据生成管道：仅输入任务名称，使用大语言模型生成问题、答案和文本到图像提示，用T2I模型合成图像，并用专有VLM验证一致性，无需参考图像或人工标注。构建了包含10个任务、10k图像-问题-答案三元组的VisionFoundry-10K合成VQA数据集。
AI.result: 在VisionFoundry-10K上训练的模型在视觉感知基准测试中取得显著提升：MMVP上+7%，CV-Bench-3D上+10%，同时保持更广泛的能力，并随着数据量增加显示出有利的缩放行为。
AI.conclusion: 有限的针对性任务监督是视觉语言模型瓶颈的重要因素，合成监督是朝着更系统化训练视觉语言模型的有前景路径。

title: Deep Light Pollution Removal in Night Cityscape Photographs
summary: Nighttime photography is severely degraded by light pollution induced by pervasive artificial lighting in urban environments. After long-range scattering and spatial diffusion, unwanted artificial light overwhelms natural night luminance, generates skyglow that washes out the view of stars and celestial objects and produces halos and glow artifacts around light sources. Unlike nighttime dehazing, which aims to improve detail legibility through thick air, the objective of light pollution removal is to restore the pristine night appearance by neutralizing the radiative footprint of ground lighting. In this paper we introduce a physically-based degradation model that adds to the previous ones for nighttime dehazing two critical aspects; (i) anisotropic spread of directional light sources, and (ii) skyglow caused by invisible surface lights behind skylines. In addition, we construct a training strategy that leverages large generative model and synthetic-real coupling to compensate for the scarcity of paired real data and enhance generalization. Extensive experiments demonstrate that the proposed formulation and learning framework substantially reduce light pollution artifacts and better recover authentic night imagery than prior nighttime restoration methods.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于物理的夜间光污染去除方法，通过建模各向异性光源扩散和天际线后不可见表面光产生的天空辉光，结合生成模型和合成-真实耦合训练策略，有效恢复原始夜间图像。
AI.motivation: 城市环境中普遍存在的人工照明导致严重的光污染，造成天空辉光、光晕和辉光伪影，掩盖了星星和天体的自然夜景。与夜间去雾不同，光污染去除的目标是通过消除地面照明的辐射足迹来恢复原始夜间外观。
AI.method: 提出基于物理的退化模型，在先前夜间去雾模型基础上加入两个关键方面：(1) 定向光源的各向异性扩散，(2) 天际线后不可见表面光产生的天空辉光。采用结合大型生成模型和合成-真实耦合的训练策略，以弥补配对真实数据的稀缺并增强泛化能力。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，所提出的公式和学习框架显著减少了光污染伪影，相比先前的夜间恢复方法能更好地恢复真实的夜间图像。
AI.conclusion: 本文提出的基于物理的光污染去除模型和训练策略能够有效恢复原始夜间图像，为夜间摄影中的光污染问题提供了有效的解决方案。

title: Rays as Pixels: Learning A Joint Distribution of Videos and Camera Trajectories
comment: 9 pages, 6 figures, 4 tables. Project page: https://wbjang.github.io/raysaspixels/
summary: Recovering camera parameters from images and rendering scenes from novel viewpoints have long been treated as separate tasks in computer vision and graphics. This separation breaks down when image coverage is sparse or poses are ambiguous, since each task needs what the other produces. We propose Rays as Pixels, a Video Diffusion Model (VDM) that learns a joint distribution over videos and camera trajectories. We represent each camera as dense ray pixels (raxels) and denoise them jointly with video frames through Decoupled Self-Cross Attention mechanism. A single trained model handles three tasks: predicting camera trajectories from video, jointly generating video and camera trajectory from input images, and generating video from input images along a target camera trajectory. Because the model can both predict trajectories from a video and generate views conditioned on its own predictions, we evaluate it through a closed-loop self-consistency test, demonstrating that its forward and inverse predictions agree. Notably, trajectory prediction requires far fewer denoising steps than video generation, even a few denoising steps suffice for self-consistency. We report results on pose estimation and camera-controlled video generation.

AI.tldr: 提出Rays as Pixels视频扩散模型，将相机轨迹与视频帧联合建模，实现相机参数估计、视频生成和轨迹预测的统一框架
AI.motivation: 传统计算机视觉和图形学中，从图像恢复相机参数和从新视角渲染场景是两个分离的任务。当图像覆盖稀疏或姿态模糊时，这种分离会失效，因为每个任务都需要另一个任务的输出结果。需要建立统一的联合建模框架。
AI.method: 提出Rays as Pixels视频扩散模型，将每个相机表示为密集光线像素（raxels），通过解耦自交叉注意力机制与视频帧联合去噪。单个模型处理三个任务：从视频预测相机轨迹、从输入图像联合生成视频和相机轨迹、沿目标相机轨迹从输入图像生成视频。
AI.result: 模型通过闭环自一致性测试验证，其前向和逆向预测结果一致。轨迹预测需要的去噪步骤远少于视频生成，甚至只需几步去噪即可实现自一致性。在姿态估计和相机控制视频生成任务上取得良好结果。
AI.conclusion: Rays as Pixels模型成功实现了相机轨迹与视频内容的联合建模，打破了传统分离处理的局限，为稀疏图像覆盖和姿态模糊情况下的视觉任务提供了统一解决方案。

title: Efficient Spatial-Temporal Focal Adapter with SSM for Temporal Action Detection
summary: Temporal human action detection aims to identify and localize action segments within untrimmed videos, serving as a pivotal task in video understanding. Despite the progress achieved by prior architectures like CNN and Transformer models, these continue to struggle with feature redundancy and degraded global dependency modeling capabilities when applied to long video sequences. These limitations severely constrain their scalability in real-world video analysis. State Space Models (SSMs) offer a promising alternative with linear long-term modeling and robust global temporal reasoning capabilities. Rethinking the application of SSMs in temporal modeling, this research constructs a novel framework for video human action detection. Specifically, we introduce the Efficient Spatial-Temporal Focal (ESTF) Adapter into the pre-trained layers. This module integrates the advantages of our proposed Temporal Boundary-aware SSM(TB-SSM) for temporal feature modeling with efficient processing of spatial features. We perform comprehensive and quantitative analyses across multiple benchmarks, comparing our proposed method against previous SSM-based and other structural methods. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our improved strategy significantly enhances both localization performance and robustness, validating the effectiveness of our proposed method.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种用于时序人体动作检测的新框架，通过引入ESTF适配器和TB-SSM模块，有效解决了长视频序列中的特征冗余和全局依赖建模问题，显著提升了定位性能和鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 现有CNN和Transformer模型在处理长视频序列时存在特征冗余和全局依赖建模能力下降的问题，限制了其在真实世界视频分析中的可扩展性。状态空间模型(SSMs)具有线性长期建模和强大的全局时序推理能力，为解决这些问题提供了有前景的替代方案。
AI.method: 提出了一个新颖的视频人体动作检测框架，在预训练层中引入了高效时空焦点(ESTF)适配器。该模块整合了提出的时序边界感知SSM(TB-SSM)用于时序特征建模，同时高效处理空间特征。
AI.result: 在多个基准测试上进行了全面定量分析，与之前的SSM基方法和其他结构方法进行了比较。大量实验表明，改进的策略显著提升了定位性能和鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 验证了所提方法的有效性，通过ESTF适配器和TB-SSM模块的结合，成功解决了长视频序列中的特征建模问题，为时序人体动作检测提供了更优的解决方案。

title: MAG-3D: Multi-Agent Grounded Reasoning for 3D Understanding
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) have achieved strong performance in multimodal understanding and reasoning, yet grounded reasoning in 3D scenes remains underexplored. Effective 3D reasoning hinges on accurate grounding: to answer open-ended queries, a model must first identify query-relevant objects and regions in a complex scene, and then reason about their spatial and geometric relationships. Recent approaches have demonstrated strong potential for grounded 3D reasoning. However, they often rely on in-domain tuning or hand-crafted reasoning pipelines, which limit their flexibility and zero-shot generalization to novel environments. In this work, we present MAG-3D, a training-free multi-agent framework for grounded 3D reasoning with off-the-shelf VLMs. Instead of relying on task-specific training or fixed reasoning procedures, MAG-3D dynamically coordinates expert agents to address the key challenges of 3D reasoning. Specifically, we propose a planning agent that decomposes the task and orchestrates the overall reasoning process, a grounding agent that performs free-form 3D grounding and relevant frame retrieval from extensive 3D scene observations, and a coding agent that conducts flexible geometric reasoning and explicit verification through executable programs. This multi-agent collaborative design enables flexible training-free 3D grounded reasoning across diverse scenes and achieves state-of-the-art performance on challenging benchmarks.

AI.tldr: MAG-3D是一个无需训练的多智能体框架，利用现成的视觉语言模型进行3D场景的接地推理，通过规划、接地和编码三个智能体的协作实现灵活的零样本泛化。
AI.motivation: 当前视觉语言模型在3D场景推理方面存在不足，现有方法依赖领域内调优或手工设计的推理流程，限制了灵活性和零样本泛化能力，需要一种无需训练且能灵活处理复杂3D场景的方法。
AI.method: 提出MAG-3D框架，包含三个专家智能体：规划智能体负责任务分解和整体推理流程编排；接地智能体执行自由形式的3D接地和从大量3D场景观察中检索相关帧；编码智能体通过可执行程序进行灵活的几何推理和显式验证。
AI.result: 该框架在多个挑战性基准测试中实现了最先进的性能，能够灵活地在不同场景中进行无需训练的3D接地推理。
AI.conclusion: MAG-3D通过多智能体协作设计，实现了无需训练、灵活且具有零样本泛化能力的3D接地推理，为3D场景理解提供了新的解决方案。

title: ELT: Elastic Looped Transformers for Visual Generation
summary: We introduce Elastic Looped Transformers (ELT), a highly parameter-efficient class of visual generative models based on a recurrent transformer architecture. While conventional generative models rely on deep stacks of unique transformer layers, our approach employs iterative, weight-shared transformer blocks to drastically reduce parameter counts while maintaining high synthesis quality. To effectively train these models for image and video generation, we propose the idea of Intra-Loop Self Distillation (ILSD), where student configurations (intermediate loops) are distilled from the teacher configuration (maximum training loops) to ensure consistency across the model's depth in a single training step. Our framework yields a family of elastic models from a single training run, enabling Any-Time inference capability with dynamic trade-offs between computational cost and generation quality, with the same parameter count. ELT significantly shifts the efficiency frontier for visual synthesis. With $4\times$ reduction in parameter count under iso-inference-compute settings, ELT achieves a competitive FID of $2.0$ on class-conditional ImageNet $256 \times 256$ and FVD of $72.8$ on class-conditional UCF-101.

AI.tldr: ELT是一种参数高效的视觉生成模型，采用循环变压器架构，通过权重共享和自蒸馏训练，在显著减少参数的同时保持高质量生成，支持任意时间推理。
AI.motivation: 传统生成模型依赖深层的唯一变压器层堆叠，参数量大且计算成本高。需要开发参数效率更高的视觉生成模型，同时保持生成质量。
AI.method: 提出弹性循环变压器（ELT），采用循环变压器架构，权重共享的变压器块迭代使用。提出循环内自蒸馏（ILSD）训练方法，将中间循环配置从最大训练循环配置中蒸馏，确保深度一致性。
AI.result: 在相同推理计算设置下，参数减少4倍，在ImageNet 256×256上FID达到2.0，在UCF-101上FVD达到72.8。从单次训练中获得弹性模型家族，支持任意时间推理。
AI.conclusion: ELT显著提升了视觉合成的效率边界，在参数大幅减少的情况下保持竞争性生成质量，为高效视觉生成提供了新方向。

title: VISOR: Agentic Visual Retrieval-Augmented Generation via Iterative Search and Over-horizon Reasoning
summary: Visual Retrieval-Augmented Generation (VRAG) empowers Vision-Language Models to retrieve and reason over visually rich documents. To tackle complex queries requiring multi-step reasoning, agentic VRAG systems interleave reasoning with iterative retrieval.. However, existing agentic VRAG faces two critical bottlenecks. (1) Visual Evidence Sparsity: key evidence is scattered across pages yet processed in isolation, hindering cross-page reasoning; moreover, fine-grained intra-image evidence often requires precise visual actions, whose misuse degrades retrieval quality; (2) Search Drift in Long Horizons: the accumulation of visual tokens across retrieved pages dilutes context and causes cognitive overload, leading agents to deviate from their search objective. To address these challenges, we propose VISOR (Visual Retrieval-Augmented Generation via Iterative Search and Over-horizon Reasoning), a unified single-agent framework. VISOR features a structured Evidence Space for progressive cross-page reasoning, coupled with a Visual Action Evaluation and Correction mechanism to manage visual actions. Additionally, we introduce a Dynamic Trajectory with Sliding Window and Intent Injection to mitigate search drift. They anchor the evidence space while discarding earlier raw interactions, preventing context from being overwhelmed by visual tokens. We train VISOR using a Group Relative Policy Optimization-based Reinforcement Learning (GRPO-based RL) pipeline with state masking and credit assignment tailored for dynamic context reconstruction. Extensive experiments on ViDoSeek, SlideVQA, and MMLongBench demonstrate that VISOR achieves state-of-the-art performance with superior efficiency for long-horizon visual reasoning tasks.

AI.tldr: VISOR提出了一种统一的单智能体框架，通过结构化证据空间和视觉动作评估机制解决视觉检索增强生成中的跨页面推理和搜索漂移问题。
AI.motivation: 现有代理式视觉检索增强生成面临两个关键瓶颈：1）视觉证据稀疏性——关键证据分散在不同页面但被孤立处理，阻碍跨页面推理；精细的视觉动作误用会降低检索质量；2）长视野搜索漂移——检索页面的视觉标记积累会稀释上下文，导致智能体偏离搜索目标。
AI.method: 提出VISOR框架，包含：1）结构化证据空间支持渐进式跨页面推理；2）视觉动作评估与校正机制管理视觉动作；3）动态轨迹与滑动窗口和意图注入缓解搜索漂移；4）基于组相对策略优化的强化学习训练管道，包含状态掩码和信用分配。
AI.result: 在ViDoSeek、SlideVQA和MMLongBench等数据集上的广泛实验表明，VISOR在长视野视觉推理任务上实现了最先进的性能，并具有优越的效率。
AI.conclusion: VISOR通过统一框架有效解决了视觉检索增强生成中的跨页面推理和搜索漂移问题，为长视野视觉推理任务提供了高效解决方案。

title: Envisioning the Future, One Step at a Time
comment: CVPR 2026. For code and models, see http://compvis.github.io/myriad
summary: Accurately anticipating how complex, diverse scenes will evolve requires models that represent uncertainty, simulate along extended interaction chains, and efficiently explore many plausible futures. Yet most existing approaches rely on dense video or latent-space prediction, expending substantial capacity on dense appearance rather than on the underlying sparse trajectories of points in the scene. This makes large-scale exploration of future hypotheses costly and limits performance when long-horizon, multi-modal motion is essential. We address this by formulating the prediction of open-set future scene dynamics as step-wise inference over sparse point trajectories. Our autoregressive diffusion model advances these trajectories through short, locally predictable transitions, explicitly modeling the growth of uncertainty over time. This dynamics-centric representation enables fast rollout of thousands of diverse futures from a single image, optionally guided by initial constraints on motion, while maintaining physical plausibility and long-range coherence. We further introduce OWM, a benchmark for open-set motion prediction based on diverse in-the-wild videos, to evaluate accuracy and variability of predicted trajectory distributions under real-world uncertainty. Our method matches or surpasses dense simulators in predictive accuracy while achieving orders-of-magnitude higher sampling speed, making open-set future prediction both scalable and practical. Project page: http://compvis.github.io/myriad.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一种基于稀疏点轨迹的自回归扩散模型，用于开放集未来场景动态预测，相比密集视频预测方法，在保持准确性的同时实现了数量级更快的采样速度。
AI.motivation: 现有方法主要依赖密集视频或潜在空间预测，将大量计算能力消耗在密集外观而非场景中稀疏点轨迹上，这使得大规模探索未来假设成本高昂，且在需要长时程、多模态运动时性能受限。
AI.method: 将开放集未来场景动态预测公式化为对稀疏点轨迹的逐步推理。采用自回归扩散模型，通过短时、局部可预测的转移推进这些轨迹，显式建模随时间增长的不确定性。这种以动态为中心的表征可以从单张图像快速生成数千种不同的未来场景。
AI.result: 方法在预测准确性上与密集模拟器相当或更优，同时实现了数量级更高的采样速度。在OWM基准测试中，能够有效评估真实世界不确定性下预测轨迹分布的准确性和变异性。
AI.conclusion: 基于稀疏点轨迹的动态中心表征使开放集未来预测既具有可扩展性又实用，能够在保持物理合理性和长程一致性的同时，从单张图像快速生成多样化的未来场景。

title: MixFlow: Mixed Source Distributions Improve Rectified Flows
summary: Diffusion models and their variations, such as rectified flows, generate diverse and high-quality images, but they are still hindered by slow iterative sampling caused by the highly curved generative paths they learn. An important cause of high curvature, as shown by previous work, is independence between the source distribution (standard Gaussian) and the data distribution. In this work, we tackle this limitation by two complementary contributions. First, we attempt to break away from the standard Gaussian assumption by introducing $κ\texttt{-FC}$, a general formulation that conditions the source distribution on an arbitrary signal $κ$ that aligns it better with the data distribution. Then, we present MixFlow, a simple but effective training strategy that reduces the generative path curvatures and considerably improves sampling efficiency. MixFlow trains a flow model on linear mixtures of a fixed unconditional distribution and a $κ\texttt{-FC}$-based distribution. This simple mixture improves the alignment between the source and data, provides better generation quality with less required sampling steps, and accelerates the training convergence considerably. On average, our training procedure improves the generation quality by 12\% in FID compared to standard rectified flow and 7\% compared to previous baselines under a fixed sampling budget. Code available at: $\href{https://github.com/NazirNayal8/MixFlow}{https://github.com/NazirNayal8/MixFlow}$

AI.tldr: MixFlow提出了一种新的训练策略，通过将固定无条件分布与κ-FC条件分布的线性混合来训练流模型，减少生成路径曲率，提高采样效率和质量。
AI.motivation: 扩散模型及其变体（如整流流）虽然能生成多样化和高质量的图像，但受到高度弯曲的生成路径导致的缓慢迭代采样的限制。先前研究表明，源分布（标准高斯）与数据分布之间的独立性是导致高曲率的重要原因。
AI.method: 1. 提出κ-FC通用框架，通过任意信号κ来条件化源分布，使其更好地与数据分布对齐。2. 提出MixFlow训练策略，在固定无条件分布和基于κ-FC的分布的线性混合上训练流模型，减少生成路径曲率。
AI.result: 在固定采样预算下，MixFlow相比标准整流流将生成质量（FID）平均提高12%，相比先前基线提高7%。同时显著加速训练收敛，减少所需采样步骤。
AI.conclusion: MixFlow通过改进源分布与数据分布的对齐，有效减少了生成路径曲率，显著提高了扩散模型的采样效率和生成质量，同时加速了训练收敛过程。

title: Globally Optimal Pose from Orthographic Silhouettes
summary:
We solve the problem of determining the pose of known shapes in $\mathbb{R}^3$ from their unoccluded silhouettes. The pose is determined up to global optimality using a simple yet under-explored property of the area-of-silhouette: its continuity w.r.t trajectories in the rotation space. The proposed method utilises pre-computed silhouette-signatures, modelled as a response surface of the area-of-silhouettes. Querying this silhouette-signature response surface for pose estimation leads to a strong branching of the rotation search space, making resolution-guided candidate search feasible. Additionally, we utilise the aspect ratio of 2D ellipses fitted to projected silhouettes as an auxiliary global shape signature to accelerate the pose search. This combined strategy forms the first method to efficiently estimate globally optimal pose from just the silhouettes, without being guided by correspondences, for any shape, irrespective of its convexity and genus. We validate our method on synthetic and real examples, demonstrating significantly improved accuracy against comparable approaches.
  Code, data, and supplementary in: https://agnivsen.github.io/pose-from-silhouette/

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一种从已知3D形状的未遮挡轮廓中全局最优估计姿态的方法，利用轮廓面积在旋转空间中的连续性特性，通过预计算的轮廓签名响应曲面和椭圆拟合辅助特征加速姿态搜索。
AI.motivation: 现有方法难以从轮廓信息中高效且全局最优地估计3D形状的姿态，特别是对于非凸形状和任意拓扑结构的形状。需要一种不依赖对应关系、适用于任意形状的全局最优姿态估计方法。
AI.method: 利用轮廓面积在旋转空间中的连续性特性，预计算轮廓签名作为响应曲面；使用分辨率引导的候选搜索策略，通过轮廓签名响应曲面进行姿态查询；同时利用投影轮廓拟合的2D椭圆纵横比作为辅助全局形状签名加速搜索。
AI.result: 在合成和真实数据上验证了方法的有效性，相比可比方法显著提高了姿态估计的准确性。该方法首次实现了仅从轮廓信息中高效估计全局最优姿态，适用于任意形状（包括非凸形状和任意拓扑结构）。
AI.conclusion: 提出了一种新颖的基于轮廓的姿态估计方法，通过利用轮廓面积在旋转空间中的连续性特性和辅助形状特征，实现了从轮廓信息中全局最优且高效地估计3D形状姿态，为计算机视觉和机器人领域的姿态估计问题提供了新的解决方案。

title: Seeing is Believing: Robust Vision-Guided Cross-Modal Prompt Learning under Label Noise
summary: Prompt learning is a parameter-efficient approach for vision-language models, yet its robustness under label noise is less investigated. Visual content contains richer and more reliable semantic information, which remains more robust under label noise. However, the prompt itself is highly susceptible to label noise. Motivated by this intuition, we propose VisPrompt, a lightweight and robust vision-guided prompt learning framework for noisy-label settings. Specifically, we exploit a cross-modal attention mechanism to reversely inject visual semantics into prompt representations. This enables the prompt tokens to selectively aggregate visual information relevant to the current sample, thereby improving robustness by anchoring prompt learning to stable instance-level visual evidence and reducing the influence of noisy supervision. To address the instability caused by using the same way of injecting visual information for all samples, despite differences in the quality of their visual cues, we further introduce a lightweight conditional modulation mechanism to adaptively control the strength of visual information injection, which strikes a more robust balance between text-side semantic priors and image-side instance evidence. The proposed framework effectively suppresses the noise-induced disturbances, reduce instability in prompt updates, and alleviate memorization of mislabeled samples. VisPrompt significantly improves robustness while keeping the pretrained VLM backbone frozen and introducing only a small amount of additional trainable parameters. Extensive experiments under synthetic and real-world label noise demonstrate that VisPrompt generally outperforms existing baselines on seven benchmark datasets and achieves stronger robustness. Our code is publicly available at https://github.com/gezbww/Vis_Prompt.

AI.tldr: VisPrompt是一种轻量级、鲁棒的视觉引导提示学习框架，专门针对标签噪声场景设计，通过跨模态注意力机制将视觉语义反向注入提示表示，并引入条件调制机制自适应控制视觉信息注入强度。
AI.motivation: 提示学习在视觉语言模型中是一种参数高效的方法，但其在标签噪声下的鲁棒性研究较少。视觉内容包含更丰富可靠的语义信息，在标签噪声下更鲁棒，而提示本身对标签噪声高度敏感。因此需要开发一种在标签噪声下更鲁棒的提示学习方法。
AI.method: 提出VisPrompt框架：1）利用跨模态注意力机制将视觉语义反向注入提示表示，使提示标记能够选择性聚合与当前样本相关的视觉信息；2）引入轻量级条件调制机制自适应控制视觉信息注入强度，在文本侧语义先验和图像侧实例证据之间实现更鲁棒的平衡。
AI.result: 在合成和真实世界标签噪声下的七个基准数据集上，VisPrompt普遍优于现有基线方法，实现了更强的鲁棒性。该方法保持预训练的VLM主干冻结，仅引入少量额外可训练参数。
AI.conclusion: VisPrompt通过视觉引导的提示学习有效抑制了噪声引起的干扰，减少了提示更新的不稳定性，缓解了对错误标记样本的记忆，显著提高了标签噪声场景下的鲁棒性。

title: CT-1: Vision-Language-Camera Models Transfer Spatial Reasoning Knowledge to Camera-Controllable Video Generation
summary: Camera-controllable video generation aims to synthesize videos with flexible and physically plausible camera movements. However, existing methods either provide imprecise camera control from text prompts or rely on labor-intensive manual camera trajectory parameters, limiting their use in automated scenarios. To address these issues, we propose a novel Vision-Language-Camera model, termed CT-1 (Camera Transformer 1), a specialized model designed to transfer spatial reasoning knowledge to video generation by accurately estimating camera trajectories. Built upon vision-language modules and a Diffusion Transformer model, CT-1 employs a Wavelet-based Regularization Loss in the frequency domain to effectively learn complex camera trajectory distributions. These trajectories are integrated into a video diffusion model to enable spatially aware camera control that aligns with user intentions. To facilitate the training of CT-1, we design a dedicated data curation pipeline and construct CT-200K, a large-scale dataset containing over 47M frames. Experimental results demonstrate that our framework successfully bridges the gap between spatial reasoning and video synthesis, yielding faithful and high-quality camera-controllable videos and improving camera control accuracy by 25.7% over prior methods.

AI.tldr: 提出CT-1模型，通过视觉-语言-相机框架将空间推理知识迁移到视频生成中，实现精确的相机轨迹控制，相比现有方法提升25.7%的控制精度。
AI.motivation: 现有相机可控视频生成方法存在两个主要问题：1）基于文本提示的相机控制不够精确；2）依赖人工手动设置相机轨迹参数，在自动化场景中应用受限。需要一种能够准确估计相机轨迹并实现自动化控制的方法。
AI.method: 提出CT-1（Camera Transformer 1）模型，基于视觉-语言模块和Diffusion Transformer构建。采用小波基正则化损失在频域学习复杂相机轨迹分布，并将学习到的轨迹集成到视频扩散模型中，实现空间感知的相机控制。为训练模型，设计了专门的数据处理流程并构建了包含47M帧的大规模数据集CT-200K。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，该框架成功弥合了空间推理与视频合成之间的差距，生成了忠实且高质量的相机可控视频，相机控制精度相比先前方法提升了25.7%。
AI.conclusion: CT-1模型通过将空间推理知识迁移到视频生成中，实现了精确的相机轨迹控制，解决了现有方法在自动化场景中的应用限制，为相机可控视频生成提供了有效的解决方案。

title: SHIFT: Steering Hidden Intermediates in Flow Transformers
summary: Diffusion models have become leading approaches for high-fidelity image generation. Recent DiT-based diffusion models, in particular, achieve strong prompt adherence while producing high-quality samples. We propose SHIFT, a simple but effective and lightweight framework for concept removal in DiT diffusion models via targeted manipulation of intermediate activations at inference time, inspired by activation steering in large language models. SHIFT learns steering vectors that are dynamically applied to selected layers and timesteps to suppress unwanted visual concepts while preserving the prompt's remaining content and overall image quality. Beyond suppression, the same mechanism can shift generations into a desired \emph{style domain} or bias samples toward adding or changing target objects. We demonstrate that SHIFT provides effective and flexible control over DiT generation across diverse prompts and targets without time-consuming retraining.

AI.tldr: SHIFT是一个轻量级框架，通过推理时操纵DiT扩散模型的中间激活来移除特定概念，无需重新训练
AI.motivation: 扩散模型在高质量图像生成方面表现出色，但缺乏对生成内容的细粒度控制。现有方法需要耗时重新训练，需要一种无需训练即可控制生成内容的方法
AI.method: SHIFT通过学习引导向量，在推理时动态应用于选定层和时间步，抑制不需要的视觉概念，同时保持提示的其余内容和整体图像质量
AI.result: SHIFT能够有效灵活地控制DiT生成，涵盖多样化的提示和目标，无需耗时重新训练，还能将生成内容转移到特定风格域或偏向添加/改变目标对象
AI.conclusion: SHIFT提供了一个简单有效且轻量级的框架，通过激活引导机制实现扩散模型的概念移除和内容控制，为扩散模型提供了新的控制维度

title: TinyNeRV: Compact Neural Video Representations via Capacity Scaling, Distillation, and Low-Precision Inference
comment: Submitted to "Computers and Electrical Engineering", Elsevier
summary: Implicit neural video representations encode entire video sequences within the parameters of a neural network and enable constant time frame reconstruction. Recent work on Neural Representations for Videos (NeRV) has demonstrated competitive reconstruction performance while avoiding the sequential decoding process of conventional video codecs. However, most existing studies focus on moderate or high capacity models, leaving the behavior of extremely compact configurations required for constrained environments insufficiently explored. This paper presents a systematic study of tiny NeRV architectures designed for efficient deployment. Two lightweight configurations, NeRV-T and NeRV-T+, are introduced and evaluated across multiple video datasets in order to analyze how aggressive capacity reduction affects reconstruction quality, computational complexity, and decoding throughput. Beyond architectural scaling, the work investigates strategies for improving the performance of compact models without increasing inference cost. Knowledge distillation with frequency-aware focal supervision is explored to enhance reconstruction fidelity in low-capacity networks. In addition, the impact of lowprecision inference is examined through both post training quantization and quantization aware training to study the robustness of tiny models under reduced numerical precision. Experimental results demonstrate that carefully designed tiny NeRV variants can achieve favorable quality efficiency trade offs while substantially reducing parameter count, computational cost, and memory requirements. These findings provide insight into the practical limits of compact neural video representations and offer guidance for deploying NeRV style models in resource constrained and real-time environments. The official implementation is available at https: //github.com/HannanAkhtar/TinyNeRV-Implementation.

AI.tldr: 该论文系统研究了用于高效部署的微型NeRV架构，提出了NeRV-T和NeRV-T+两种轻量配置，探索了知识蒸馏和低精度推理策略，在保持良好重建质量的同时大幅减少了参数数量、计算成本和内存需求。
AI.motivation: 现有神经视频表示研究主要关注中等或高容量模型，对资源受限环境所需的极端紧凑配置行为探索不足。需要研究如何在保持重建质量的同时实现高效部署。
AI.method: 提出了两种轻量级配置NeRV-T和NeRV-T+，并进行了系统评估。探索了基于频率感知焦点监督的知识蒸馏策略来提升紧凑模型性能。研究了后训练量化和量化感知训练对低精度推理的影响。
AI.result: 精心设计的微型NeRV变体能够在显著减少参数数量、计算成本和内存需求的同时，实现良好的质量-效率权衡。实验结果为紧凑神经视频表示的实际极限提供了见解。
AI.conclusion: 该研究为在资源受限和实时环境中部署NeRV风格模型提供了指导，展示了紧凑神经视频表示在保持性能的同时实现高效部署的潜力。

title: Hitem3D 2.0: Multi-View Guided Native 3D Texture Generation
summary: Although recent advances have improved the quality of 3D texture generation, existing methods still struggle with incomplete texture coverage, cross-view inconsistency, and misalignment between geometry and texture. To address these limitations, we propose Hitem3D 2.0, a multi-view guided native 3D texture generation framework that enhances texture quality through the integration of 2D multi-view generation priors and native 3D texture representations. Hitem3D 2.0 comprises two key components: a multi-view synthesis framework and a native 3D texture generation model. The multi-view generation is built upon a pre-trained image editing backbone and incorporates plug-and-play modules that explicitly promote geometric alignment, cross-view consistency, and illumination uniformity, thereby enabling the synthesis of high-fidelity multi-view images. Conditioned on the generated views and 3D geometry, the native 3D texture generation model projects multi-view textures onto 3D surfaces while plausibly completing textures in unseen regions. Through the integration of multi-view consistency constraints with native 3D texture modeling, Hitem3D 2.0 significantly improves texture completeness, cross-view coherence, and geometric alignment. Experimental results demonstrate that Hitem3D 2.0 outperforms existing methods in terms of texture detail, fidelity, consistency, coherence, and alignment.

AI.tldr: Hitem3D 2.0是一个多视图引导的原生3D纹理生成框架，通过整合2D多视图生成先验和原生3D纹理表示来解决现有方法在纹理覆盖不完整、跨视图不一致以及几何与纹理不对齐方面的问题。
AI.motivation: 现有3D纹理生成方法存在纹理覆盖不完整、跨视图不一致以及几何与纹理不对齐的问题，需要一种能够生成高质量、一致且对齐的3D纹理的方法。
AI.method: 框架包含两个关键组件：1) 基于预训练图像编辑骨干的多视图合成框架，通过即插即用模块显式促进几何对齐、跨视图一致性和光照均匀性；2) 基于生成视图和3D几何的原生3D纹理生成模型，将多视图纹理投影到3D表面并在不可见区域合理补全纹理。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，Hitem3D 2.0在纹理细节、保真度、一致性、连贯性和对齐方面优于现有方法，显著提高了纹理完整性、跨视图一致性和几何对齐质量。
AI.conclusion: 通过整合多视图一致性约束与原生3D纹理建模，Hitem3D 2.0有效解决了3D纹理生成中的关键挑战，为高质量3D纹理生成提供了有效解决方案。

title: FashionStylist: An Expert Knowledge-enhanced Multimodal Dataset for Fashion Understanding
summary: Fashion understanding requires both visual perception and expert-level reasoning about style, occasion, compatibility, and outfit rationale. However, existing fashion datasets remain fragmented and task-specific, often focusing on item attributes, outfit co-occurrence, or weak textual supervision, and thus provide limited support for holistic outfit understanding. In this paper, we introduce FashionStylist, an expert-annotated benchmark for holistic and expert-level fashion understanding. Constructed through a dedicated fashion-expert annotation pipeline, FashionStylist provides professionally grounded annotations at both the item and outfit levels. It supports three representative tasks: outfit-to-item grounding, outfit completion, and outfit evaluation. These tasks cover realistic item recovery from complex outfits with layering and accessories, compatibility-aware composition beyond co-occurrence matching, and expert-level assessment of style, season, occasion, and overall coherence. Experimental results show that FashionStylist serves not only as a unified benchmark for multiple fashion tasks, but also as an effective training resource for improving grounding, completion, and outfit-level semantic evaluation in MLLM-based fashion systems.

AI.tldr: FashionStylist是一个专家标注的时尚理解基准数据集，支持服装到单品定位、服装搭配完成和服装评估三个任务，为MLLM时尚系统提供统一评估和训练资源。
AI.motivation: 现有时尚数据集存在碎片化和任务特定性问题，主要关注单品属性、搭配共现或弱文本监督，缺乏对整体服装理解的全面支持，需要专家级的时尚理解基准。
AI.method: 通过专门的时尚专家标注流程构建FashionStylist数据集，提供专业基础的单品和服装级别标注，支持三个核心任务：服装到单品定位、服装搭配完成和服装评估。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，FashionStylist不仅可作为多个时尚任务的统一基准，还能有效提升MLLM时尚系统中定位、搭配完成和服装级别语义评估的能力。
AI.conclusion: FashionStylist为整体和专家级时尚理解提供了专业标注的基准，填补了现有数据集的不足，支持更全面的时尚系统开发和评估。

title: GeRM: A Generative Rendering Model From Physically Realistic to Photorealistic
summary: For decades, Physically-Based Rendering (PBR) is the fundation of synthesizing photorealisitic images, and therefore sometimes roughly referred as Photorealistic Rendering (PRR). While PBR is indeed a mathematical simulation of light transport that guarantees physical reality, photorealism has additional reliance on the realistic digital model of geometry and appearance of the real world, leaving a barely explored gap from PBR to PRR (P2P). Consequently, the path toward photorealism faces a critical dilemma: the explicit simulation of PRR encumbered by unreachable realistic digital models for real-world existence, while implicit generation models sacrifice controllability and geometric consistency. Based on this insight, this paper presents the problem, data, and approach of mitigating P2P gap, followed by the first multi-modal generative rendering model, dubbed GeRM, to unify PBR and PRR. GeRM integrates physical attributes like G-buffers with text prompts, and progressive incremental injection to generate controllable photorealistic images, allowing users to fluidly navigate the continuum between strict physical fidelity and perceptual photorealism. Technically, we model the transition between PBR and PRR images as a distribution transfer and aim to learn a distribution transfer vector field (DTV Field) to guide this process. To define the learning objective, we first leverage a multi-agent VLM framework to construct an expert-guided pairwise P2P transfer dataset, named P2P-50K, where each paired sample in the dataset corresponds to a transfer vector in the DTV Field. Subsequently, we propose a multi-condition ControlNet to learn the DTV Field, which synthesizes PBR images and progressively transitions them into PRR images, guided by G-buffers, text prompts, and cues for enhanced regions.

AI.tldr: GeRM模型通过分布转移向量场统一物理渲染与照片级真实感渲染，解决P2P差距问题
AI.motivation: 物理渲染(PBR)虽然保证物理真实性，但照片级真实感渲染(PRR)还需要真实的几何和外观数字模型，存在P2P差距。现有方法要么受限于无法获得真实数字模型，要么牺牲可控性和几何一致性。
AI.method: 提出GeRM模型，将PBR到PRR的过渡建模为分布转移，学习分布转移向量场(DTV Field)。首先构建P2P-50K数据集，使用多智能体VLM框架生成专家指导的配对转移样本，然后提出多条件ControlNet学习DTV Field，通过渐进增量注入生成可控照片级真实图像。
AI.result: GeRM能够统一PBR和PRR，允许用户在严格的物理保真度和感知真实感之间流畅导航，生成可控的照片级真实图像。
AI.conclusion: GeRM是首个多模态生成渲染模型，通过解决P2P差距问题，实现了物理渲染与照片级真实感渲染的统一，为照片级真实感渲染提供了新的可控生成方法。

title: From Frames to Events: Rethinking Evaluation in Human-Centric Video Anomaly Detection
summary: Pose-based Video Anomaly Detection (VAD) has gained significant attention for its privacy-preserving nature and robustness to environmental variations. However, traditional frame-level evaluations treat video as a collection of isolated frames, fundamentally misaligned with how anomalies manifest and are acted upon in the real world. In operational surveillance systems, what matters is not the flagging of individual frames, but the reliable detection, localization, and reporting of a coherent anomalous event, a contiguous temporal episode with an identifiable onset and duration. Frame-level metrics are blind to this distinction, and as a result, they systematically overestimate model performance for any deployment that requires actionable, event-level alerts. In this work, we propose a shift toward an event-centric perspective in VAD. We first audit widely used VAD benchmarks, including SHT[19], CHAD[6], NWPUC[4], and HuVAD[25], to characterize their event structure. We then introduce two strategies for temporal event localization: a score-refinement pipeline with hierarchical Gaussian smoothing and adaptive binarization, and an end-to-end Dual-Branch Model that directly generates event-level detections. Finally, we establish the first event-based evaluation standard for VAD by adapting Temporal Action Localization metrics, including tIoU-based event matching and multi-threshold F1 evaluation. Our results quantify a substantial performance gap: while all SoTA models achieve frame-level AUC-ROC exceeding 52% on the NWPUC[4], their event-level localization precision falls below 10% even at a minimal tIoU=0.2, with an average event-level F1 of only 0.11 across all thresholds. The code base for this work is available at https://github.com/TeCSAR-UNCC/EventCentric-VAD.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出从帧级评估转向事件中心视角的异常检测方法，通过事件定位策略和事件级评估标准，揭示了现有模型在事件级检测性能上的严重不足。
AI.motivation: 传统基于姿态的视频异常检测采用帧级评估，与真实世界中异常事件作为连续时间片段出现的特性不符。帧级指标会高估模型性能，无法满足实际监控系统中需要可操作事件级警报的需求。
AI.method: 1. 审计现有VAD基准的事件结构特征；2. 提出两种时间事件定位策略：基于分层高斯平滑和自适应二值化的分数优化流程，以及直接生成事件级检测的端到端双分支模型；3. 建立首个基于事件的VAD评估标准，采用基于时间交并比的事件匹配和多阈值F1评估。
AI.result: 量化了显著的性能差距：虽然所有最先进模型在NWPUC数据集上的帧级AUC-ROC超过52%，但在最小tIoU=0.2时，事件级定位精度低于10%，所有阈值下的平均事件级F1仅为0.11。
AI.conclusion: 需要从帧级评估转向事件中心视角，现有模型在事件级异常检测方面存在严重不足，提出的事件级评估标准能更准确地反映模型在实际部署中的性能。

title: Robust 4D Visual Geometry Transformer with Uncertainty-Aware Priors
summary: Reconstructing dynamic 4D scenes is an important yet challenging task. While 3D foundation models like VGGT excel in static settings, they often struggle with dynamic sequences where motion causes significant geometric ambiguity. To address this, we present a framework designed to disentangle dynamic and static components by modeling uncertainty across different stages of the reconstruction process. Our approach introduces three synergistic mechanisms: (1) Entropy-Guided Subspace Projection, which leverages information-theoretic weighting to adaptively aggregate multi-head attention distributions, effectively isolating dynamic motion cues from semantic noise; (2) Local-Consistency Driven Geometry Purification, which enforces spatial continuity via radius-based neighborhood constraints to eliminate structural outliers; and (3) Uncertainty-Aware Cross-View Consistency, which formulates multi-view projection refinement as a heteroscedastic maximum likelihood estimation problem, utilizing depth confidence as a probabilistic weight. Experiments on dynamic benchmarks show that our approach outperforms current state-of-the-art methods, reducing Mean Accuracy error by 13.43\% and improving segmentation F-measure by 10.49\%. Our framework maintains the efficiency of feed-forward inference and requires no task-specific fine-tuning or per-scene optimization.

AI.tldr: 提出一种动态4D场景重建框架，通过建模不确定性来分离动态和静态组件，在动态基准测试中优于现有方法，无需任务特定微调或逐场景优化。
AI.motivation: 现有的3D基础模型（如VGGT）在静态场景中表现良好，但在动态序列中由于运动导致的几何模糊性而表现不佳，需要解决动态场景重建中的不确定性问题。
AI.method: 提出三个协同机制：1) 熵引导子空间投影，利用信息论加权自适应聚合多头注意力分布，隔离动态运动线索；2) 局部一致性驱动几何净化，通过半径邻域约束强制空间连续性，消除结构异常值；3) 不确定性感知跨视图一致性，将多视图投影细化建模为异方差最大似然估计问题，使用深度置信度作为概率权重。
AI.result: 在动态基准测试中优于当前最先进方法，平均准确度误差降低13.43%，分割F-measure提高10.49%，保持前馈推理效率。
AI.conclusion: 该框架通过建模不确定性有效分离动态和静态组件，在动态4D场景重建中取得显著改进，同时保持高效推理且无需额外优化。

title: EpiAgent: An Agent-Centric System for Ancient Inscription Restoration
summary: Ancient inscriptions, as repositories of cultural memory, have suffered from centuries of environmental and human-induced degradation. Restoring their intertwined visual and textual integrity poses one of the most demanding challenges in digital heritage preservation. However, existing AI-based approaches often rely on rigid pipelines, struggling to generalize across such complex and heterogeneous real-world degradations. Inspired by the skill-coordinated workflow of human epigraphers, we propose EpiAgent, an agent-centric system that formulates inscription restoration as a hierarchical planning problem. Following an Observe-Conceive-Execute-Reevaluate paradigm, an LLM-based central planner orchestrates collaboration among multimodal analysis, historical experience, specialized restoration tools, and iterative self-refinement. This agent-centric coordination enables a flexible and adaptive restoration process beyond conventional single-pass methods. Across real-world degraded inscriptions, EpiAgent achieves superior restoration quality and stronger generalization compared to existing methods. Our work marks an important step toward expert-level agent-driven restoration of cultural heritage. The code is available at https://github.com/blackprotoss/EpiAgent.

AI.tldr: EpiAgent是一个基于智能体协作的碑文修复系统，采用分层规划方法，通过LLM中央规划器协调多模态分析、历史经验、专业修复工具和迭代自优化，实现了超越传统单次方法的灵活自适应修复。
AI.motivation: 古代碑文作为文化遗产面临严重退化，现有AI方法采用刚性流程难以处理复杂多样的真实世界退化问题，需要更灵活、自适应的修复方法。
AI.method: 提出EpiAgent系统，将碑文修复建模为分层规划问题，采用观察-构思-执行-重评估范式，由LLM中央规划器协调多模态分析、历史经验、专业修复工具和迭代自优化模块的协作。
AI.result: 在真实世界退化碑文上，EpiAgent实现了优于现有方法的修复质量和更强的泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: 这项工作标志着向专家级智能体驱动文化遗产修复迈出了重要一步，展示了智能体协作在复杂文化遗产修复任务中的潜力。

title: Region-Constrained Group Relative Policy Optimization for Flow-Based Image Editing
summary: Instruction-guided image editing requires balancing target modification with non-target preservation. Recently, flow-based models have emerged as a strong and increasingly adopted backbone for instruction-guided image editing, thanks to their high fidelity and efficient deterministic ODE sampling. Building on this foundation, GRPO-based reward-driven post-training has been explored to directly optimize editing-specific rewards, improving instruction following and editing consistency. However, existing methods often suffer from noisy credit assignment: global exploration also perturbs non-target regions, inflating within-group reward variance and yielding noisy GRPO advantages. To address this, we propose RC-GRPO-Editing, a region-constrained GRPO post-training framework for flow-based image editing under deterministic ODE sampling. It suppresses background-induced nuisance variance to enable cleaner localized credit assignment, improving editing region instruction adherence while preserving non-target content. Concretely, we localize exploration via region-decoupled initial noise perturbations to reduce background-induced reward variance and stabilize GRPO advantages, and introduce an attention concentration reward that aligns cross-attention with the intended editing region throughout the rollout, reducing unintended changes in non-target regions. Experiments on CompBench show consistent improvements in editing region instruction adherence and non-target preservation.

AI.tldr: 提出RC-GRPO-Editing框架，通过区域约束的GRPO后训练方法，解决基于流的图像编辑中全局探索导致非目标区域扰动的问题，提升编辑区域指令遵循度和非目标内容保留。
AI.motivation: 现有基于流的指令引导图像编辑方法虽然高效，但在GRPO奖励驱动后训练中存在噪声信用分配问题：全局探索会扰动非目标区域，导致奖励方差增大和GRPO优势噪声化，影响编辑效果。
AI.method: 提出RC-GRPO-Editing框架：1) 通过区域解耦的初始噪声扰动实现局部化探索，减少背景引起的奖励方差；2) 引入注意力集中奖励，使交叉注意力在整个采样过程中与目标编辑区域对齐，减少非目标区域的意外修改。
AI.result: 在CompBench上的实验表明，该方法在编辑区域指令遵循度和非目标内容保留方面均取得一致性的改进。
AI.conclusion: RC-GRPO-Editing通过区域约束的GRPO后训练，有效解决了基于流的图像编辑中的噪声信用分配问题，实现了更好的编辑区域控制和非目标内容保留。

title: EGLOCE: Training-Free Energy-Guided Latent Optimization for Concept Erasure
summary: As text-to-image diffusion models grow increasingly prevalent, the ability to remove specific concepts-mostly explicit content and many copyrighted characters or styles-has become essential for safety and compliance. Existing unlearning approaches often require costly re-training, modify parameters at the cost of degradation of unrelated concept fidelity, or depend on indirect inference-time adjustment that compromise the effectiveness of concept erasure. Inspired by the success of energy-guided sampling for preservation of the condition of diffusion models, we introduce Energy-Guided Latent Optimization for Concept Erasure (EGLOCE), a training-free approach that removes unwanted concepts by re-directing noisy latent during inference. Our method employs a dual-objective framework: a repulsion energy that steers generation away from target concepts via gradient descent in latent space, and a retention energy that preserves semantic alignment to the original prompt. Combined with previous approaches that either require erroneous modified model weights or provide weak inference-time guidance, EGLOCE operates entirely at inference and enhances erasure performance, enabling plug-and-play integration. Extensive experiments demonstrate that EGLOCE improves concept removal while maintaining image quality and prompt alignment across baselines, even with adversarial attacks. To the best of our knowledge, our work is the first to establish a new paradigm for safe and controllable image generation through dual energy-based guidance during sampling.

AI.tldr: EGLOCE是一种无需训练的文本到图像扩散模型概念擦除方法，通过推理时的双能量引导潜在优化，在保持图像质量和提示对齐的同时有效移除特定概念。
AI.motivation: 随着文本到图像扩散模型的普及，移除特定概念（如敏感内容、受版权保护的角色或风格）对于安全和合规性变得至关重要。现有方法存在需要重新训练、修改参数导致无关概念保真度下降或依赖间接推理时调整等问题。
AI.method: EGLOCE采用训练免费的方法，通过推理时重新引导噪声潜在空间来移除不需要的概念。该方法使用双目标框架：排斥能量通过潜在空间梯度下降引导生成远离目标概念；保留能量保持与原始提示的语义对齐。该方法完全在推理时操作，无需修改模型权重。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，EGLOCE在基准测试中改善了概念移除效果，同时保持了图像质量和提示对齐，即使在对抗攻击下也表现良好。该方法实现了即插即用集成。
AI.conclusion: EGLOCE首次建立了通过采样期间双能量引导实现安全和可控图像生成的新范式，为概念擦除提供了高效且无需训练的解决方案。

title: SynFlow: Scaling Up LiDAR Scene Flow Estimation with Synthetic Data
summary: Reliable 3D dynamic perception requires models that can anticipate motion beyond predefined categories, yet progress is hindered by the scarcity of dense, high-quality motion annotations. While self-supervision on unlabeled real data offers a path forward, empirical evidence suggests that scaling unlabeled data fails to close the performance gap due to noisy proxy signals. In this paper, we propose a shift in paradigm: learning robust real-world motion priors entirely from scalable simulation. We introduce SynFlow, a data generation pipeline that generates large-scale synthetic dataset specifically designed for LiDAR scene flow. Unlike prior works that prioritize sensor-specific realism, SynFlow employs a motion-oriented strategy to synthesize diverse kinematic patterns across 4,000 sequences ($\sim$940k frames), termed SynFlow-4k. This represents a 34x scale-up in annotated volume over existing real-world benchmarks. Our experiments demonstrate that SynFlow-4k provides a highly domain-invariant motion prior. In a zero-shot regime, models trained exclusively on our synthetic data generalize across multiple real-world benchmarks, rivaling in-domain supervised baselines on nuScenes and outperforming state-of-the-art methods on TruckScenes by 31.8%. Furthermore, SynFlow-4k serves as a label-efficient foundation: fine-tuning with only 5% of real-world labels surpasses models trained from scratch on the full available budget. We open-source the pipeline and dataset to facilitate research in generalizable 3D motion estimation. More detail can be found at https://kin-zhang.github.io/SynFlow.

AI.tldr: 提出SynFlow数据生成管道，通过模拟生成大规模合成LiDAR场景流数据集SynFlow-4k，用于学习鲁棒的运动先验，在零样本和少样本设置下在多个真实世界基准上取得优异性能。
AI.motivation: 可靠的3D动态感知需要能够预测超出预定义类别运动的模型，但密集高质量运动标注的稀缺阻碍了进展。虽然无标签真实数据的自监督学习提供了前进路径，但经验证据表明扩展无标签数据无法弥补性能差距，因为代理信号存在噪声。
AI.method: 提出SynFlow数据生成管道，采用面向运动的策略合成多样化的运动模式，生成包含约940k帧的SynFlow-4k大规模合成数据集，比现有真实世界基准的标注量扩大了34倍。
AI.result: SynFlow-4k提供了高度领域不变的运动先验。在零样本设置下，仅使用合成数据训练的模型在多个真实世界基准上表现出良好的泛化能力，在nuScenes上与领域内监督基线相当，在TruckScenes上比最先进方法高出31.8%。此外，仅使用5%真实世界标签进行微调即可超过在完整预算上从头训练的模型。
AI.conclusion: SynFlow-4k为可泛化的3D运动估计研究提供了标签高效的基础，通过模拟学习鲁棒的真实世界运动先验是可行的替代范式。作者开源了管道和数据集以促进研究。

title: Do Vision Language Models Need to Process Image Tokens?
summary: Vision Language Models (VLMs) have achieved remarkable success by integrating visual encoders with large language models (LLMs). While VLMs process dense image tokens across deep transformer stacks (incurring substantial computational overhead), it remains fundamentally unclear whether sustained image-token processing is necessary for their performance or visual representations meaningfully evolve from early to later layers. In this work, we systematically investigate the functional role of image tokens in VLMs and show that visual representations rapidly converge to a bounded-complexity regime, \ie their entropy stabilizes, intrinsic dimensionality compresses, and trajectory curvature approaches a near-constant profile. In contrast, textual representations continue to undergo substantial restructuring across depth. Once stabilized, visual representations become largely interchangeable between layers, indicating limited additional transformation in deeper stages. Further, depth-wise visual truncation reveals that the necessity of visual processing is task-dependent, where single-token predictions remain comparatively robust to truncated visual depth, but multi-token generation require sustained access to visual representations. Under deterministic decoding, reducing visual depth perturbs intermediate reasoning trajectories more strongly than final outputs, suggesting that image tokens influence the structure of reasoning more than the ultimate conclusions. Collectively, these findings \textbf{question the assumption} that deeper visual processing is uniformly essential in VLMs, challenging the current paradigm of multimodal LLM architectures.

AI.tldr: 研究发现视觉语言模型中图像token的表示在早期层就快速收敛，深层处理并非总是必要，挑战了当前多模态LLM架构的范式
AI.motivation: 当前视觉语言模型(VLMs)通过深度transformer堆栈处理密集图像token，计算开销巨大，但尚不清楚持续的图像token处理是否必要，以及视觉表示从早期到后期层是否有实质性演化
AI.method: 系统研究图像token在VLMs中的功能作用，分析视觉表示的收敛特性（熵稳定、内在维度压缩、轨迹曲率趋近恒定），对比文本表示的演化，进行深度方向的视觉截断实验
AI.result: 视觉表示快速收敛到有界复杂度区域，稳定后各层间可互换；视觉处理的必要性是任务依赖的：单token预测对视觉深度截断相对鲁棒，但多token生成需要持续访问视觉表示；确定性解码下，减少视觉深度对中间推理轨迹影响大于最终输出
AI.conclusion: 研究质疑了更深层视觉处理在VLMs中普遍必要的假设，挑战了当前多模态LLM架构的范式

title: SCoRe: Clean Image Generation from Diffusion Models Trained on Noisy Images
summary: Diffusion models trained on noisy datasets often reproduce high-frequency training artifacts, significantly degrading generation quality. To address this, we propose SCoRe (Spectral Cutoff Regeneration), a training-free, generation-time spectral regeneration method for clean image generation from diffusion models trained on noisy images. Leveraging the spectral bias of diffusion models, which infer high-frequency details from low-frequency cues, SCoRe suppresses corrupted high-frequency components of a generated image via a frequency cutoff and regenerates them via SDEdit. Crucially, we derive a theoretical mapping between the cutoff frequency and the SDEdit initialization timestep based on Radially Averaged Power Spectral Density (RAPSD), which prevents excessive noise injection during regeneration. Experiments on synthetic (CIFAR-10) and real-world (SIDD) noisy datasets demonstrate that SCoRe substantially outperforms post-processing and noise-robust baselines, restoring samples closer to clean image distributions without any retraining or fine-tuning.

AI.tldr: SCoRe是一种无需训练的生成时频谱再生方法，通过抑制生成图像中的高频噪声并重新生成，从噪声数据训练的扩散模型中生成干净图像。
AI.motivation: 在噪声数据集上训练的扩散模型会复制高频训练伪影，显著降低生成质量。现有方法需要重新训练或微调，而SCoRe旨在提供无需训练的解决方案。
AI.method: SCoRe利用扩散模型的频谱偏置特性，通过频率截止抑制生成图像中的高频噪声，然后使用SDEdit重新生成这些高频成分。关键创新是推导了截止频率与SDEdit初始化时间步之间的理论映射关系。
AI.result: 在合成数据集(CIFAR-10)和真实世界噪声数据集(SIDD)上的实验表明，SCoRe显著优于后处理和噪声鲁棒基线方法，无需重新训练或微调即可恢复接近干净图像分布的样本。
AI.conclusion: SCoRe提供了一种有效的训练时频谱再生方法，能够从噪声数据训练的扩散模型中生成干净图像，无需额外的训练成本，在理论和实验上都表现出优越性能。

title: AsymLoc: Towards Asymmetric Feature Matching for Efficient Visual Localization
summary:
Precise and real-time visual localization is critical for applications like AR/VR and robotics, especially on resource-constrained edge devices such as smart glasses, where battery life and heat dissipation can be a primary concerns. While many efficient models exist, further reducing compute without sacrificing accuracy is essential for practical deployment. To address this, we propose asymmetric visual localization: a large Teacher model processes pre-mapped database images offline, while a lightweight Student model processes the query image online. This creates a challenge in matching features from two different models without resorting to heavy, learned matchers.
  We introduce AsymLoc, a novel distillation framework that aligns a Student to its Teacher through a combination of a geometry-driven matching objective and a joint detector-descriptor distillation objective, enabling fast, parameter-less nearest-neighbor matching. Extensive experiments on HPatches, ScanNet, IMC2022, and Aachen show that AsymLoc achieves up to 95% of the teacher's localization accuracy using an order of magnitude smaller models, significantly outperforming existing baselines and establishing a new state-of-the-art efficiency-accuracy trade-off.
